**Company Overview**
  
  
Performance Contracting Group is a national employee-owned specialty contractor that offers quality services and products to the commercial, industrial, and non-residential construction markets. We are committed to recruiting, developing, and advancing employees from a diversity of backgrounds and experiences, as well as supporting a culture of safety and inclusiveness that allows you to contribute to your fullest potential. We place high value on training and professional development, encouraging you to broaden and strengthen your unique skill sets so you can fully realize your potential.

**Job Description**

  

Performance Contracting Inc. is seeking an experienced **Senior Administrative Assistant** to support our **Business Development 597** department, providing administrative support across our East Coast regions, with opportunities based in **Raleigh, NC, Washington, D.C., Philadelphia, PA, or Atlanta, GA**. The Senior Administrative Assistant provides high-level administrative and operational support to the Director of Strategic Accounts and Business Development team by coordinating executive activities, managing key business information and resources, supporting client engagement initiatives, and ensuring the efficient execution of strategic business development operations.

  

**Duties & Responsibilities:**

  

* Provide high-level administrative support to the Director of Strategic Accounts and Business Development Executives, ensuring efficient day-to-day operations and effective coordination of activities.
* Manage a variety of administrative and executive support responsibilities, including correspondence management, email monitoring and response, report preparation, document organization, and cross-functional administrative support.
* Coordinate and maintain calendars, schedule meetings, and arrange business travel and related logistics.
* Support business development initiatives by coordinating participation in industry trade shows, conferences, workshops, client events, charitable engagements, and other networking opportunities.
* Partner with Marketing and internal stakeholders across PCG to obtain and coordinate promotional materials, event resources, presentations, and other business development support needs.
* Maintain and manage travel schedules and tracking records for team members, including travel dates, locations, client engagements, and overlapping travel activities.
* Research, develop, and maintain strategic client profiles, including detailed dossiers on key client organizations and executive contacts.
* Organize and maintain electronic filing systems and document repositories, ensuring accurate, accessible, and up-to-date business development information and resources.
* Manage and continuously improve Business Development shared folders and records, including reports, databases, analytics files, and supporting documentation.
* Coordinate the preparation, inventory, and distribution of client appreciation items, branded merchandise, executive gift packages, thank-you correspondence, and other client engagement materials.
* Assist with the development and compilation of post-event reports, analyses, and summaries, including trade show recaps, business development reviews, and executive reporting materials.
* Collaborate with business development leadership and team members to support strategic initiatives, special projects, and operational priorities.
  

**Salary Range**: $52,800-71,000 annual salary plus non-guaranteed annualized bonus program.

  

**Basic Qualifications**

  

* Minimum of three years of progressive administrative support experience in a professional business environment.
* Bachelor's degree in Business Administration, Sales, Communications, or a related field; equivalent combinations of education and experience may be considered.
* Demonstrated experience supporting one or more senior leaders or executives, including managing complex calendars, coordinating competing priorities, preparing reports, and facilitating efficient workflow management.
* Proficiency in Microsoft Office Suite applications, including Excel and PowerPoint, Microsoft Copilot, and other AI platforms and tools.
* Experience handling confidential and sensitive information with a high degree of discretion and professionalism.
* Ability to support in-person and virtual events as needed.
* Ability and willingness to travel up to 10% as business needs require.
* Experience with ProjectMark (or other CRM’s) and Axis/Dynamics 365 preferred
* Local to the East Coast area.
  

**Skills & Abilities**

  

* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities and follow through on commitments.
* Exceptional customer service skills with a commitment to providing responsive and professional support.
* Ability to thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic work environment while maintaining accuracy and attention to detail.
* Demonstrated adaptability and flexibility in response to changing priorities and business needs.
* Excellent verbal, written, and interpersonal communication skills, with the ability to interact professionally and effectively with stakeholders at all levels of the organization.
* Strong business writing, editing, proofreading, grammar, and punctuation skills.
* Professional presence and the ability to represent the organization in a positive and professional manner.

**Benefits**

At Performance Contracting, our employees are our greatest asset. We put our people first and are proud to provide a comprehensive benefits package designed to meet the needs of our employees at every stage of life.

In our commitment to fostering an environment where everyone can thrive personally and professionally, we offer:

* Competitive pay
* Incentive bonus plan
* Employee stock ownership plan (ESOP)
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with match
* Medical, prescription drug, dental, and vision insurance plans with flexible spending account option
* Life insurance, AD&D, and disability benefits
* Employee assistance program (EAP)
* Flexible paid time off policy and paid holidays

PCG provides equal employment and affirmative action opportunities to applicants and employees without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, protected veteran status, or disability.

PCG is a background screening, drug-free workplace. In accordance with the provisions of Tennessee Code Annotated (T.C.A.), Title 50, Chapter 9, PCG’s Drug-Free Workplace Program includes drug and alcohol testing as part of the hiring process and throughout employment, as applicable.

Please note this job description is not designed to contain a comprehensive listing of activities, duties, or responsibilities that are required of the employee for this job. Duties, responsibilities, and activities may change at any time with or without notice.

NOTICE TO STAFFING FIRMS, AGENCIES, AND EMPLOYMENT VENDORS:
  
Performance Contracting Group and its affiliates will not accept unsolicited resumes or claims on candidates from third-party employment vendors unless a signed Fee Agreement is in place AND a candidate has been submitted into our applicant tracking system (Dayforce). Vendor solicitation should be directed to the Corporate Recruitment Department directly; as such, firms that circumvent the required compliant process will be barred from submitting candidates. In the absence of a signed Fee Agreement and proper resume submission, PCG does not recognize any claim on a candidate by a third party and will consider unsolicited resumes the property of the company, reserving the right to engage and hire those candidates without any financial responsibility to the third-party vendor.

46b60791a9fad235a302.description:
The Senior Administrative Coordinator provides high-level administrative, financial, and operational support for a designated region. This remote role is responsible for managing regional organization and reporting. The position serves as a key liaison between operational deliverables and regional leadership. Accountability, consistency, and the timely execution of business priorities are critical to success in this role. This role requires strong organizational skills, financial acumen, attention to detail, and the ability to manage multiple initiatives in a fast-paced environment.

**Compensation: $27.00/hr. (US Dollars)**  
The pay listed is the salary range for this position. Any specific offer will vary based on the successful applicant’s education, experience, skills, abilities, geographic location, and alignment with market data. You may be eligible to participate in a Company incentive or bonus program.

**Executive & Administrative Support**

* Provides direct administrative support to the Director of Operations.
* Manages calendars, meeting coordination, project tracking, action item follow-up, and operational communications.
* Prepare presentations, reports, dashboards, meeting materials, and executive summaries.
* Coordinates regional meetings, business reviews, operational calls, and leadership communications.
* Maintains organized electronic records, documentation, and business files in accordance with company standards.

At LifeStance Health, we strive to help individuals, families, and communities with their mental health needs. Everywhere. Every day. It’s a lofty goal; we know. But we make it happen with the best team in mental healthcare.

Thank you for taking the time to explore a career with us. As the fastest growing mental health practice group in the country, now is the perfect time to join our team!

*LifeStance Health Values*

* Belonging: We cultivate a space where everyone can show up as their authentic self.
* Empathy: We seek out diverse perspectives and listen to learn without judgment.
* Courage: We are all accountable for doing the right thing - even when it's hard - because we know it's worth it.
* One Team: We realize our full potential when we work together towards our shared purpose.

*Benefits*  
As a full-time employee of LifeStance Health, the following benefits are offered: medical, dental, vision, AD&D, short and long-term disability, and life insurance. Additional benefits include a 401k retirement savings with employer match, paid parental leave, paid time off, holiday pay and an Employee Assistance Program.

**Job Summary:**

The Practice Coordinator is responsible for managing the front office daily activities for their practice location, ensuring quality customer service to in-person and remote patients and clinicians.

  

**Compensation**: Starting pay of $21- 22/hour depending on experience, plus quarterly bonus/incentive potential

**Location**: 495 Thomas Jones Way Suite 204 Exton, PA 19341

**Duties/Responsibilities:**

**Operational Excellence:**

* Create a positive work environment; be a culture carrier and support in-office clinician and staff engagement activities to promote LFST culture, engagement, and connection.
* Conduct schedule prep process for all patients to ensure all paperwork and documentation is complete, credit card on file is current, demographics are accurate, and patient chart is prepared.
* General office duties, cleanliness, and appeal, such as sorting office mail, scanning documents, e-faxes, shared office email and office upkeep, to ensure the practice is running smoothly and prepared for patients and clinicians.
* Communicate with peers, clinicians, and patients in ways that support patient care and clinician satisfaction.

**Patient Support:**

* Provide exceptional customer service, responding quickly and appropriately to patient needs, and being prepared to manage potentially difficult or sensitive situations by following Crisis and De-escalation Processes.
* Manage front desk responsibilities including greeting and checking patients in/out in a courteous manner.
* Provide support to patients with requests via phone, email, and/or portal with payment/billing related questions, scheduling needs, release requests, miscellaneous inquires, etc.
* Manage queues within the phone system, ensuring calls are answered timely to ensure excellent customer service.
* Assist patients with telehealth access, Patient Portal issues, and other troubleshooting as needed.

* Handle any urgent requests; triage patient issues and resolution, i.e., direct to correct departments or escalate for assistance.
* Collect all in-person and telehealth co-payments and account balances at the time of service.
* Complete insurance eligibility verification and reach out to patients to resolve any issues.

**Clinician Support:**

* Provide general clinician support – assist clinicians with administrative questions and/or duties such as sending letters, faxes, etc.
* Coordinate with clinicians pertaining to any additional patient questions.
* Support clinician schedules by auditing for appointment accuracy.
* Maintain a pleasant, secure, and motivational working environment in the Practice.

**Required Skills/Abilities:**

* Ability to multitask and prioritize duties to support delivery of high-quality patient experience.
* Ability to work independently and as a team member.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Proficient in using Computer Software Applications (Microsoft Office & EMRs)
* Comfortable handling sensitive and confidential Information (HIPAA)

**Education and Experience:**

* High School or equivalent required, associates/bachelor’s degree, preferred.
* 1+ years of experience in healthcare operations, customer service, or similar role or setting preferred.

**Physical Requirements:**

* The physical demands described here are representative of those that must be met by an employee to successfully perform the essential functions of the job. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions.
* While performing the duties of this job, the employee is regularly required to sit, stand, bend, talk, and hear. The employee is frequently required to walk. The employee must be able to lift and/or move objects up to 25 pounds. Specific vision abilities required by this job include close vision, distance vision, color vision, peripheral vision, depth perception, and the ability to adjust focus.

*LifeStance provides the compensation range and benefits that it in good faith believes it might pay and/or offer for this position. LifeStance reserves the right to ultimately pay more or less than the posted range and offer additional benefits and other compensation, depending on circumstances not related to an applicant’s sex or other status protected by local, state, or federal law.*

Bachelor’s Degree in health, business, or related field preferred

* Experience managing or supporting daily operations such as staffing coordination, scheduling, patient access, workflow management, and regulatory compliance
* Demonstrated ability to supervise staff, support performance management, and maintain service and quality standards

Competencies required for this job:

* Strong business acumen
* Skilled in all forms of communication
* Effectively able to develop self and others
* Leadership presence/EQ, presents as a composed and competent leader
* Quality focused
* Exudes patient and customer service focus
* Shares a compelling strategy that inspires others

***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Assistant General Counsel will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer and play a key role in supporting the Company's EPC and other business development, commercial and procurement contracting, regulatory compliance, risk management, and day-to-day business operations. This position will serve as a trusted legal advisor to cross-functional business teams, including executive leadership, helping drive business objectives while proactively managing legal and commercial risk.
  
  
The ideal candidate will possess a strong combination of construction, corporate and renewable energy experience, with the ability to provide practical, business-oriented legal advice in a fast-paced, growth-oriented environment. The successful candidate will be comfortable handling complex transactions, leading negotiations, influencing business decisions, and partnering with senior executives. The successful candidate will also have multiple years of managing and developing other attorneys in an in-house legal department.  
  
This role can be based full-time in our office in San Diego, CA, Frisco / Dallas, TX or Denver, CO. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

**Position Responsibilities and Duties:**

* Serve as a trusted legal advisor to business teams, including executive leadership, on commercial, operational and regulatory matters.
* Exercise sound judgment grounded in ethics, integrity, accountability, and transparent communication.
* Build and maintain strong relationships with internal and external stakeholders, including business leaders, executives, developers, contractors, and outside counsel.
* Evaluate legal and business issues holistically, balancing risk mitigation with commercial objectives.
* Foster a collaborative, solution-oriented approach across the organization. Monitor and advise on legal, regulatory, legislative, and industry developments impacting the renewable energy, infrastructure, and construction sectors.
* Partner with business development, finance, and executive teams on a broad range of project and commercial transactions.
* Identify legal and business risks associated with new market opportunities and develop practical mitigation strategies.
* Assist in developing and enhancing legal processes, policies, and governance structures that support organizational growth and scalability.

Commercial Contracting

* Lead and support the drafting, review, negotiation, and administration of a broad range of complex commercial agreements, including:
* Engineering, procurement and construction (EPC) agreements
* Construction subcontracts
* Supply and procurement agreements
* Equipment purchase agreements
* Operations and Maintenance (O&M) agreements
* Master service agreements
* Commercial customer contracts
* Non-disclosure agreements
* Real estate agreements
* Memorandums of understanding and framework agreements
* Provide strategic guidance regarding contract interpretation, change orders, claims management, and dispute avoidance.
* Collaborate with Operations, Procurement and Business Development teams to support successful project execution and commercial outcomes.

Risk Management, Compliance and Governance

* Assist in developing, implementing, and maintaining corporate compliance, governance, and risk management programs.
* Support corporate entity management, organizational recordkeeping, and governance requirements.
* Advise business leaders on regulatory requirements affecting renewable energy development, construction operations, labor matters, and commercial activities.
* Conduct legal risk assessments and recommend practical solutions to minimize exposure while supporting business objectives.

Claims, Disputes and Legal Operations

* Support the management of construction, commercial, and project-related claims and disputes.
* Assist with the coordination of outside counsel regarding litigation, arbitration, mediation, and other dispute resolution matters.
* Assist in overseeing outside counsel performance, legal budgets, accruals, and matter management.

**Minimum Skills or Experience Requirements:**

* Juris Doctor (J.D.) from an ABA-accredited law school.
* Active bar membership in good standing.
* 12-15+ years of legal experience, including significant experience at a nationally or regionally recognized law firm, and at a public company and/or other sophisticated in-house legal department.
* Managed other attorneys for 5+ years
* Demonstrated experience in renewable energy, construction, infrastructure, project development, or related industries.
* Strong experience negotiating and drafting complex commercial agreements and construction-related contracts.
* Proven ability to provide practical, solutions-oriented legal guidance.
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to handle multiple competing priorities.
* Excellent written, verbal, negotiation, and presentation skills.
* Demonstrated ability to identify legal risks proactively and develop commercially reasonable solutions.
High degree of professional judgment, integrity, executive presence, and business acumen.  

  

*Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the U.S. without requiring employer sponsorship now or in the future.*

Kentro is hiring for a **Talent Acquisition (TA) Ops Coordinator** supporting the Corporate TA team and all contracts. The Talent Acquisition (TA) Coordinator provides administrative, systems, and customer service support throughout the recruiting and hiring lifecycle. Reporting to the TA Operations Lead, this role helps maintain accurate iCIMS records, conducts initial requisition quality reviews before TA Manager review, coordinates post-offer activities and start-date communications, and responds professionally to general inquiries submitted through Digital HQ. The Coordinator works closely with Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, HR Business Partners, Personnel Security, IT, Corporate teams, and Service Delivery stakeholders to ensure timely and accurate handoffs. This is an opportunity for a detail-oriented, dependable individual to learn recruiting operations, technology, and the federal government contracting business while supporting a high-performing team.

**Location:** This position can be performed remotely within the continental United States and will support Eastern Time working hours.

**Compensation Range:** The anticipated base salary range for this position is $45,000- 65,000 annually as non-exempt employee and reflects Kentro’s good-faith expectations at the time of posting. Final compensation is determined based on the role’s requirements, relevant skills, experience, education, certifications, work location, applicable security clearance requirements, market conditions, internal equity, and contract requirements.

This Job Description reflects the primary duties of the role; however, it is not intended to be all‑inclusive. Team members may be asked to take on additional responsibilities in alignment with customer expectations, business needs, and Kentro’s culture of collaboration and adaptability.

Responsibilities:

### **Recruiting Operations**

* Conduct initial completeness and accuracy checks of new and updated requisitions in iCIMS, including job information, required fields, supporting documentation, and workflow status, before routing to the TA Manager for review.
* Maintain requisition and candidate records, update statuses, monitor outstanding administrative actions, and follow up with recruiters and stakeholders on missing information.
* Support daily recruiting coordination, documentation, and task tracking while following established procedures and escalation paths.
* Assist with maintaining SOPs, job aids, templates, and process documentation as directed by the TA Operations Lead.

### **Analytics & Reporting**

* Perform routine data-quality checks to identify incomplete, inconsistent, duplicate, or outdated ATS records and coordinate corrections.
* Support recurring reporting by validating source data, maintaining trackers, and preparing basic status updates as assigned.
* Flag recurring errors, delayed handoffs, and data-quality concerns to the TA Operations Lead.

### **Technology & Systems Support**

* Learn iCIMS ATS and CXM workflows, user functions, and basic administrative capabilities under the guidance of the TA Operations Lead.
* Assist with approved system updates, testing, user guidance, and documentation; escalate configuration, access, integration, and vendor issues to authorized system owners.
* Help maintain system cleanliness and support adoption of updated workflows and tools.

### **Candidate Experience & Post-Offer Coordination**

* Complete and track assigned administrative steps after offer acceptance, ensuring required records and notifications are updated promptly.
* Confirm anticipated start dates with responsible stakeholders and communicate changes to TA, HR Operations, Personnel Security, IT, Corporate teams, and Service Delivery as appropriate.
* Monitor outstanding pre-employment and onboarding items, follow up with process owners, and escalate potential delays; do not independently approve clearances, screenings, or hiring exceptions.
* Support accurate, professional candidate and internal communications throughout the post-offer handoff.

### **Internal Customer Service & Quality Control**

* Monitor and respond to assigned Digital HQ tickets involving general TA questions and requests with timely, courteous, accurate communication.
* Document ticket actions, coordinate answers with appropriate subject-matter experts, and escalate policy, sensitive employee, technical, or approval matters when necessary.
* Conduct routine checks of requisition and candidate documentation against established TA standards and help maintain audit-ready records.
* Collaborate professionally with recruiters, TA Managers, Corporate departments, and Service Delivery personnel to resolve administrative needs and improve handoffs.

### **Growth & Process Improvement and Sourcing**

* Participate in training to build knowledge of government contracting, TA systems, hiring processes, and relevant compliance requirements.
* Identify practical improvements to checklists, data hygiene, communications, and administrative workflows and share recommendations with the TA Operations Lead.
* Demonstrate initiative, accountability, confidentiality, responsiveness, and a willingness to take on broader responsibilities as skills develop.
* As the Company grows, additional opportunities to conduct sourcing using Kentro tools to support the overall Hiring Process.

Qualifications:

* College education (associate’s degree, bachelor’s degree, or relevant college coursework) with 0–3 years of related experience in administrative support, recruiting coordination, HR, customer service, or business operations; OR, for candidates without college education, generally 3 or more years of relevant administrative, business operations, or government contracting experience. Equivalent combinations of education and experience will be considered.
* Strong attention to detail, organization, time management, and ability to follow through on multiple priorities.
* Professional written and verbal communication and a service-oriented approach to internal customers.
* Working familiarity with Microsoft Outlook, Word, Excel, and Teams and ability to learn new systems quickly.
* Sound judgment in handling confidential information, following established procedures, and escalating issues appropriately.
* Demonstrated reliability, initiative, teamwork, curiosity, and willingness to learn.

**Preferred Qualifications:**
-----------------------------

* Experience with iCIMS or another applicant tracking or HR system.
* Exposure to federal government contracting, recruiting, HR operations, or employee onboarding.
* Experience using ticketing systems, maintaining records, supporting audits, or assisting with system testing.

**Clearance Requirement:**

* US Citizen or Lawful Permanent Resident (Green Card)
* Willing and able to obtain and maintain Public Trust Clearance or higher

Benefits:

**The Company**

We believe in generating success collaboratively, enabling long-term mission success, and building trust for the next challenge. With you as our partner, let’s solve challenges, think innovatively, and maximize impact. As a valued member of our team, you have the unique opportunity to work in a diverse range of technology and business career paths, all while supporting our nation and delivering innovative technology solutions. We are a close community of experts that pride ourselves on creating an environment defined by teamwork, dedication, and excellence.

We hold three ISO certifications (27001:2013, 20000-1:2011, 9001:2015), two CMMI ML 3 ratings (DEV and SVC) and CMMC Level 2 Certification.

**Industry Recognition**

Growth | Inc 5000’s Fastest Growing Private Companies, DC Metro List Fastest Growing; Washington Business Journal: Fastest Growing Companies, Top Performing Small Technology Companies in Greater D.C.

Culture | Northern Virginia Technology Council Tech 100 Honoree; Virginia Best Place to Work; Washington Business Journal: Best Places to Work, Corporate Diversity Index Winner – Mid-Size Companies, Companies Owned by People of Color; Department of Labor’s HireVets for our work helping veterans transition; SECAF Award of Excellence finalist; Victory Military Friendly Brand; Virginia Values Veterans (V3); Cystic Fibrosis Foundation Corporate Breath Award

**Benefits**

We offer competitive benefits package including paid time off, healthcare benefits, supplemental benefits, 401k including an employer match, discount perks, rewards, and more. We invest in our employees – Every employee is eligible for education reimbursement for certifications, degrees, or professional development. Reimbursement amounts may fluctuate due to IRS limitations. We want you to grow as an expert and a leader and offer flexibility for you to take a course, complete a certification, or other professional growth and networking. We are committed to supporting your curiosity and sustaining a culture that prioritizes commitment to continuous professional development.

We work hard; we play hard. Kentro is committed to incorporating fun into every day. We dedicate funds for activities – virtual and in-person – e.g., we host happy hours, holiday events, fitness & wellness events, and annual celebrations. In alignment with our commitment to our communities, we also host and attend charity galas/events. We believe in appreciating your commitment and building a positive workspace for you to be creative, innovative, and happy.

**Commitment Equal Opportunity Employment & VEVRAA**

Kentro is an equal opportunity employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to disability, status as a protected veteran or any other status protected by applicable federal, state or local law.

Kentro is strongly committed to compliance with VEVRAA and other applicable federal, state, and local laws governing equal employment opportunity. We have developed comprehensive policies and procedures to ensure our hiring practices align with these requirements.

As part of our VEVRAA compliance efforts, Kentro has established an equal opportunity plan outlining our commitment to recruiting, hiring, and advancing protected veterans. This plan is regularly reviewed and updated to ensure its effectiveness.

We encourage protected veterans to self-identify during the application process. This information is strictly confidential and will only be used for reporting and compliance purposes as required by law. Providing this information is voluntary and will not impact your employment eligibility.

Our commitment to equal employment opportunity extends beyond legal compliance. We are dedicated to fostering an inclusive workplace where all employees, including protected veterans, are treated with dignity, respect, and fairness.

**How to Apply**

To apply to Kentro Positions- Please click on the job link and then click the blue “Apply” button at the top right of Job Description. Please upload your resume and complete all the application steps. You must fully submit the application for Kentro to consider you for a position. If you need alternative application methods, please email careers@kentro.us and request assistance.

**Accommodations**

To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty satisfactorily. Reasonable Accommodations may be made to enable qualified individuals with disabilities to perform the essential functions. If you need to discuss reasonable accommodations, please email careers@kentro.us.

284f50dd351aacb72feb.description:
***Are you ready for what’s next?***

*Come explore opportunities within* *Brunswick, a global marine leader* *committed to challenging conventions and innovating next-generation technologies that transform experiences on the water and beyond. Brunswick believes “Next Never Rests™,” and we offer a variety of exciting careers and growth opportunities within united teams defining the future of marine recreation.*

**Workplace Category:** Remote

**Travel Required:** None

**Direct Reports:** None

**Pay Range: $43,680.00 - $45,760.00**

**Visa Sponsorship:** *Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States. This position is not eligible for employment visa sponsorship now or in the future.*

**Relocation:** Not offered

**Innovation is at the heart of Brunswick. See how your contributions will help transform vision into reality:**

  

Position Overview:

Freedom Boat Club is the nation's oldest and largest private member boat club, with locations both nationally and internationally. We are currently seeking a highly organized, detail-oriented Systems Support Coordinator to join our Member Experience Center team. This role supports multiple internal platforms and provides technical and operational assistance to franchise owners, corporate staff, and internal users, ensuring system accuracy, consistency, and performance across a wide range of business systems.

The Systems Support Coordinator is a system-oriented support role that is not member-facing but is critical to smooth daily operations. Responsibilities include front-end and back-end support, ticketing, data validation, and multi-system troubleshooting. The ideal candidate demonstrates professionalism in all communications and works independently to resolve issues, manage tasks, and drive process improvements.

This position reports to the Manager of Reservations and requires strong organizational skills, attention to detail, and the ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment.

**At Brunswick & Freedom Boat Club, we are passionate about what we do and committed to delivering exceptional experiences.**

**Essential Functions:**

* Provide multi‑system support for staff and franchise teams, including account assistance, troubleshooting, and general system guidance
* Review and reconcile data inconsistencies across platforms; escalate issues as needed
* Manage and prioritize a high volume of tickets, requests, and projects
* Deliver non‑initial system training, job aids, and resource materials to staff and franchise operators
* Update templates for member welcome emails and texts
* Create new user profiles, reset passwords, and confirm user details
* Assist with reservation creation, confirmation, and issue resolution (Home and Reciprocal)
* Support updates to staff or franchise account records, reservations, payments, and operational data
* Evaluate work submitted by franchise teams for accuracy and provide process guidance when needed
* Process membership contract inbox requests for new memberships, holds, suspensions, cancellations
* Perform manual data entry and ensure system accuracy
* Assist with fleet changes, including vessel out of service, in service, retired and transfers
* Communicate with stakeholders to track ticket statuses

**Diversity of thought and experiences is fundamental when imagining the unimaginable. Certain** **skillsets/experiences** **are necessary; however, others can be developed along the way.**

  

**Required Qualifications**

* 1-3 years of professional customer service experience (B2C and/or B2B)
* Proven ability to communicate professionally with internal teams and external stakeholders
* Strong organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities simultaneously
* Ability to work independently in a fast-paced, high-volume environment
* Strong problem-solving and analytical thinking skills
* Experience with data entry, systems administration, or operational support
* Team player with camaraderie culture attitude

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* Associate or Bachelor’s degree (or equivalent work experience)
* Experience with Salesforce or similar CRM systems
* Familiarity with ticketing systems (e.g., ServiceNow or similar)
* Experience working with franchise networks or multi-location operations

**Working Conditions**

* This is a fully remote position
* Member Experience Center operating hours are Monday through Friday, 8:00 AM – 5:00 PM Eastern Time
* Full-time role: 40 hours per week, Monday through Friday, with occasional holiday coverage as needed.

**The anticipated pay** **range for this position is $43,680.00 - $45,760.00 annually**. The actual base pay offered will vary based on multiple factors including job-related knowledge/skills, relevant experience, business needs, and geographic location. Compensation decisions are dependent upon the specifics of the candidate’s qualifications and the business context.

In addition to base pay, this position is eligible for an annual discretionary bonus. This position is eligible to participate in Brunswick's comprehensive and high-quality benefits offerings, including medical, dental, vision, paid vacation, 401k (up to 4% match), Health Savings Account (with company contribution), well-being program, product purchase discounts and much more. Details about our benefits can be found here.

**Why Brunswick:**

Whatever tomorrow brings, we’ll be at the leading edge. As the clear leader in the marine industry, we're committed to our values and supporting our exceptional people. We offer valuable benefits including a competitive 401(k) plan with company match, discounted membership rates, and much more. In addition, we’re proud of being recognized for making a splash with numerous awards!

**About Freedom Boat Club**

Freedom Boat Club – the world’s largest members-only boat club – was founded in 1989 in Sarasota, Florida. Today, the Clubs 400+ locations welcome hundreds of members to its docks each day to enjoy a day on the water while we take care of the rest including fueling, cleaning, maintenance, and more.

With over 30 years of Boating Made Simple®, Freedom Boat Club (a division of Brunswick Corporation) continues to be a passionate group of individuals who focus on raising the bar in everything that we do. We are always looking for hardworking and motivated people who share our passion for getting others out on the open waters.

To learn more about open positions within the Freedom Boat Club, please visit the Brunswick Corporation Careers page.

*Next is Now!*

*We value growth and development, recognizing that people come with a wealth of experience and talent beyond just the technical requirements of a job. If your experience is close to what you see listed here, please still consider applying.*

Brunswick is an Equal Opportunity Employer and considers all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, age, disability, protected veteran status or any other characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law. Diversity of experience and skills combined with passion is key to innovation and inspiration and we encourage individuals from all backgrounds to apply. If you require accommodation during the application or interview process, please contact hrsharedservices@brunswick.com for support.

Brunswick and Workday Privacy Policies

Brunswick does not accept applications, inquiries or solicitations from unapproved staffing agencies or vendors. For help, please contact our support team at: hrsharedservices@brunswick.com or 866-278-6942.

All job offers will come to you via the candidate portal you create when applying through a posted position through https:///www.brunswick.com/careers. If you are ever unsure about what is being required of you during the application process or its source, please contact HR Shared Services at 866-278-6942 or HRSharedServices@brunswick.com.

52625eabef55b89ba1c7.description:
**About WCG**
-------------

WCG delivers transformational solutions that accelerate clinical research and advance human health. We serve the experts, innovators, and pathfinders on the frontlines of science and medicine—empowering them to develop breakthrough therapies while ensuring the risks of progress never outweigh the value of human life. Together, we stimulate growth, maximize efficiency, and shape the future of clinical trials.

**Why WCG**
-----------

At WCG, we invest in our people because you are the driving force behind our mission. When you grow, our impact grows. When you thrive, research accelerates. We empower you to build a meaningful career while advancing the work that improves lives.

  

What we offer:

* Comprehensive health and financial protection – Medical, dental, vision, life and disability insurance, 401(k) with company match, and flexible spending accounts
* Resources that support your whole life – Employee assistance programs and work/life balance tools
* Investment in your growth – Referral bonuses, tuition reimbursement, on-the-job training, certification assistance, and continuing education support
* Time to recharge – Paid holidays, vacation, and sick time
* Pathways forward – Career development opportunities across One WCG

We practice transparency in everything we do, including compensation. The salary range for this position reflects our commitment to fair, competitive pay based on your qualifications, experience, skills, education, and location. Together, we'll find the right fit for your expertise and our shared mission.

**Job Summary**
---------------

Responsibilities include, but are not limited to, supporting data collection; managing and analyzing documents; client reporting; and problem resolution. This position will:

* Support the Board and clients by preparing documents for review in accordance with company policies and regulatory requirements
* Provide accurate document identification and data entry
* Finalize and deliver documents to clients
* Meet assigned metrics around speed and accuracy
* Able to deal effectively with high work volume, rigid deadlines, and frequent changes

Specific job function requirements are outlined in the training curriculum and addenda that support step-level 1 development for this position. Each function is made up of multiple duties. Specific criteria are attributed to each duty to measure proficiency. As proficiency is demonstrated in each duty, additional duties will be assigned for learning.

**ESSENTIAL DUTIES/RESPONSIBILITIES:** To perform this job successfully, an individual must be able to perform each essential duty and responsibility satisfactorily. The accountabilities listed below are representative of the knowledge, skills, and/or ability required.

* Ability to maintain and promote positive working relationships with clients (internal and external) by providing timely and professional service to their needs within the scope of company mission and accompanying regulations
* Maintain close attention to detail
* Ability to proofread and detect errors in typing, spelling, grammar, syntax, and punctuation
* Ability to read and interpret documents such as protocols for clinical investigations, medical literature, safety rules, operating and maintenance instructions
* Ability to set priorities and manage time effectively
* Accurately and completely enter information in a database system
* Contribute to a positive team environment through collaborative engagement with others
* Resolve questions and problems effectively
* Communicate to obtain information or clarify requests
* Mentor team members by teaching procedures, monitoring, and proofing work, and providing constructive feedback as needed or requested
* Is able to assist others across Operations, as needed. This may include overtime requests, training support, etc.
* Professional verbal and written communication skills
* Independent worker
* Accountable for self-metrics
* Other duties as assigned by supervisor. These may, on occasion, be unrelated to the position described here.
* Attendance and punctuality are essential functions of the position.

**EDUCATION REQUIREMENTS:**

* Bachelor's or associate Degree preferred, or a combination of equivalent education and experience

**QUALIFICATIONS/EXPERIENCE:**

* Two+ years of experience working in an office setting where proofing documents and attention to detail are essential elements of your job requirements
* Must have strong analytical skills with a high degree of accuracy in work
* Advanced knowledge of Microsoft Word, Excel, Outlook, Databases and Adobe
* Knowledge of FDA regulations as they relate to research (preferred)
* Must be able to maintain confidentiality
* Experience working with medical terminology (preferred)
* Ability to work independently, utilize discretionary judgment, and be a pro-active team player
* Exhibit excellence in:
  + Communication – Proficient verbal and written communication skills. Willingness to share and receive information and ideas from all levels of the organization in order to achieve the desired results.
  + Customer service – Understanding the importance of meeting client requests and adapting to changing needs.
  + Teamwork – Commitment to the successful achievement of team and organizational goals through a desire to participate with and help other members of the team

**TRAVEL REQUIREMENTS:** 0 - 5%

**Pay Range**
-------------

USD $19.50 - USD $28.10 /Hr.

**EEOC Statement**
------------------

WCG is proud to be an equal opportunity employer – Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment based on merit and without regard to race, color, national origin or ancestry, religion or creed, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression, gender identity, age, marital status, family or parental status, disability, genetic information, citizenship, veteran status, or any other legally recognized basis or status protected by federal, state, or local law. WCG complies with the Vietnam Era Veterans' Readjustment Act and Section 503 of the Rehabilitation Act. We promote a "One WCG" culture where all are welcome, respected, valued, and empowered to make a difference every day to advance clinical research.

aecedd8eef1f489c4bd0.title: Sr Specialist, Operations Business Intelligence
aecedd8eef1f489c4bd0.description:
OnTrac is hiring a Senior Specialist, Operations Business Intelligence!
  
  
Are you eager to join a dynamic and expanding company where you can both learn and make a meaningful impact? If you possess a strong sense of empathy, enjoy assisting others, thrive in a fast-paced environment, and excel at problem-solving, we encourage you to apply today to connect with a recruiter!
  
  
Founded in 1986, OnTrac has evolved into the leading provider of same-day and next-day delivery services in the U.S. for premier e-commerce and product-supply businesses, including five of the largest retailers in the U.S.
  
  
**Location:** Remote - This position may be performed remotely in states where the company is authorized to employ individuals.
  
**Compensation:** The expected starting base pay range for this position is $84,000 - $105,000, with full potential base salary range over a successful candidate’s tenure in the position of $84,000 - $126,000. Actual compensation will be determined based on experience, skills, internal equity, and other job-related factors.
  
  
**Employment Logistics:**  
The Senior Specialist, Operations Business Intelligence leads the development of clear, trustworthy reporting and visualizations for the Operations organization. This role owns how field performance is measured and communicated, from frontline operators to the executive team, as well as externally to customers. You will partner closely with Operations, Quality, Loss Prevention, Customer Experience, Product, Engineering, and Data Analytics teams to identify what is happening, understand why it is happening, and determine what actions should follow. Success requires strong analytical judgment, independent ownership, reliable reporting foundations, and clear data storytelling in a fast-paced, evolving environment.
  
  
**Unpacking the Benefits:**  
Employees are eligible for a comprehensive benefits package which may include:
  
  

* Medical, dental, and vision insurance
* Life and short- and long-term disability coverage
* 401(k) retirement savings plan with company match
* Flex vacation in states other than CA, CO, IL, MA, MT, and NE, with accruals up to 96 hours for first year of employment with tenure-based increases up to 160 hours
* Two (2) floating holidays per year
* Paid sick leave\*
* Six (6) paid company holidays
* Two (2) weeks paid pregnancy disability leave, four (4) weeks paid parental bonding leave
* Additional wellness and employee assistance programs

Benefits eligibility and offerings are subject to the terms and conditions of the applicable plans and company policies.
  
  
**The Must-Haves:**  

* 5+ years of experience in analytics, business intelligence, or operations analysis within warehouse fulfillment, logistics, supply chain, e-commerce, or a similar environment
* Expert-level ability to build insights-driven dashboards in Power BI or similar BI tools using large, complex datasets
* Strong experience with data modeling and KPI design
* Strong SQL skills, including the ability to extract, validate, and interpret operational data
* Strong stakeholder management skills, including the ability to influence Operations leaders and communicate across business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Product teams through clear analysis and storytelling
* Familiarity with warehouse systems and operational event data, including WMS scan events, exception codes, labor tracking, and station performance
* Experience supporting multi-site performance reviews and standardizing KPIs across a network
* ​​It is the responsibility of every position to understand and adhere to the security guidelines outlined in OnTrac’s Acceptable Use policy and to conduct their activities accordingly.​

**Your Mission in Motion:**  
A summary of key responsibilities for the role is outlined below. Additional duties may be assigned as needed to support business objectives.
  

* Dashboard development & reporting ownership: Build, maintain, and monitor standardized, user-friendly Power BI dashboards and reports across sites and functions, using clear definitions and consistent reporting logic.
* KPI design & operational insights: Translate operational goals into actionable KPIs and visualizations that support decision-making at both the site and network levels.
* Data visibility & cross-functional partnership: Partner with cross-functional teams to identify, scope, and address gaps in data visibility.
* Data requirements & business alignment: Work with Product and Engineering teams to ensure the organization collects the data required to support business objectives.
* Data pipeline partnership & optimization: Collaborate with Data Engineering and Analytics teams to design, optimize, and maintain data pipelines that support data availability, accuracy, and efficiency.
* Reporting governance & trusted metrics: Establish reporting best practices through standardized metric definitions, documentation, and governance, creating a trusted single source of truth.

**Paving your way to your success:**  

* You bring a passion for data and its ability to create meaningful business value.
* You are highly curious and eager to investigate complex operational problems.
* You are self-driven, proactive, and comfortable operating with ownership and ambiguity.
* You influence Operations leaders and communicate effectively across business stakeholders, Data Engineering, and Product teams through clear analysis and storytelling.
* You stay close to the business, build high-trust reporting, and use data to drive real-world operational improvements.

**Posting Timeline:**  
This job posting is anticipated to remain open for at least 15 days from the date of posting
  
  
**Disclosures:**  

* Washington state employees are eligible for up to 56 hours of paid sick leave annually.

The salary range above represents the national range for this position. The salary range may be inclusive of several career levels at OnTrac, and the actual base salary offered may vary depending on several factors including, but not limited to: Geographic location, candidate experience and qualifications, job-related skills and competencies, market alignment, and financial considerations.
  
  
Compensation decisions are made based on the specific circumstances of each hire to ensure fair and competitive pay.
  
  
**ADA Statement:**  
We are committed to providing equal employment opportunities to all qualified individuals. If you require reasonable accommodation to participate in the application or interview process, perform essential job functions, or access other employment benefits, please contact Human Resources.
  
  
If you are excited to be part of our team and grow with our OnTrac family, we invite you to apply!
  
  
OnTrac is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer
  
Lasership, Inc. dba OnTrac Final Mile with its affiliates, including OnTrac Logistics, Inc. (collectively, "OnTrac" or the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer. We value diversity and welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, abilities, and experiences. We do not discriminate based on race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, or age. Join us in our commitment to creating a diverse and inclusive workplace. If you are excited to be part of our team and contribute to our talent acquisition efforts, we invite you to apply.

a37f5269e956ae32b588.title: FleetShare Operations Specialist (Memphis, TN)
a37f5269e956ae32b588.description:
As a FleetShare Ambassador, you will play a crucial role in providing onsite support to Merchants FleetShare product clients within your assigned territory. Your primary focus will be on delivering superior customer service and expertise in support of the FleetShare product.

  

**Location: Based in or near Memphis, TN**

**Salary: $70,000**

  

**Key responsibilities include:**

* Serve as the primary contact for FleetShare locations in your territory, conducting site visits as necessary.
* Act as a subject matter expert within FleetShare, sharing consultative information with clients and internal partners.
* Facilitate documentation for new or renewing FleetShare users.
* Conduct inspections for new vehicles entering the program.
* Manage rental-related inquiries, including repairs, billing, registration, and FleetShare technology access.
* Build and maintain relationships with key onsite contacts within client operations.
* Manage usage in the defined territory to increase utilization and income.
* Facilitate maintenance, repairs, inspections, registrations, and related needs of FleetShare vehicles.
* Provide KPI reporting for the assigned territory internally and externally as required.
* Coordinate vehicle movements and material shipments within the territory.
* Handle billing for charges incurred within the assigned territory.
* Collaborate with cross-departmental teams within Operational and Technical departments.
* Troubleshoot product technology onsite as needed.
* Take on additional projects as assigned.
* Use of personal vehicle is required with travel reimbursement.
* Travel as necessary to current and future FleetShare locations within the territory of **Memphis, TN.**

**Experience:**

* Proven experience in managing deadlines and providing feedback on trends and customer challenges.
* Must hold a valid U.S. driver's license and an acceptable driving record at time of hire.
* Must continue to keep a satisfactory driving record, as determined by Merchants, and remain eligible to be insured by the company's vehicle insurance carrier. Employee must cooperate in completing any required authorizations or paperwork for regular motor vehicle checks.

**Skills:**

* Excellent customer service, communication, and listening skills.
* Aptitude to learn FleetShare fleet management system (Agile/TSD), CRM (Salesforce), and LeaseWave.
* Strong Microsoft Office Suite skills; ability to learn and utilize company software.
* Effective time management and organizational skills.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving ability.
* Exceptional verbal, written, presentation, project management, and interpersonal skills.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively as part of a team.
* Familiarity with telematics software is a plus.
* Must be comfortable working on your feet for extended periods throughout the shift.
* Work is primarily conducted outdoors in varying weather conditions, including heat, cold, rain, or wind.
* Frequent bending, kneeling, and reaching to complete tasks.

**Education:**

* Bachelor's degree preferred.

  

**The Company**

You're invigorated by team collaboration and a fast-paced work environment. Opportunities for growth motivate you to always bring your A-game. You're tired of being told "no" when you think of ways to improve, innovate, and do things better.

There's a place for people like you. Welcome to Merchants Fleet.

We've been around for more than 60 years, but we're the fastest growing fleet management company in North America. The fleet industry is behind every delivered package, the summertime memories kids make on their way to camp, and the heavy-duty trucks and vans that keep the lights on. That's a lot of responsibility, and why we want our employees to always be at their best.

Everything at Merchants Fleet is fueled by our entrepreneurial spirit, including:

* Leadership who truly lead and engage with employees
* Real career paths and the tools you need to grow and develop
* A work environment that's encouraging and collaborative

We know employees won't stay if they're not happy, which is why we provide a great benefits package on top of our award-winning work environment. ee2d6e5c07be809cb528.title: CAT Outside Claims Specialist
ee2d6e5c07be809cb528.description:
You have a clear vision of where your career can go. And we have the leadership to help you get there. At CNA, we strive to create a culture in which people know they matter and are part of something important, ensuring the abilities of all employees are used to their fullest potential.

This individual contributor role operates under technical direction and within defined authority limits to manage commercial property/casualty claims of low to moderate complexity and exposure. The position involves field-based investigations and coordination, including reviewing coverage, determining liability and compensability, securing relevant information, arranging property damage appraisals, and negotiating settlements. Responsibilities are carried out in accordance with company protocols, quality standards, and customer service expectations. Regular communication with insureds, customers, and internal partners is required, and the role may be dedicated to specific account(s).

**JOB DESCRIPTION:**

**Essential Duties & Responsibilities:**

Performs a combination of duties in accordance with departmental guidelines:

* Manages an inventory of commercial property claims with low to moderate complexity and exposure (typically up to $50,000), including field-based losses.

* Conducts on-site investigations and inspections of loss locations; prepares estimates, diagrams, uploads photos, and completes inspection reports using company systems and guidelines.

* Verifies policy coverage and establishes timely and adequate reserves by reviewing and interpreting policy language and estimating potential claim valuation.

* Exercises judgment to determine liability and compensability by gathering pertinent information, taking recorded statements, and collaborating with experts.

* Coordinates with insureds, claimants, witnesses, business partners, and vendors to evaluate claims and identify early resolution opportunities.

* Authorizes and ensures claim disbursements within authority limits by negotiating settlements and escalating to management when appropriate.

* Contributes to customer satisfaction by interacting professionally and effectively with all stakeholders, providing timely updates, and responding promptly to inquiries.

* Collaborates with internal and external partners—including attorneys, account representatives, agents, underwriters, and experts—to facilitate best claim outcomes.

* Identifies and refers subrogation, salvage, and potential fraud opportunities to appropriate internal units (Recovery, SIU).

* Accurately inputs and maintains claim data to reflect circumstances and support business outcomes.

* Maintains compliance with state/local regulatory requirements and stays current on commercial insurance laws, regulations, and industry trends.

* Achieves quality and cycle time standards by following company guidelines, ensuring proper documentation, and issuing appropriate claim disbursements.

*May perform additional duties as assigned*

  
  

**Skills, Knowledge & Abilities**

* Solid knowledge of claims and insurance industry theory, products, and practices.

* Demonstrated technical expertise and product-specific knowledge.

* Developing foundational understanding of commercial insurance and claims processes.

* Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to demonstrate empathy and deliver exceptional customer service.

* Effective interpersonal and negotiation skills; able to interact professionally with all levels of internal and external business partners.

* Ability to build and maintain collaborative relationships across departments and with external stakeholders.

* Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with critical thinking and the ability to develop viable alternative solutions.

* Capable of exercising independent judgment and making sound business decisions, including cost-benefit evaluations.

* Proven ability to manage time and resources independently, handling multiple priorities in a fast-paced, team-oriented environment.

* High level of productivity with strong organizational and time management skills.

* Proficient in Microsoft Office Suite and able to quickly learn and adapt to business-related software systems.

* Flexible and adaptable to changing environments, processes, and priorities.

* Values diverse perspectives and fosters inclusive decision-making.

* Ability to handle claims with a proactive, long-term view aligned with business goals and objectives.

* Willingness and ability to travel 50–75% of the time to visit loss sites and perform field inspections.

* Available for Catastrophe (CAT) deployment, including travel on short notice for extended periods.

* Must have and maintain a valid driver’s license.

* Must be able to obtain and maintain proper licensing as required.

  
  

**Education and Experience**

* Bachelor's degree or equivalent experience. Professional designations preferred.

* Typically a minimum one to three years claims experience.

At Commure, we're building the AI Operating System for healthcare, the foundation that defines how care is delivered, documented, and financed. * Exceptional attention to detail and organizational skills

6d6fbb238b694122057a.title: Remote Credentialing Coordinator
6d6fbb238b694122057a.description:
**We are looking for an excellent Dental Credentialing Coordinator to join our practice!**
==========================================================================================

**Job Type:**

Full-time: Mon-Fri 8:00 AM - 5:00 PM

Hourly Rate: $19.00 - $25.00 DOE

Location: Remote/Hybrid

Picture yourself working in a fun, rapidly growing pediatric dental office, where a unique experience is guaranteed daily. Since launching Children's Dental FunZone in 2002, our mission has been simple: We treat your kids as our own. After 23 years, we still uphold our core values of Integrity, Excellent Customer Service, Accountability, and Teamwork. These values not only guide how we care for our patients but also how we support our employees.

**Position Summary**

The Credentialing Coordinator keeps every provider and clinical team member across our pediatric dental offices fully licensed, permitted, and enrolled with payers so they can see patients and the practice can bill. The role owns initial credentialing, re-credentialing, Denti-Cal and Commercial Plan enrollment, and expiration tracking.

The role works closely with provider recruiting, payroll, office managers, and billing to make sure no provider starts seeing patients before they are cleared.

**Provider credentialing and payer enrollment**

* Complete initial credentialing for new dentists, pediatric dentists, and specialists: collect and verify licenses, DEA registration, NPI, education, board certification, malpractice coverage, work history, and references.
* Prepare and submit Medi-Cal Dental provider applications, rendering-provider additions, and service-office updates for each professional corporation and location.
* Enroll providers with contracted dental plans (PPO, HMO and Medi-Cal), and track each application through approval and effective date.
* Manage re-credentialing and revalidation cycles so no provider lapses with any payer.
* Notify recruiting, scheduling, office managers, and billing when a provider is cleared to see patients under each plan.

**License, permit, and certification tracking**

* Maintain a tracking system for expiration dates on all licenses, permits, and certifications, including DDS/DMD licenses, DEA registrations, Dental Board sedation and anesthesia permits, RDA and RDH licenses, radiation safety, coronal polish, pit-and-fissure sealant, BLS/CPR, and malpractice coverage.
* Send advance renewal reminders (90, 60, and 30 days) to employees and their managers, and escalate items at risk of lapsing.
* Verify all licenses and permits through primary sources such as the Dental Board of California and Dental Hygiene Board of California.

**Compliance and screening**

* Run and document monthly exclusion checks against the OIG LEIE, SAM.gov, and the Medi-Cal Suspended and Ineligible Provider List.
* Keep complete, audit-ready credentialing files for every provider and clinical employee.
* Support payer audits, site reviews, and internal compliance reviews with timely documentation.
* Protect provider personal information in line with HIPAA and company confidentiality policies.

**Coordination and reporting**

* Partner with provider recruiting on start dates, so credentialing timelines are built into onboarding.
* Coordinate with payroll and HR on entity assignments when providers work across multiple professional corporations.
* Report weekly on open applications, pending approvals, and upcoming expirations by location.
* Respond to payer and provider inquiries, and resolve claim holds tied to enrollment issues with the billing team.
* Perform other related duties as assigned.

**Qualifications**

*Required*

* High school diploma or equivalent.
* 2+ years of credentialing, provider enrollment, or medical/dental office administration experience.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Excel or Google Sheets for tracking and reporting.

*Preferred*

* Dental credentialing experience, especially Medi-Cal Dental enrollment.
* Experience in a DSO, multi-location practice, or multi-entity organization.
* Bilingual English/Spanish.

**Knowledge, Skills, and Abilities**

* Close attention to detail and accuracy in forms, dates, and identifiers.
* Strong organization: able to manage dozens of open applications and deadlines at once.
* Clear written and verbal communication with providers, payers, and office staff.
* Persistence in following up with payers and state agencies until applications close.
* Sound judgment with confidential personal and licensing information.
* Knowledge of California dental licensing categories and Dental Board permit types.
* Ability to work independently and escalate risks early.

***Equal Opportunity and Acknowledgment***

*Children's Dental FunZone / Rodef Dental Group is an equal opportunity employer. We consider all qualified applicants without regard to any characteristic protected by federal, state, or local law, and we consider qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records in accordance with the California Fair Chance Act.*

*This description summarizes the main functions of the role and is not an exhaustive list of duties. It does not create an employment contract, and employment remains at-will.*

Join Children's Dental FunZone, where we are committed to providing comprehensive pediatric dental care and orthodontics for children, toddlers, and teens. Our team is revolutionizing pediatric dental care through a patient-centric approach built on teamwork, flexibility, and a dedication to oral health and compassionate care.

We service our customers through a nationwide network consisting of over 80 locations making over 1 million deliveries annually to homes, job sites, and retail locations. Our team-oriented approach, together with our proprietary technology, enables us to exceed our customers’ expectations.

We are not perfect, but we try to be. We hold ourselves to the highest standards, ensuring every customer is treated with respect and every order is handled as if it were our own.
