AskJoy is hiring a part-time or contract Caregiver Referral Network Lead to build the local network of trusted people who send older adults and their families to AskJoy. You'll start at 10–20 hours a week, on a 3–6 month contract, with a path to a full-time role if the network takes off.

**About AskJoy.** AskJoy protects the money of adults 55+, especially those on a fixed income. It finds and cancels unwanted subscriptions, flags scams and duplicate charges, helps with medical bills and insurance overlaps, and steps in to help recover after a scam. It works over regular text messages, a real person takes over when the AI can't finish, and AskJoy can never move money or make purchases. Adult children can join through Family Hub, and the senior decides what they see.

**Why this role matters.** Older adults don't find help like this in app stores. They hear about it from someone they trust: a care manager, an elder law attorney, their pastor, the Area Agency on Aging, a Medicare counselor. Your job is to earn that trust, one relationship at a time.

What you'll do

* **Map the local network.** Build a target list of the referral sources that matter in [launch metro]: Area Agencies on Aging, geriatric care managers (Aging Life Care Association members), elder law attorneys, State Health Insurance Assistance Program (SHIP) counselors, home care agencies and franchises, faith communities, senior centers, libraries and AARP chapters.
* **Open doors and build relationships.** Meet referral sources in person and by phone. Learn what their clients struggle with, explain how AskJoy helps, and make referring easy.
* **Turn contacts into regular referrers.** Equip each partner with simple materials (a one-page handout, a referral link or code, a short script), then follow up until they send families regularly.
* **Run community sessions.** Lead or coordinate short, practical talks such as scam-awareness workshops, Medicare bill clinics and "help your parent with subscriptions" sessions for adult children at senior centers, churches, libraries and retirement communities.
* **Track everything.** Keep the referral pipeline current: who you met, what stage they're at, how many signups they've sent. Report weekly on what's working.
* **Bring back what you hear.** Share caregiver and partner feedback with the founder so it shapes the product, the pricing and the materials.
* **Flag bigger opportunities.** When a credit union, senior living community or health plan contact shows interest in paying for AskJoy for their members, hand it to the founder or the partnerships lead.

**Qualifications**

* 3+ years building referral relationships in aging services, for example as a hospice or home health community liaison, a home care business development rep, a senior living community relations director, or a geriatric care or social work role with outreach duties.
* An existing network among care managers, discharge planners, elder law attorneys, Area Agency on Aging staff or faith communities.
* A track record of turning one-time contacts into steady referral sources, with numbers you can share.
* Comfort presenting to small groups of older adults and their families, in plain language and with patience.
* The discipline to work independently, keep a pipeline current and report honestly on what isn't working.
* A car and willingness to travel locally several days a week.
* Comfortable using Google Suite, Slack and CRM.

**Nice to have:**

* Experience with Medicare, insurance or billing questions, or with elder fraud and financial exploitation cases.
* Ties to credit unions, senior centers or local AARP chapters.
* Spanish, Mandarin, Vietnamese or another language spoken by older adults in [launch metro].

* A car and willingness to travel locally several days a week.

Visit askjoynow.com to learn more about the company.

241320f7281766646ad5.description:
**Company Description**

Eurofins Scientific is an international life sciences company, providing a unique range of analytical testing services to clients across multiple industries, to make life and our environment safer, healthier and more sustainable. From the food you eat, to the water you drink, to the medicines you rely on, Eurofins works with the biggest companies in the world to ensure the products they supply are safe, their ingredients are authentic and labelling is accurate. Eurofins believes it is a global leader in food, environmental, pharmaceutical and cosmetics products testing and in agroscience CRO services. It is also one of the global independent market leaders in certain testing and laboratory services for genomics, discovery pharmacology, forensics, CDMO, advanced material sciences and in the support of clinical studies.

In over just 30 years, Eurofins has grown from one laboratory in Nantes, France to over 47,000 staff across a network of more than 900 independent companies in over 50 countries and operating more than 800 laboratories. Eurofins offers a portfolio of over 200,000 analytical methods to evaluate the safety, identity, composition, authenticity, origin, traceability and purity of biological substances and products, as well as providing innovative clinical diagnostic testing services, as one of the leading global emerging players in specialised clinical diagnostics testing.

In 2019, Eurofins generated total revenues of EUR € 4.56 billion, and has been among the best performing stocks in Europe over the past 20 years.

 **Job Description**

Key Responsibilities

Business Leadership & Strategy

* Lead all business unit activities to achieve revenue, profitability, and operational performance objectives.
* Develop and execute annual business plans aligned with company growth strategies.
* Manage the laboratory's P&L, budgets, forecasting, and financial performance.
* Identify market opportunities, competitive trends, and customer needs to support strategic growth initiatives.
* Establish and monitor KPIs related to revenue, profitability, turnaround time, quality, productivity, and customer satisfaction.

Commercial & Client Development

* Partner with sales and business development teams to grow market share and increase revenue.
* Maintain strong relationships with key clients, consultants, industrial hygiene firms, environmental contractors, engineering firms, and regulatory stakeholders.
* Participate in customer visits, industry events, and strategic account reviews.
* Support pricing strategies, contract negotiations, and business development initiatives.
* Actively identify opportunities for service expansion, cross-selling, and new market entry.

Laboratory Operations

* Direct daily laboratory operations to ensure efficient workflow, quality delivery, and customer responsiveness.
* Drive continuous improvement initiatives focused on productivity, cost management, quality, and turnaround time.
* Ensure staffing levels, training programs, and resource allocation support business growth and operational objectives.
* Lead performance management, succession planning, and employee development efforts.
* Promote a culture of accountability, operational excellence, collaboration, and safety.

Quality & Regulatory Compliance

* Ensure compliance with all applicable regulatory, accreditation, and quality system requirements.
* Support adherence to ISO 17025 standards and other relevant federal, state, and industry regulations.
* Partner with technical and quality teams to drive audit readiness and continuous quality improvement.
* Ensure laboratory operations meet client expectations and applicable service-level agreements.

People Leadership

* Lead, mentor, and develop managers, supervisors, and staff.
* Foster employee engagement through effective communication, coaching, and recognition.
* Build a high-performance culture focused on collaboration, customer service, quality, and innovation.
* Recruit and retain top talent to support current and future business objectives.

 **Qualifications**

Required

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Chemistry, Environmental Science, Biology, Industrial Hygiene, Engineering, or related discipline.
* Minimum of 7-10 years of progressive leadership experience within laboratory testing, environmental services, industrial hygiene, analytical testing, or a related technical services industry.
* Demonstrated experience managing business operations and financial performance, including P&L responsibility.
* Proven commercial experience with revenue growth, client management, business development, or sales leadership.
* Strong leadership and team development skills.
* Experience managing operational KPIs, budgets, forecasting, and continuous improvement initiatives.
* Excellent communication, negotiation, and relationship management skills.

Preferred

* Experience within Built Environment testing, asbestos analysis, microbiology, industrial hygiene, indoor air quality, environmental laboratory testing, or related laboratory services.
* Existing industry network within environmental consulting, industrial hygiene, engineering, remediation, or testing services sectors.
* Experience managing ISO 17025 accredited laboratories.
* MBA or advanced degree.
* Lean, Six Sigma, or other operational excellence certifications.

Success Profile

The successful candidate will be:

* A proven business leader with both operational and commercial expertise.
* Capable of driving profitable growth while maintaining exceptional quality and client service.
* Experienced in laboratory environments serving environmental, industrial hygiene, or built environment markets.
* Comfortable leading change, improving processes, and scaling operations.
* Customer-focused, financially savvy, and highly accountable for results.

  
**Additional Information**

EVOLUTION:  
  
In a fast growing group, successful leaders are frequently being offered increased areas of responsibility (subject to geographic mobility).  
  
Eurofins offers international opportunities to strong performers.

**Job Summary:**

**Job Description:**

**Who We Are**

Trapeze Software Inc is part of Modaxo’s transit portfolio, and an operating group of Constellation Software Inc. We design and deploy best-in class technologies like enterprise asset management, workforce management, mobility solutions, and more for public transportation agencies. Our technology helps our customers find new ways to increase ridership, improve passenger experience, and achieve operational excellence. We will provide you with the resources, responsibilities, guidance, and freedom needed to be successful. Building strong and long-lasting relationships are a vital component to working with us. Join our team and be on the way to a rewarding and fulfilling career!

**What we are looking for**

We are looking for a self-motivated and results oriented General Manager to direct and manage one of our business units mainly serving the North American market. This role is accountable for leading a team of leaders to deliver sustainable growth and profitability for the business unit. The successful candidate will possess abilities and experience to fulfil duties that include allocating budget resources, coordinating business operations, managing operational costs, ensuring the business provides exceptional customer service, identifying business opportunities, and monitoring financial activities. * Development and Implementation of a clear strategic plan, P&L ownership, and accountability, and operational performance of a Trapeze business unit
* Ensuring forecasts of business results are realistic and achievable.
* Overseeing support of existing clients, ensuring their utilization of deployed solutions is maximized, and that customer engagement is exemplary, as measured by customer satisfaction levels and back to base sales.

  + Working with the leadership team, prepare and execute a detailed plan that will lead to an organic growth CAGR of 10% over the next 5 years
  + Assess the future of the business and make investment recommendations supported by a strategic business plan and financial output Ensure customer implementations are closely managed to achieve on-time deliverables and gross margins in excess of 40%

  + Support the development of a healthy internal culture that retains key employees and encourages professional growth and development

* Provide strategic advisement to the Group Leader and keep leadership team aware of developments within the industry and region
* Prepare and implement comprehensive business plans to facilitate achievement of cost-effective operations and market development activities
* Ensure company policies and legal guidelines are communicated effectively and are followed.
* Oversee and manage business operations and resources of the business unit while ensuring compliance with:
  + Design and direction of technology products and solutions

* 5 to 10 years of experience in executive management role

* Thorough knowledge of market, market changes and forces that influence company performance

7fbbd39a89644c43865d.title: Senior Paid Media Manager (Remote) (copy)
7fbbd39a89644c43865d.description:
Silverback Strategies is a performance marketing agency built to help marketers grow and capitalize on change. Ad Age, Inc Magazine, The Washington Post, The Washingtonian, and The Washington Business Journal have recognized Silverback as one of the best places to work.

We hire the best and help them get better. Silverbackers are supported, challenged and inspired by their peers. Regardless of title or tenure, every Silverbacker plays a role in helping our agency get better. This is a place where you can make a difference.

Job Highlights:

* Role: Senior Paid Media Manager
* Department: Paid Media
* Salary Band: $90,000 - $115,000
* Location: Remote (U.S.)
* Position Status: Actively hiring for this role
* Application Deadline: We review applications on a rolling basis, so there’s no cutoff date. If this job sounds like you, go for it.

Today, we’re ready to add another **Senior Paid Media Manager** to our team. Our new Senior Paid Media Manager will serve as a premier subject matter expert in all things related to Paid Media. You will act as a true paid channel expert, developing and managing a portfolio of Paid Media accounts and marketing campaigns, building great relationships, managing projects and deliverables, and growing accounts.

  

You’ll work on a team of other Paid Media Specialists and Managers, but as the Sr. Manager, will be expected to go “above and beyond” to exemplify excellence in your work & contribute to internal initiatives like developing media best practices, disseminating industry updates, and enhancing Silverback’s overall media product. You’ll serve as a role model and mentor to your peers, and in some cases, will even directly manage 1-2 junior teammates.

  

The Senior Paid Media Manager is expected to work cross-functionally, finding opportunities to enhance our clients' overall digital programs through Paid initiatives and complementary strategies with other services. You'll collaborate internally with teammates in Creative, Measurement, SEO, and Client Services functions. You’ll be the true face of Paid Media for your assigned clients, and will spearhead the kickoff, development, tactical execution, and ongoing testing, optimization, and overall success of your clients’ media strategies & performance.

  

Here’s what we expect from our Senior Paid Media Manager.

### **—What You'll Do—**

* Responsible for driving the strategy, innovation, and performance of multiple client Paid Media strategies
* Fully “own” the success of a portfolio of a few (3-5) client accounts
* Plan, implement, and audit paid media campaigns & strategies that align with client KPIs and marketing goals
* Successfully plan & execute campaigns in both Search and Social paid media platforms (Google, Meta, LinkedIn, TikTok)
* Pioneer testing and deployment of “outside the box” media channels & tools
* Collaborate closely with internal teammates in our Creative and Measurement teams to drive successful creative strategy/performance & analytics measurement, tag management, etc
* Collaborate cross-functionally whenever appropriate (i.e. on multiservice clients) with counterparts in SEO to drive successful cross-channel marketing strategy for clients
* Regularly create, analyze, and present insightful and actionable Paid Media performance reports directly to clients
* Leverage various tools to carry out analysis and to maximize efficiency and effectiveness of Paid Media accounts
* Serve as the lead point of contact for all things Paid Media for your “owned” clients; lead biweekly and ad hoc client calls to build & maintain strong client relationships
* Successfully retain & even grow your assigned client portfolio through best-in-class communication, storytelling, presentation, and relationship building
* Accurately communicate project timelines to clients; manage client expectations and proactively update clients as things change
* Understand the client’s industry, audience and goals and stay on top of industry changes, trends, and best practices
* Play a close role in sales enablement, including but not limited to identifying upsell/cross-sell opportunities and contributing to sales pitches, client onboardings/kickoffs, etc
* Effectively delegate support tasks as appropriate to junior teammates; manage quality assurance for teammates’ work & ensure clients are receiving high-quality deliverables 100% of the time
* In some cases, directly manage (i.e. act as the dedicated people manager) for 1-2 Paid Media teammates (Managers, Specialists, or Associates)
* Contribute to the overall success of the Media department through proactive involvement in product development, process improvement, and direct collaboration with the Associate Directors and Senior Director of Paid Media

### **—What We’re Looking For—**

* 5+ years of experience (minimum) managing Paid Search AND Social campaigns. (Main platforms are Google, Meta, LinkedIn, and TikTok)
* Previous agency experience is a must-have!
* Experience serving as the main point of contact on client engagements (at least 3+ years of client-facing experience); strong comfortability being client-facing
* Strong experience driving/leading paid media account strategy
* Strong testing & innovation mentality
* Experience collaborating with Creative resources and contributing to creative briefs + driving paid social performance creative
* Advanced proficiency with Google Analytics 4 and Google Sheets/Excel
* Experience with Google Tag Manager and Supermetrics is a plus!
* Strong analytical skills, technical knowledge and attention to detail
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills
* Eagerness to deliver under tight deadlines
* Genuine curiosity that will guide the research to inform your technical work
* Outstanding time management and organization skills
* The ability to accept constructive criticism in a professional manner and to learn from edits
* Comfort with constant personal and professional growth

### **—Why Silverback?—**

Silverback isn’t for everybody. If you’re an A player, you will get paid more, learn more and grow faster with support from a smart and fun team. If you’re a B player, you will be miserable.

* Work with the A team: We are ruthless about putting the best possible team on the field.
* Make an impact: We’re a small agency. Everybody has the opportunity to drive change and impact.
* Get paid: We hire the best and pay them generously.
* Do cool sh\*t: From media to SEO to measurement, learn the cutting edge of what works.

### **—Benefits & Perks—**

Great work deserves great support. That’s why we offer a competitive total compensation package, with benefits built around how our people actually live and work.

* Fully remote team
* Unlimited PTO & Summer Fridays
* Comprehensive health, dental, and vision plans
* Paid Parental Leave: 12 weeks for primary caregivers, 6 weeks for non-primary caregivers
* Life and short term disability insurance, on us
* 401(k) with employer match
* Company-paid ClassPass membership
* Monthly Team Events that bring our remote team together

### **—Work Environment—**

* We're a fully remote agency with employees working across the U.S., and our culture is built for it. At Silverback, you'll be part of a remote work culture that emphasizes smooth, productive online communication so work moves forward and no one is left guessing.
* We pride ourselves on being an extremely tight-knit team. We boast an unparalleled culture of collaboration, empathy, and a truly “work hard, play hard” mentality.
* Ad Age, Inc. Magazine and The Washington Post have named Silverback one of the best places to work in the Country and our CEO is a DIGIDAY Top Boss.

Think this sounds like your kind of team? Apply today. We can't wait to hear from you!

*Silverback Strategies is an equal opportunity employer. If you believe you meet the qualifications for the position, then we invite you to apply. We celebrate the free flow of conversation, ideas and opinions at Silverback, but actions such as bullying, discrimination, harassment or retaliation of any kind are strictly prohibited in our workplace. We are committed to providing a safe, open and accommodating environment that allows all of our team members to thrive. Employment decisions are made without regard to age, color, disability, family, genetic information, origin, race, religion, sex. For more information, we invite you to visit* *eeoc.gov**.*

We may use artificial intelligence (AI) tools to support parts of the hiring process, such as reviewing applications, analyzing resumes, or assessing responses and identifying potential inconsistencies or verification signals in application materials based on available information. These tools assist our recruitment team but do not replace human judgment. Final hiring decisions are ultimately made by humans. If you would like more information about how your data is processed, please contact us.

* Understanding of ACLs, UI Policies, and Business Rules
* Ability to analyze requirements, troubleshoot issues, and develop effective solutions
* Ability to identify, understand, document, and create functionality aligning with customer value streams
* Organizational and time management skills while working in a rapid software development environment
* Ability to identify and learn new technologies quickly

**DESIRED QUALIFICATIONS AND EXPERIENCE:**

* Experience with ServiceNow Automated Testing Framework
* Excellent organizational and time management skills; ability to manage frequently changing priorities of competing importance.
* Ability to communicate and interact effectively with internal/external teams including key stakeholders and customers.
* Ability to produce high-quality documentation that contributes to the overall success of our program.

**GDIT IS YOUR PLACE:**

24d763f51378e2e72214.description:
Deloitte is defining the digital landscape. We are pioneering a new model for a new digital world. Do you like to challenge the status quo? Does curiosity feed your soul? Are you addicted to the thrill of creating? Do you want to be your authentic self at work? Then consider a career within our Software Defined Products practice. Creative design, state-of-the-art technology, and your imagination merge here to create lasting impact for our clients. Not to mention make for a pretty fun and meaningful career!  
  
**The team**  
  
Our team helps clients transform their value chains into competitive advantages. We drive efficiency, improve flexibility, and increase responsiveness through proactive insights and decision-making. We advise, implement, and operate transformational solutions that bring world-class supply network and operational capabilities to our clients. We provide operational know-how, digital technologies, advanced analytics, and industry-specific hybrid solutions to deliver unprecedented client value. Additionally, we improve operations, product, and material flow across the breadth of the value chain and create greater supply network synergy.  
  
**Work you'll do**  
  
Lead AI-enabled supply planning transformations for clients across industries. As a Senior Manager, you'll own senior client relationships, shape and sell engagements, lead delivery teams, and manage engagement economics, helping clients redesign how they plan and decide across the end-to-end supply chain. Each project offers the chance to grow, but the work typically includes:
  

* **Setting the vision.** Work with senior supply chain leaders to define the AI-enabled planning vision, value case, operating model, and transformation program roadmap
* **Guiding technology choices.** Advise clients on where optimization and AI create the most value in planning, and help them select the right vendor-package or custom solutions
* **Redesigning planning workflows.** Blend optimization engines, AI, and planner judgment into processes with clear governance, decision rights, and change management
* **Leading delivery end to end.** Direct design, deployment, and handover of planning solutions tied to measurable outcomes such as service, cost, inventory, and planner productivity
* **Delivering with AI-enabled tools.** Use GenAI and agentic tools to accelerate how our teams design and deliver, and set the standard for responsible use
* **Shaping and sell engagements.** Build relationships with decision makers, lead pursuit teams, and drive proposals, including approach, pricing, and risk
* **Owning engagement performance.** Manage planning, budgets, risks, quality, and executive communications through to on-time delivery
* **Developing people and the practice.** Lead Managers and teams, mentor and coach practitioners, and contribute to Deloitte methodologies, points of view, and thought leadership

  
  
**Required qualifications**  
  

* 12+ years of professional experience working in a Supply Chain Management organization

  

* 8+ years of relevant Supply Planning experience with some years working in a Consulting environment

  

* Demonstrated experience leading project teams and working with cross-functional / extended teams in a complex environment

  

* Demonstrated experience managing complex, multi-thread programs including scope definition, objective prioritization, risk management, and issue resolution

  

* Experience using analytics and metrics to assess supply chain performance and identify and quantify improvement opportunities

  

* Bachelor's Degree

  

* Ability to travel up to 50%, on average, based on the work you do and the clients and industries/sectors you serve

  

* Must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for employer sponsorship, now or at any time in the future

  
**Preferred qualifications**  
  

* Experience with supply planning transformations in more than one industry (e.g. Life Sciences, Retail and Consumer, Transportation)

  

* Deep understanding of the technology elements of supply planning platform implementations, as well as the business process it supports

  

* Deep understanding of data models, ontologies and taxonomies related to industries and supply planning technology platforms

  

* Experience (direct or adjacent) with ERP systems (e.g., SAP, Oracle, D365), Order Management Systems, Demand Planning, Allocation & Replenishment / Inventory Planning

  

* Experience (direct or adjacent) with data and integration technologies and platforms (e.g., Azure Data Platform, Snowflake, Delta Share, APIs, SQL Server)

  
-  
  
The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Deloitte, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $171,800-$338,300.  
  
You may also be eligible to participate in a discretionary annual incentive program, subject to the rules governing the program, whereby an award, if any, depends on various factors, including, without limitation, individual and organizational performance.  
  
Information for applicants with a need for accommodation: https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/careers/articles/join-deloitte-assistance-for-disabled-applicants.html

409ce6ebe012f259f216.description:
**Your Journey at Crowe Starts Here:**

At Crowe, you can build a meaningful and rewarding career. With real flexibility to balance work with life moments, you’re trusted to deliver results and make an impact. We embrace you for who you are, care for your well-being, and nurture your career. Everyone has equitable access to opportunities for career growth and leadership. Over our 80-year history, delivering excellent service through innovation has been a core part of our DNA across our audit, tax, and consulting groups. That’s why we continuously invest in innovative ideas, such as AI-enabled insights and technology-powered solutions, to enhance our services. Join us at Crowe and embark on a career where you can help shape the future of our industry.

**Job Description:**

**What It Means to Be a Consultant at Crowe** 
**Consulting is a dynamic business focused on solving problems for our clients and serving our core markets through innovative solutions. As technology and AI continue to reshape the consulting landscape, we are looking for individuals who are curious, adaptable, and eager to learn. At Crowe, consultants are expected to build both technical and transferable skills, think critically, and use technology to solve real business problems. In this role, you will continuously learn, collaborate across teams, and explore how tools, including emerging AI capabilities, can improve efficiency, insights, and client outcomes.**
---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------

In management at Crowe, you play a pivotal role in leading teams, guiding project execution, and deepening client relationships. You are expected to contribute to account planning, identify opportunities to add value, and ensure high-quality delivery. As your responsibilities expand, you take on broader account ownership, balancing project leadership with growing involvement in client strategy and solution development.

Success in this role comes from a growth mindset, strong communication skills, advanced critical thinking, and the ability to navigate new challenges with confidence

**About The Role**

The California State Controller’s Office (SCO) is currently implementing a large and complex SaaS solution to support the California State Payroll System (CSPS) project. CSPS is a massive project, and the implementation includes both Personnel and Payroll functionality to support the needs of some 300,000 employees across 160 agencies and 21 bargaining units. With an estimated project budget exceeding $1 billion and staffing approaching 200 IT professionals, this highly complex effort is expected to continue for the next several years.

Description

The Project Management Office (PMO) is responsible for supporting all activities of the project including:

* Managing the project schedule and providing visibility to task, deliverable, and milestone completion
* Managing project quality including the review of State and SI deliverables
* Identifying and addressing risks and issues
* Identifying and managing change requests
* Supporting the project manager and project directors with reports and insight needed to make decisions and provide leadership to the project team
* Provide the project workstreams (Functional, Technical, Organizational Change Management, and Production Support) with project management support
* Support internal communications across workstreams
* Assist the CSPS Leadership Team in monitoring system integrator performance

The CSPS PMO is currently staffed by five senior project managers who each work directly with a state and system integrator counterpart. Each PM is also assigned other tasks to work directly with the project workstreams.

Contract Required Qualifications for the Project Manager Role

Requires a minimum of five (5) years of broad, extensive and increasingly responsible experience applying PM principles, methods, techniques, and tools. (Seven years of experience is preferred)

Possession of (a) a bachelor’s degree, and (b) a valid Project Management Professional (PMP) certification from the Project Management Institute (PMI)

* Additional qualifying experience may be substituted for the required education on a year-for-year basis. The PMP certification is required and may not be substituted with additional experience.

Preferred Experience

The following are specific areas of project experience that we are looking for to supplement our PMO team:

* Managing software implementation projects
* undefined
* Implementing HR and/or payroll projects
* undefined
* Working with technical teams including Data Cleanup, Data Conversion, Interfaces, Roles and Security
* undefined
* Managing implementation details including cutover, go-live, and transition to production support

Additional Qualifications

The Project Manager role requires proven project management skills in a highly complex and large-scale IT implementation. The successful candidate will need to work well in a dynamic environment, providing exceptional client service with outstanding professionalism. The role requires direct interaction with client and system integrator staff, as well as:

* Strong analytical, organizational and core project management skills
* Ability to help client personnel to leverage technology to solve business problems
* Strong verbal and written communication skills with a commitment to client service and professionalism
* Possess conceptual thinking skills, creativity and flexibility
* Work well both independently and in a team
* Must be self-sufficient and have the ability to self-manage
* Experienced and comfortable in Microsoft Office applications (Word, Excel, PowerPoint, Visio)
* Ability to learn quickly and adapt with other technology applications in day-to-day work

Other

* Candidates will need to complete and pass a LiveScan background check conducted by SCO prior to beginning work
* Remote work is allowed, but staff must be based in the continental United States. With advance notice, project staff will occasionally need to travel to Sacramento for project meetings.
* Normal working hours are 8:00 AM to 5:00 PM Pacific time. All staff, regardless of location, are required to perform duties within those hours.

We expect the candidate to uphold Crowe’s values of Care, Trust, Courage, and Stewardship. These values define who we are. We expect all of our people to act ethically and with integrity at all times.

In compliance with federal law, all persons hired will be required to verify identity and eligibility to work in the United States and to complete the required employment eligibility verification form upon hire. Crowe is not sponsoring for work authorization at this time.

The wage range for this role takes into account the wide range of factors that are considered in making compensation decisions including but not limited to skill sets; experience and training; licensure and certifications; and other business and organizational needs. The disclosed range estimate has not been adjusted for the applicable geographic differential associated with the location at which the position may be filled. At Crowe, it is not typical for an individual to be hired at or near the top of the range for their role and compensation decisions are dependent on the facts and circumstances of each case. A reasonable estimate of the current range is $100,400.00 - $205,300.00 per year.

**Our Benefits:**  
Your exceptional people experience starts here. At Crowe, we know that great people are what makes a great firm. We care about our people and offer employees a comprehensive total rewards package. Learn more about what working at Crowe can mean for you!

**How You Can Grow:**  
We will nurture your talent in an inclusive culture that values diversity. You will have the chance to meet on a consistent basis with your Career Coach that will guide you in your career goals and aspirations. Learn more about where talent can prosper!  
  
**More about Crowe:**  
Crowe provides professional services through two separate entities: Crowe LLP delivers audit and attest services, and Crowe Advisory LLC provides tax, advisory, consulting, and other nonattest services.

The Crowe Global network consists of more than 300 independent accounting and advisory services firms in more than 150 countries around the globe, making it one of the largest accounting networks in the world\*. As independent members of Crowe Global, Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC serve clients worldwide. (\*As of July 2026)

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) provides equal employment opportunities to all employees and applicants for employment and prohibits discrimination and harassment of any type without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, national origin, disability or protected veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by federal, state or local laws.

Crowe LLP and Crowe Advisory LLC (and their respective subsidiary entities) does not accept unsolicited candidates, referrals or resumes from any staffing agency, recruiting service, sourcing entity or any other third-party paid service at any time. Any referrals, resumes or candidates submitted to Crowe, or any employee or owner of Crowe without a pre-existing agreement signed by both parties covering the submission will be considered the property of Crowe, and free of charge.

  
Crowe will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance, San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, and the California Fair Chance Act.

Please visit our webpage to see notices of the various state and local Ban-the-Box laws and Fair Chance Ordinances, where applicable.

We are committed to a merit-based hiring process, evaluating all candidates consistently using objective, job-related criteria such as relevant experience, demonstrated skills, measurable impact, and alignment with the role’s responsibilities, and making employment decisions in a fair and inclusive manner free from discrimination.

If you are interested in applying for employment with Crowe and are in need of an accommodation or require special assistance to navigate our website or to complete your application, please visit our Applicant Assistance and Accommodations page for more information: https://careers.crowe.com/crowe-applicant-assistance-and-accommodation

338855e688789edfe383.description:
**Overview**

Lead technology projects from planning through delivery, aligning teams, stakeholders, and technical work around clear outcomes. As a Technical Project Manager, you’ll guide software development, enterprise software implementation, and IT infrastructure initiatives using Agile, Waterfall, or hybrid approaches. You’ll coordinate project scope, schedules, risks, and releases while keeping decisions and progress visible.

Your impact: By connecting technical teams with project stakeholders, you’ll help deliver reliable solutions that meet business and user needs.

**Responsibilities**

* Build project plans, schedules, milestones, and status updates using tools such as Jira, Microsoft Project, TFS, VersionOne, and SharePoint.
* Lead cross-functional collaboration, requirements gathering, stakeholder communication, and project implementation.
* Manage risks, dependencies, budgets, change control, release management, and IT governance throughout the software development life cycle (SDLC).
* Coordinate test cases, test-driven development, user acceptance testing, and disaster recovery planning.
* Apply Scrum, Kanban, SAFe (Scaled Agile Framework), PMBOK (Project Management Body of Knowledge), and other project management methodologies as appropriate.

**Experience**

* Project management experience in technology, including IT project management, technical project management, program management, project scheduling, and software implementation.
* Experience leading teams and supervising technical project or program managers; demonstrate leadership, negotiation, communication, time management, organizational, and analysis skills.
* Technical proficiency with enterprise solutions, cloud computing such as AWS (Amazon Web Services), databases including SQL and Oracle, and IT infrastructure.
* Familiarity with Agile planning, project management software, Microsoft Office (including Word and Excel), and Visio.
* Preferred: experience with enterprise solutions implementation, software development, and project management tools; knowledge of Waterfall and Agile practices.

Pay: $65,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* Dental insurance
* Health insurance

Work Location: Remote

6877ecfa277cbe39b1e9.description:
Position Overview:

The Regional Director, Enterprise Imaging Systems (RD,EIS) manages the new business pipeline growth and target attainment for all radiology informatics, healthcare IT, and enterprise MI product activity . He/she collaborates closely with the MI RDMI and works with all other HCUS sales teams to maximize MI product new business growth. This role must consistently demonstrate effective leadership and partnership with all members of the HCUS Sales organization and work effectively with other cross-functional departments in the organization.

Company Overview:

At FUJIFILM Healthcare Americas Corporation, we’re on a mission to innovate for a healthier world, and we need passionate, driven people like you to help us get there. Our cutting-edge healthcare solutions span diagnostic imaging, enterprise imaging, endoscopic and surgical imaging, as well as in-vitro diagnostics.

  

But we don’t stop at healthcare; our Non-Destructive Testing (NDT) team harnesses advanced radiography solutions to keep transportation infrastructure, aerospace, and oil and gas assets safe and running smoothly.

  

Ready to innovate, collaborate, and make a difference? Join us and bring your big ideas to life while working in a dynamic, flexible environment that fuels your creativity and drive.

  

Our headquarters is in Lexington, Massachusetts, an inspiring healthcare research hub in a historic town.

Fujifilm is globally headquartered in Tokyo with over 70,000 employees across four key business segments of healthcare, electronics, business innovation, and imaging. We are guided and united by our Group Purpose of “giving our world more smiles.” Visit: https://www.fujifilm.com/us/en/about/region/careers

Job Description:

**Duties and Responsibilities:**

* Meets and exceeds quarterly bookings and revenue objectives by driving new business sales growth.
* Maintains accurate CRM, forecast and pipeline management.
* Drives new business sales strategy and efforts, working closely with the RDMI team.
* Supports successful new customer transition to RDMI management, maintains customer relationships, and supports highest level of customer satisfaction.
* Works collaboratively with inside sales to develop new MI customer pipeline.
* Maintains an enterprise MI focus, maximizing the scope of new business deals and ensuring balanced MI product target attainment.
* Provide product demonstrations and portfolio presentations for all new business opportunity.
* Works closely with MI marketing to provide feedback on field and market needs for new MI business.
* Works collaboratively with Corporate and Government accounts to support strategic IDN activity.
* Works collaboratively with sales training department and MI marketing on competitive feedback.
* Comply with all applicable U.S. Food and Drug Administration (U.S. FDA) medical device regulatory requirements, applicable ISO 13485 standard requirements and all other applicable laws, regulations, and standards.
* Comply with and pass all requirements for vendor credentialing as part of gaining access to hospitals and facilities to perform assigned job duties

Key Performance Indicators

* Achieve sales quota for area.
* Achieve revenue goals.
* Increase MI market share in coverage area.
* Increase number of new MI customers in coverage area.
* Achieve balanced selling performance across all MI product areas.
* Drive a culture of superior customer experience within organization.
* Participate in corporate activities (e.g., leadership activities, BPR, etc.).
* Align behavior with corporate strategy, along with mission, vision, and values.
* Establish and promote a collaborative team environment.
* Ensure ongoing and transparent communication- up, down, across the organization.
* Adhere to the competencies, as defined for the position.

**Qualifications:**

* BA/BS/MA, with 8+ years of progressive experience in the Healthcare IT / Medical Informatics Sales.
* Extensive experience in software product demonstrations.
* Experience managing or supporting teams in a Healthcare / Medical Imaging / IT organization.
* Broad functional expertise in sales and experience in the areas of sales and marketing, strategic selling and planning, and pricing strategies.
* Proven track record of sales overachievement.
* Ability to work cross-functionally and create business impact.
* Ability to organize and manage multiple priorities and multiple direct reports.
* Ability to problem solve, analyze and resolve at both a strategic and tactical level.
* Strong customer orientation.
* Demonstrated ability to achieve sales performance as an individual and in support of teams.
* Strong communication skills- presentation, written, and oral.
* Must have strong interpersonal skills and a demonstrated ability to communicate with a diverse range of individuals.
* Exercises good judgment.
* Proficient in Microsoft Office, including PowerPoint, Excel, and Word.
* Proficient in the use of SalesForce.com.
* Effective time management skills.
* Ability to anticipate the need for proactive communication and planning at all levels.
* Ability to drive action plans with direct and indirect authority, executing within established timeframes and meeting or exceeding stated deliverables.

The position requires the ability to perform the following physical demands and/or have the listed capabilities:

* Ability to use your hands and fingers to feel and manipulate items, including keyboards, up to 100% of applicable work time.

**Customer Service & Scheduling CoordinatorCali Bros Construction**

Orange County, CA | Hybrid / Mostly Remote  
Flexible Schedule | High Availability Required  
Long-Term Growth & Promotion Opportunities

**About Cali Bros Construction**

Cali Bros Construction is a growing, highly rated residential and commercial construction company serving Southern California.

We take pride in delivering exceptional craftsmanship, outstanding customer service, and a smooth, professional experience for every homeowner we work with.

As our company continues to grow, we’re looking for a reliable, organized, and motivated individual to join our team as a **Customer Service & Scheduling Coordinator**.

This is an excellent opportunity for someone who enjoys communicating with people, staying organized, and being part of a growing company with long-term career potential.

**Position Overview**

Your primary responsibility will be to manage customer communication, coordinate appointments, follow up with existing customers, and help ensure every customer receives excellent service throughout their experience with Cali Bros Construction.

You will serve as an important connection between our customers, project managers, and internal team.

**This is primarily a customer service, scheduling, and follow-up position — not a sales or construction labor position.**

We offer a highly flexible work schedule, but we need someone who is consistently available, responsive, and dependable when customers or team members need assistance.

**Key Responsibilities**

**Customer Communication & Scheduling**

* Answer incoming customer calls, messages, and inquiries professionally.
* Schedule consultations, estimates, appointments, and follow-up meetings.
* Confirm appointments and coordinate scheduling changes.
* Communicate with customers and internal team members to keep appointments organized.
* Ensure customers receive timely responses and accurate information.

**Customer Follow-Ups & Relationship Management**

* Follow up with existing customers regarding appointments, project updates, and service satisfaction.
* Maintain consistent communication with customers throughout their experience.
* Help ensure no customer inquiry, appointment, or important follow-up is overlooked.
* Build positive relationships and provide a professional, friendly customer experience.

**Quality Control & Customer Satisfaction**

* Contact customers to ensure they are satisfied with our service and overall experience.
* Identify customer concerns and communicate them to management.
* Follow up on outstanding issues to help ensure they are properly addressed.
* Assist with collecting customer feedback and coordinating review requests.
* Help maintain the high standards and reputation of Cali Bros Construction.

**Administrative & Team Support**

* Maintain organized customer records, appointment schedules, and follow-up notes.
* Update customer information in company systems.
* Coordinate with project managers and other team members when needed.
* Assist with occasional administrative tasks and day-to-day office coordination.

**Qualifications**

**We’re looking for someone who is:**

* Extremely organized, responsible, and detail-oriented.
* Friendly, professional, and confident communicating with customers.
* Excellent at phone communication and customer service.
* Reliable and responsive throughout the workday.
* Comfortable managing multiple appointments and customer conversations.
* Able to work independently without constant supervision.
* Comfortable using computers, calendars, email, and customer management software.
* A strong communicator with excellent follow-through.
* Motivated to grow professionally and take on additional responsibilities.

**Previous experience in customer service, scheduling, office administration, or construction coordination is a plus, but not required.**

We value attitude, reliability, communication skills, and willingness to learn.

**Work Schedule & Location**

**Flexible Schedule | Mostly Remote**

We believe in flexibility and trust, and we’re looking for someone who can manage their responsibilities independently.

* Flexible daily schedule.
* Work can be performed primarily remotely.
* Must remain consistently reachable and responsive during agreed-upon business hours.
* Must live in Orange County or a nearby area.
* Must be able to attend an in-person team meeting at our Orange County office approximately once per week.
* Zoom meetings may be available when appropriate.
* Occasional additional coordination may be required depending on business needs.

**Important:** While the schedule is flexible, consistent availability, timely communication, and dependability are essential for this position.

**Career Growth & Advancement**

Cali Bros Construction is a growing company, and we’re looking for someone interested in building a long-term professional relationship with our team.

As the company expands, there may be opportunities to take on additional responsibilities and advance into higher-level positions.

Potential future opportunities may include office management, operations coordination, customer relations management, and other leadership roles.

We value dedicated team members and believe in creating opportunities for people who demonstrate initiative, reliability, and strong performance.

**Why Join Cali Bros Construction?**

Join a growing, highly rated construction company.

Enjoy a flexible, primarily remote work environment.

Work with a supportive, professional team.

Build a long-term career with potential advancement opportunities.

Take on a meaningful role that directly impacts customer satisfaction and company success.

**How to Apply**

If you’re organized, dependable, enjoy working with people, and are looking for a flexible position with long-term growth potential, we’d love to hear from you.

**Apply today and tell us why you’d be a great fit for Cali Bros Construction!**

*Cali Bros Construction — Great Work. Real Passion.*

Pay: $20.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Flexible schedule

Work Location: Remote

f15e9ceea73d8f19c62e.description:
Stockton University is ranked among the top public universities in the Northeast with more than 160 undergraduate and graduate programs, as well as continuing education opportunities. Our University, one hour from Philadelphia and two hours from New York City, offers unique learning, living, and working environments throughout southern New Jersey, including the 1,600-acre Galloway campus in the Pinelands National Reserve and Atlantic City campus, located in the University District, just steps from the beach and iconic Atlantic City Boardwalk. Additional locations include Hammonton and Manahawkin.

As a public University, Stockton University provides an environment for excellence to our student body through an interdisciplinary approach to liberal arts, sciences, and professional education. Founded in 1969, our University held its first classes in 1971. Our University’s welcoming and vibrant community makes Stockton a great place to learn, live, and work! Learn more about the many reasons to choose Stockton at www.Stockton.edu. Our Faculty and Staff are committed to supporting Stockton University’s strong student-centered vision and mission.

### **Program Assistant – Office of Graduate and Continuing Studies**

* Galloway, New Jersey

* Office of Graduate and Continuing Studies

* Staff Full-time

* Opening on: Nov 20 2026
* Closing on: Dec 4 2026

**Campus Location:** Main Campus (Galloway)

**Department:** Office of Graduate and Continuing Studies

**Salary Range:** $53,281.63 - $55,690.52

**Salary Information:** Based on NJ Civil Service Commission regulations and is accompanied by an extremely competitive University benefits package

**University Pensions & Benefits Information Webpage**

**Work Hours:**

**Brief Job Overview/Summary**

The Graduate Admissions Specialist for Graduate Student Services provides frontline support to prospective graduate students and coordinates key administrative student support functions within the Office of Graduate and Continuing Studies. This position supports the graduate student lifecycle by assisting with recruitment initiatives, enrollment processes, and new student issue resolution, helping to ensure a seamless and student-centered graduate experience.
  
  
This position also supports graduate faculty and academic programs by adhering to policies, processes, and managing a designated caseload focused on new student administrative support. In collaboration with academic programs and campus partners, this position promotes consistent and efficient graduate administrative processes that support student success from inquiry to enrollment.

**Descriptions of Essential Duties/Responsibilities:**

* Provide frontline support to prospective students from inquiry through enrollment, which includes providing application guidance, enrollment navigation, and assistance with institutional systems, policies, and academic requirements.
* Oversee an assigned portfolio of graduate programs throughout the admissions and enrollment process.
* Provide course enrollment support and troubleshooting in collaboration with the unit personnel, the Registrar's Office and assigned graduate academic programs.
* Provide specific program guidance by reinforcing academic requirements, policies, and progression pathways in collaboration with faculty and program leadership.
* Utilize CRM and/or Slate to support prospective student communications, engagement, and recruitment efforts.
* Coordinate with unit personnel (e.g. Graduate Enrollment Systems and Operations) to ensure accurate incoming student records and support enrollment and operational data tracking.
* Collaborate with faculty and campus partners to support graduate advising and manage a designated caseload, providing guidance on registration, student support, and institutional policies. Implement OGCS policies and operational workflows to ensure consistent practices across graduate programs.
* Support graduate faculty and program leadership with incoming and new student processes, policy interpretation, and coordination of graduate program procedures.
* Collaborate with academic programs and campus partners to align graduate student support services and communication.
* Identify process gaps and support continuous improvement of graduate operations and prospective student support systems.
* Support OGCS programming, with priority given to graduate student recruitment related events and targeted recruitment initiatives.
* Perform other duties as assigned.

**Required Qualifications:**

Applicants must meet one of the following or a combination of both experience and education. Thirty (30) semester hour credits are equal to one (1) year of relevant experience:
  

* Four (4) years of professional position-related experience. OR
* Possession of a bachelor's degree from an accredited college or university. OR
* Possession of an associate's degree; and two (2) years of professional position-related experience.

  
NOTE: "Professional experience" refers to work that is analytical, evaluative, and interpretive; requires a range of basic knowledge of the profession's concepts and practices; and is performed with the authority to act and make accurate and informed decisions.

**Preferred Qualifications:**

* 2 years of experience working in Higher Education
* 2 years of experience working in a Graduate Services and/or Graduate Admissions Office
* Prior experience working in a fast-paced, customer service-driven office environment

18b381d68aea685b851e.title: Appointment Sales Specialist
18b381d68aea685b851e.description:
**Are you a closer who thrives on turning interest into commitment?**  
We’re not hiring a receptionist or a customer service rep. We’re hiring a **phone-based sales professional** who understands that every call is an opportunity to help someone take the next step—and to grow revenue by doing it the right way.

The Role

As our **Appointment Sales Specialist**, you’ll respond to inbound calls/web leads and run outbound follow-up for people who already raised their hand. Your goal is simple:

**Convert qualified leads into scheduled appointments with a paid reservation deposit.**

This is a consultative sales role. You’ll listen, diagnose the real barrier, communicate our value clearly, and handle objections professionally—without being pushy.

What You’ll Do

* **Convert inbound leads:** Turn calls and form submissions into booked appointments.
* **Secure reservation deposits:** Confidently collect deposits over the phone in accordance with our policy to protect show rates.
* **Outbound follow-up:** Re-engage warm leads who didn’t schedule (no cold calling).
* **Handle objections:** Cost, timing, “need to think about it,” spouse approval, fear/uncertainty—your job is to lead the conversation to a decision.
* **Own the pipeline:** Keep CRM notes clean, follow-ups tight, and ensure no lead falls through the cracks.
* **Improve through coaching:** You’ll be recorded/role-played/coached to continuously improve conversion and show rate.

Who You Are

* **A proven closer:** You’re comfortable asking for payment on the phone, and you do it professionally.
* **High empathy + high standards:** You build rapport fast *and* you move the conversation to commitment.
* **Process-driven:** You follow a script, use a CRM correctly, and you don’t “wing it.”
* **Experienced:** 2+ years in phone sales, enrollment, inside sales, or appointment setting (healthcare is a plus).

How We Measure Success

* **Lead-to-appointment conversion rate**
* **Deposit collection rate**
* **Show rate on booked appointments**
* **Speed-to-lead + follow-up completion**
* **Pipeline cleanliness (no stale leads)**

Compensation

* **Base:** $25–$30/hour
* **Remote:** Work from home (quiet environment, reliable internet, headset required)
* **Schedule:** Must be available during **Pacific Time business hours** (specific shifts TBD)

Pay: $25.00 - $30.00 per hour

Benefits:

* Work from home

Application Question(s):

* In your most recent phone sales or appointment-setting role, how many dials did you make per day, how many appointments did you set per week, and what was your show rate? Give real numbers.

Work Location: Remote

8af5691864a8ceb56570.title: Revenue Operations Specialist
8af5691864a8ceb56570.description:
**About The Princeton Review**

The Princeton Review is a leading tutoring, test prep, and college admission services company. Every year, it helps millions of college- and graduate school–bound students achieve their education and career goals through online and in-person courses delivered by a network of more than 4,000 teachers and tutors, online resources, and its more than 150 print and digital books published by Penguin Random House. The company's Tutor.com brand is one of the largest online tutoring services in the U.S. It comprises a community of thousands of tutors who have delivered more than 22 million one-to-one tutoring sessions. The Princeton Review is headquartered in New York, NY. Follow the company on LinkedIn, YouTube and Instagram.

**About the Position**

We're looking for a detail-obsessed, quick-learning Revenue Operations Specialist to join our remote team and keep our revenue data accurate, visible, and actionable. In this role, you'll track and forecast revenue across accounts, reconcile records with Accounting, and manage revenue data in Salesforce. You'll also guide Sales and Customer Success toward the highest-priority accounts to close each month.

Day to day, you'll write Standard Operating Procedures, audit internal systems, and work with teams across the company (Sales, Marketing, Legal, Accounts Receivable, and senior leadership) to resolve invoicing questions quickly and accurately. You'll also take on special projects, including building a new invoicing process in Salesforce, managing non-standard contract compliance, serving as the Sales and Marketing liaison on lead list management and CCPA compliance, and helping launch new Sales Enablement tools such as a Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**What You'll Do**

* Identify and track all potential revenue earnings for each account, report to Leadership weekly, and reconcile records with Accounting monthly.
* Guide the Sales and Customer Success teams to maximize impact on revenue by identifying high priority accounts to close each month.
* Design and write Standard Operating Procedures when needed to improve accuracy, efficiency, and usability for internal teams.
* Coordinate with multiple internal teams to ensure quick and accurate response to customer inquiries regarding invoicing.
* Verify and input sales credits and debits into our internal tools to guarantee customer account balances as displayed accessible and accurate for our clients.
* Audit data entries and program statuses in our internal systems.
* Effectively communicate system needs to Salesforce Administrator and Sales Operations leadership to support design of technological tools that will improve workflow for business unit.
* Design and maintain a new invoicing process that bridges information in our proprietary Customer Service Tool and Salesforce.
* Manage non-standard contract compliance and reporting, using Claude AI and Salesforce to identify and track requirements.
* Serve as a liaison between Sales and Marketing regarding lead list management and sales follow-through.
* Write, build, and maintain the Sales Playbook on SharePoint.

**Who You Are**

* 3-5 years of Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or Sales experience, preferably in B2B SaaS
* Extremely detail oriented, prone to checking every last number and data point
* Ability to quickly learn new concepts and systems.
* Adept at using Excel for data entry, data preparation and some data analysis: pivot tables, vlookups, sumifs are all important to this position
* Knowledgeable of general accounting principles related to deferred revenue calculations and reporting
* Comfortable running reports in Salesforce Lightning and navigating the Salesforce environment.
* SharePoint experience preferred
* Comfortable using AI tools such as Claude to improve efficiencies in workflow
* Ability to interface professionally and effectively with many personality types from various departments including senior management, sales and service, marketing, legal team, and accounts receivables
* Work quickly, independently and remotely with an ability to adapt to changes in priority as needed
* Collaborate with, support, and lean on teammates when needed
* Willing to put in extra time during our busiest season with the understanding that flexibility will be reciprocated

*The Princeton Review is an equal employment opportunity employer. The Princeton Review's policy is not to discriminate against any applicant or employee based on, and all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to, race, color, religion, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, age, marital status, disability, military status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law. The Princeton Review also prohibits harassment of applicants or employees based on any of these protected categories. It is also The Princeton Review's policy to comply with all applicable laws respecting consideration of unemployment status in making hiring decisions.*

Storyblok is a headless CMS that enables marketers and developers to create with joy and publish with confidence. It empowers you to deliver structured and consistent content everywhere: websites, apps, AI search, and beyond.

Legendary brands like Virgin Media O2, Oatly, and TomTom use Storyblok to make a bigger, faster market impact.

  

**WHAT IS IN IT FOR YOU**

You will be joining a growing company where you can contribute to many "firsts". Plus these benefits:

* Monthly remote work stipend (home internet costs, electricity). Home office equipment package right at the start (laptop, keyboard, monitor…)
* Home office equipment upgrade (furniture, ear plugs …) or membership to a local co-working space after your onboarding
* Sick leave benefit, parental leave and 25 days of annual leave plus your local national holidays
* Personal development fund for courses, books, conferences, and material
* The annual international team-building trip, quarterly and monthly online get-togethers
* As a fully remote company, with work-life balance at its core, you'll enjoy flexible schedules
* An international team that loves to have fun at work and works hard together to accomplish shared goals

**Job Summary**
---------------

The Senior Global Partner Specialist owns the growth and commercial performance of Storyblok's global Longtail partner ecosystem, including New, Nurturing, and Emerging partners of all sizes.

This role develops and delivers scalable programs that enable partners, increase partner-sourced and partner-influenced revenue, and move partners through the lifecycle from onboarding to sustained commercial activity. Operating primarily through one-to-many engagement, automation, self-service, and data-driven segmentation, the role ensures Storyblok can support and grow a broad partner base efficiently. The role also identifies practical opportunities to use AI and emerging technologies to improve partner experience, efficiency, and scale.

The Senior Global Partner Specialist identifies high-potential Longtail partners that are ready to progress into the Focused segment and works cross-functionally to continuously improve Storyblok's global partner growth model.

**Essential Job Functions**
---------------------------

* Own and continuously improve the global growth strategy and engagement model for New, Nurturing, and Emerging partners.
* Drive partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue across the Longtail partner ecosystem.
* Design and deliver scalable one-to-many programs that support partner activation, enablement, engagement, and commercial growth.
* Manage partner lifecycle communications and campaigns across relevant channels and partner cohorts.
* Use partner data and performance insights to improve segmentation, prioritization, lifecycle progression, and program effectiveness.
* Identify barriers to partner growth and lead cross-functional initiatives to improve the partner experience and commercial outcomes.
* Own the process for identifying, assessing, and recommending high-potential Longtail partners for progression into the Focused segment.
* Collaborate with Partner Management, Sales, Marketing, Partner Enablement, Solutions Engineering, Developer Experience, and Operations to deliver a connected partner journey.
* Identify opportunities to use AI and automation to reduce repetitive work, improve partner self-service, and scale partner engagement while preserving human involvement for high-value commercial and strategic moments.
* Define and monitor success measures, share insights with Partner Leadership, and continuously optimize programs based on measurable outcomes.

**Education and Experience**
----------------------------

* 4-5 years of relevant experience in partnerships, channel management, partner growth, partner programs, business development, revenue programs, or a related SaaS environment.
* Demonstrated experience owning complex programs or business initiatives with measurable commercial outcomes.
* Experience managing or influencing a large portfolio of partners, customers, or accounts through scalable programs.
* Strong understanding of SaaS sales cycles, partner ecosystems, and lifecycle or growth programs.
* Strong analytical skills and experience using CRM, PRM, engagement, enablement, and pipeline data to guide decisions.
* Experience working globally and cross-functionally with commercial, marketing, enablement, operational, and technical stakeholders.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills in English.
* Demonstrated ability to work independently and lead complex initiatives with limited oversight.

**Professional Competencies**
-----------------------------

* **Commercial orientation:** Connects partner activity to pipeline and revenue and prioritizes work based on business impact.
* **Program strategy and management:** Translates strategic objectives into scalable programs and leads complex initiatives from concept through optimization.
* **One-to-many partner management:** Creates relevant partner experiences across a large portfolio without relying on continuous individual account management.
* **Lifecycle, segmentation, and prioritization:** Uses partner maturity, behavior, capability, and commercial signals to guide engagement and investment.
* **Analytical problem solving:** Uses qualitative and quantitative insights to diagnose challenges and develop effective solutions.
* **Cross-functional leadership:** Aligns stakeholders across functions and influences decisions without relying on direct authority.
* **Technology and automation mindset:** Identifies practical opportunities to use automation, AI, and digital tools to improve partner experience, operational efficiency, and program scalability.
* **Autonomy and ownership:** Takes accountability for outcomes and makes sound decisions in an evolving, global environment.

**Key Success Measures**
------------------------

* Partner-sourced and partner-influenced pipeline and revenue from Longtail partners
* Growth in commercially active partners and first and repeat opportunity generation
* Progression across partner lifecycle stages
* Effectiveness of one-to-many partner programs and communications
* Number and quality of partners progressed from Longtail to Focused
* Growth in partner productivity without proportional growth in manual management effort
  

***U.S. Base Salary Range: $97,000 - $132,000***

*At Storyblok, we are committed to equitable compensation and pay transparency. We consider many factors when it comes to compensation, such as the scope of the role, job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training. Our base salary ranges are determined by job and job level and are benchmarked to relevant location and industry data. The range displayed represents the target US base compensation range within which we are hiring for this role. For some roles Storyblok also offers a competitive commission structure.*

Remote (home) work opportunity or funded by Storyblok co-working space

**GENERAL TERMS**

*Storyblok has a commitment to diversity and inclusion. We strive to create a hiring environment in which all people feel they are equally respected and valued, irrespective of gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, ethnicity, age, religion, citizenship or any other characteristic.* *You can find more information about our privacy policy**here**.*
