9965d9965aa0e3f9f46f.title: Senior Consultant, Human Capital Workforce Management
9965d9965aa0e3f9f46f.description:
**Description**

**About Alvarez & Marsal**

Alvarez & Marsal (A&M) is a global consulting firm with entrepreneurial, action- and results-oriented professionals. We take a hands-on approach to solving our clients' problems and helping them reach their potential. A&M is different by design: we give people ownership and impact from day one, fuel development through real opportunity, and provide direct access to leaders who invest in our growth. Our culture celebrates independent thinkers and doers who positively impact clients and shape our industry. Guided by A&M's core values of Integrity, Quality, Objectivity, Fun, Personal Reward, and Inclusive Diversity, our collaborative, globally minded environment is why our people love working at A&M.

**The Team**

The Healthcare Industry Group, a subsidiary of A&M, leads transformational change in healthcare. As established leaders and trusted advisors, we deliver results for healthcare executives, boards, private equity firms, investors, law firms, and government agencies. Our team brings diverse perspectives and experiences to assist clients with enhancing financial and operational performance, accelerating strategic growth, and optimizing value throughout the investment lifecycle.

We provide specialized services in interim management, restructuring, revenue cycle management, M&A, compliance, digital technology, and analytics. Our professionals collaborate with a wide range of organizations, including health systems, physician groups, medical schools, behavioral health institutes, managed care organizations, healthcare investors, medical device companies, and suppliers, as well as vision centers, dental practices, and laboratories.

A practice within the Healthcare Industry Group (HIG), the Human Capital and Workforce Management practice is comprised of knowledgeable workforce management and human resources professionals experienced in the healthcare space. This team leads transformational work to meet client goals in a rapidly evolving and dynamic labor market that includes post-transaction integration, organizational design, alignment of staffing to business strategy and demand, change management, workforce cost takeout, and development of talent acquisition, employee engagement and management strategies.

As part of the Human Capital and Workforce Management team, you will have the opportunity to work with clients in a variety of sectors including: health systems and providers, physician groups, ancillary providers, medical schools, vision, laboratory, dental and behavioral health, managed care and health plans, government plans and programs, healthcare investors and lenders, medical devices, healthcare suppliers and infrastructure, life sciences, pharma, and biotech.

**How you will contribute**

As a Senior Associate, you will play a key role on project teams serving as a trusted partner to clients within the healthcare industry. You will be responsible for supporting and managing key workstreams, performing data-driven analyses, developing insights and recommendations, and contributing to the design and implementation of workforce and human capital transformation initiatives. Senior Associates are expected to work independently, communicate effectively, and collaborate closely with team members and client stakeholders. Depending on the client engagement, your responsibilities may include:

* Supporting the design and implementation of organizational and workforce transformation initiatives across a range of healthcare clients
* Managing discrete project workstreams, ensuring progress against goals, deadlines, and deliverables
* Conducting research, quantitative analyses, and qualitative interviews to identify performance improvement opportunities
* Developing client-ready deliverables such as presentations, reports, and dashboards that clearly communicate findings and recommendations
* Partnering with client leaders and team members to identify priorities and execute high-impact solutions under tight timelines
* Collaborating with project managers and Directors to monitor engagement economics, deliverables, and client expectations
* Assisting in the development of key performance indicators (KPIs), benchmarking tools, and analytics to measure workforce efficiency and outcomes
* Contributing to the identification and resolution of root causes for workforce management issues through data-driven insights and practical recommendations
* Participating in proposal development, client presentations, and business development activities as needed
* Contributing to team culture by fostering collaboration, learning, and inclusion across all engagements

At Alvarez & Marsal, you will join an entrepreneurial and collaborative team known for delivering hands-on, results-driven solutions that create meaningful and sustainable change.

We are seeking a motivated, adaptable, and analytical professional with a passion for healthcare and workforce transformation. The ideal candidate is comfortable managing ambiguity, balancing multiple priorities, and driving initiatives to completion in a fast-paced environment.

**Qualifications**

* Minimum of six (6) years of progressive experience in Human Resources, Workforce Management, or related areas within the healthcare industry
* Minimum of two (2) to three (3) years of experience in a healthcare consulting environment
* Bachelor’s degree required; master’s degree in human resources, Organizational Development, Business (MBA), Healthcare Administration (MHA), or Public Health (MPH) preferred
* Working knowledge of the healthcare industry, including understanding of healthcare operations, workforce strategy, and labor market dynamics
* Experience supporting or managing initiatives such as workforce planning, staffing-to-demand analysis, organizational design, or HR transformation
* Strong quantitative and analytical skills, with demonstrated ability to synthesize findings into actionable insights
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to prepare client-ready materials and present findings to project stakeholders
* Proficiency in Microsoft PowerPoint, Excel, and Word; experience with tools such as Tableau, Power BI, SQL, Action O-I benchmarking, or MGMA survey data is a plus
* Demonstrated ability to collaborate within cross-functional teams and contribute to a positive, inclusive, and high-performance work environment
* Willingness and ability to travel as required

**Your journey at A&M**

At A&M, professional growth is tied directly to performance, not tenure. Our people take on meaningful, hands-on work supported by a performance development process that rewards contribution and fosters a culture of meritocracy. Stretch roles, evolving business needs, and firm growth create ongoing opportunities for ownership and building new skills, while direct access to senior leaders provides mentorship and real-time coaching along the way. We also prioritize your wellbeing through comprehensive benefits and resources. Together, these elements create an environment where high-performing professionals can continue to grow and advance from day one.

Regular employees working 30 or more hours per week are also entitled to participate in Alvarez & Marsal Holdings’ fringe benefits consisting of healthcare plans, flexible spending and savings accounts, life, AD&D, and disability coverages at rates determined periodically as well as a 401(k)-retirement savings plan. Provided the eligibility requirements are met, employees will also receive an annual discretionary contribution to their 401(k)-retirement savings plan from Alvarez & Marsal. Additionally, employees are eligible for paid time off including vacation, personal days, seventy-two (72) hours of sick time (prorated for part-time employees), ten federal holidays, one floating holiday, and parental leave. The amount of vacation and personal days available varies based on tenure and role type. Click here for more information regarding A&M’s benefits programs.

*The salary range is $140,000- $160,000 annually, dependent on several variables including but not limited to education, experience, skills, and geography. In addition, A&M offers a discretionary bonus program which is based on a number of factors, including individual and firm performance. Please ask your recruiter for details.*

Alvarez & Marsal recruits on an ongoing basis. Candidates are considered as they apply, until the opportunity is filled. Candidates are encouraged to apply expeditiously to any role(s) that they are qualified for and that are of interest to them.

A&M does not require or administer lie detector tests as a condition of employment or continued employment. It is unlawful in Massachusetts to require or administer a lie detector test as a condition of employment or continued employment. An employer who violates this law shall be subject to criminal penalties and civil liability.

95fd226841fcd1a07f12.title: Engineering Operations Technician, DCC Communities
95fd226841fcd1a07f12.description:
**DESCRIPTION**
---------------

Join our dynamic team and become a critical guardian of technological infrastructure! As a Data Center Engineering Technician, you'll play a pivotal role in maintaining the heartbeat of mission-critical technology infrastructure, ensuring seamless operations that power global digital experiences. Your expertise will directly contribute to maintaining an extraordinary 99.999% uptime, keeping the digital world running smoothly and efficiently.
  
  
Engineering Technicians are Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment troubleshooting. They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot, Data Center Operation’s Mission Critical Facilities, which includes stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, as well as three phase electrical systems such as: switch gear, UPSs, PDUs, wet cell batteries and associated systems, CRAC, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers/water chemical system, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, & motors.
  
  
AWS Infrastructure Services owns the design, planning, delivery, and operation of all AWS global infrastructure. In other words, we’re the people who keep the cloud running. We support all AWS data centers and all of the servers, storage, networking, power, and cooling equipment that ensure our customers have continual access to the innovation they rely on. We work on the most challenging problems, with thousands of variables impacting the supply chain — and we’re looking for talented people who want to help.
  
  
You’ll join a diverse team of software, hardware, and network engineers, supply chain specialists, security experts, operations managers, and other vital roles. You’ll collaborate with people across AWS to help us deliver the highest standards for safety and security while providing seemingly infinite capacity at the lowest possible cost for our customers. And you’ll experience an inclusive culture that welcomes bold ideas and empowers you to own them to completion.
  
  
NOTE: Amazon does not sponsor for immigration, including for H-1B, TN, and other non-immigrant visas, for this role.
  
  
NOTE: Lump sum stipend will be provided to eligible candidates who relocate for this position.
  
  
Key job responsibilities  

* Daily building rounds to monitor and record information from electrical, mechanical, and fire/life safety equipment to ensure 24/7 reliability and availability
* Monitor Building Management Systems (BMS) and Electrical Power Management System (EPMS)
* Assist in troubleshooting of facility and rack-level events within internal Service Level Agreements (SLA)
* Perform rack installs and rack decommissioning within internal SLA
* Perform PM, troubleshooting, root cause analysis, and repair of electrical and mechanical equipment
* Technical writing to support change management program
* Monitor daily work requests and manage to resolution, and execute projects from conception to completion
* On-site support of contractors, sub-contractors and vendors, ensuring that all work performed is in accordance with established practices, procedures & local legislation
* Work schedule changes depending on specific site needs. Shifts can be up to 12-hours and may rotate on a predefined schedule. Some locations have on-call rotations.
* Role may support more than one location/site.

  
Physical Requirements:  

* Willingness and demonstrated ability to work in the following physical conditions with reasonable accommodations:
* Regularly lift and/or move up to 39 pounds independently
* Participate in group lifts for 40+ pounds
* Maintain balance and perform construction tasks while on a ladder
* Regularly walk, use hands and fingers, handle or feel, reach with hands and arms, stoop, kneel, crouch or crawl, climb stairs, twist, bend, work above shoulders, grasp, carry, push and pull objects into position
* Work in an environment requiring provided ear protection

  
This role supports data centers in various operational stages. The position may be assigned to a facility still under development, which could require travel to established locations for training until your designated site becomes fully operational.
  
  
Essential Requirements:
  
  

* Ability to travel to or commute between data center locations as needed

  

* Willingness to temporarily work at alternative sites during training periods or until assigned facility is operational

  

* Travel frequency will vary based on business needs and operational status of assigned facility

  
Candidates must be able to travel (over 50 miles) or commute (less than 50 miles) to active data center sites as required by business needs.
  
  
A day in the life  
This role acts as Amazon’s front line when it comes to hands-on electrical and mechanical equipment preventative maintenance (PM) and troubleshooting, reporting to a site’s Data Center Facility Manager (FM). They will maintain, operate, and troubleshoot mission-critical data center facility equipment including stand-by diesel generators and related fuel systems, 3 phase electrical systems such as switchgear, UPS units, PDUs, and wet cell batteries and associated systems. Mechanical equipment includes CRAHU units, centrifugal chillers, cooling towers, water systems, air handlers and associated systems, pumps, and motors. Additional support equipment is included in the scope of the role which includes fire/life safety equipment, building automation systems, and general facilities equipment.  
  
About the team  
Diverse Experiences AWS values diverse experiences. Even if you do not meet all of the preferred qualifications and skills listed in the job description, we encourage candidates to apply. If your career is just starting, hasn’t followed a traditional path, or includes alternative experiences, don’t let it stop you from applying.
  
  
Why AWS? Amazon Web Services (AWS) is the world’s most comprehensive and broadly adopted cloud platform. We pioneered cloud computing and never stopped innovating — that’s why customers from the most successful startups to Global 500 companies trust our robust suite of products and services to power their businesses.
  
  
Inclusive Team Culture
  
AWS values curiosity and connection. Our employee-led and company-sponsored affinity groups promote inclusion and empower our people to take pride in what makes us unique. Our inclusion of events fosters stronger, more collaborative teams. Our continual innovation is fueled by the bold ideas, fresh perspectives, and passionate voices our teams bring to everything we do.
  
  
Mentorship & Career Growth
  
We’re continuously raising our performance bar as we strive to become Earth’s Best Employer. That’s why you’ll find endless knowledge-sharing, mentorship, and other career-advancing resources here to help you develop into a better-rounded professional.
  
  
Work/Life Balance
  
We value work-life harmony. Achieving success at work should never come at the expense of sacrifices at home, which is why we strive for flexibility as part of our working culture. When we feel supported in the workplace and at home, there’s nothing we can’t achieve.

**BASIC QUALIFICATIONS**
------------------------

* 2+ years of Microsoft Office products and applications experience
* 2+ years of electrical and mechanical experience
* Ability to work on a flexible schedule including days, nights, and/or weekends.

**PREFERRED QUALIFICATIONS**
----------------------------

* Experience working in a data center or mission critical facility (example: hospital, military facility, public safety facility, etc.)
* Associate or higher education in related field
* Experience with reading and writing procedures, technical documents, and engineering drawings

  
Amazon is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of protected veteran status, disability, or other legally protected status.  
  
Our inclusive culture empowers Amazonians to deliver the best results for our customers. If you have a disability and need a workplace accommodation or adjustment during the application and hiring process, including support for the interview or onboarding process, please visit https://amazon.jobs/content/en/how-we-hire/accommodations for more information. dad9560773acb15a64c9.description:
Comcast Business offers a suite of Connectivity, Communications, Networking, Cybersecurity, Wireless, and Managed Solutions to help global organizations of all sizes prepare for what’s next. Powered by the nation’s largest Gig-speed broadband network and backed by 24/7 customer support, Comcast Business is the nation’s largest technology provider to small businesses and one of the leading service providers to the Enterprise market. Comcast Business has been consistently recognized by industry analysts and associations as a leader and innovator, and one of the fastest growing providers of Ethernet services.  
**Job Summary**

Comcast Business is seeking a highly-driven Project Manager 3 to support our National Enterprise Ethernet portfolio. This role is responsible for managing complex customer deployments, ensuring on-time delivery, and providing exceptional customer experience across large enterprise implementations. This PM3 serves as the central point of coordination and accountability for end-to-end project execution, driving collaboration across cross-functional teams while managing multiple high-visibility customer initiatives. The successful candidate will manage deployments including Ethernet Private Line (EPL), Ethernet Virtual Private Line (EVPL), Ethernet Network Service (ENS), Dedicated Internet, Retail Wavelength, Managed Wi-Fi, and other strategic National Enterprise Ethernet solutions for large enterprise customers. Strong Smartsheet expertise is critical for project tracking, reporting, workflow automation, and executive-level visibility. Due to this team’s present business operations, we are only able to consider candidates who presently reside within Colorado, Pennsylvania, Georgia, Ohio or Illinois, with reasonable proximity to one of the team’s primary hub locations (Denver, Philadelphia, Atlanta, West Chester or Naperville).

**Job Description**

**Key Responsibilities:**

* Manage project timelines and SLA commitments for National Enterprise Ethernet product deployments, ensuring on-time delivery.
* Coordinate implementation of EPL, EVPL, ENS, Dedicated Internet, Retail Wavelength, Managed Wi-Fi, and other National Enterprise Ethernet services**.**
* Utilize Smartsheet to track project milestones, manage dependencies, automate workflows, and provide real-time visibility to stakeholders.
* Identify, escalate, and mitigate risks impacting customer delivery timelines.
* Drive accountability across cross-functional teams including Sales, Engineering, Service Assurance, Construction, Order Management, and Field Operations.
* Meet and exceed KPI performance metrics while supporting continuous process improvement initiatives.
* Coordinate installation, testing, turn-up, and customer acceptance activities for Enterprise Ethernet services.
* Maintain accurate project documentation and ensure customer communication throughout the project lifecycle.
* Support deployment of new technologies and process enhancements aligned with business objectives and customer requirements.
* Consistently exercise independent judgment and discretion in matters of significance.
* Regular, consistent, and punctual attendance.
* Other duties and responsibilities as assigned.

**Key Qualifications:**

* Advanced proficiency in Smartsheet, including dashboards, automation, reporting, and portfolio management.
* Strong understanding of National Enterprise Ethernet products, deployment standards, and implementation workflows.
* Experience managing large enterprise customer deployments involving multiple sites and complex network solutions.
* Proven ability to independently solve complex problems and manage competing priorities.
* Excellent communication, executive presentation, and stakeholder management skills.
* Demonstrated success delivering high-quality customer experiences in a fast-paced environment.
* Ability to drive accountability, influence cross-functional teams, and deliver results.

**Customer & Employee Experience:**

Maintaining appropriate staffing levels also supports a strong employee experience by balancing workloads, reducing burnout, and fostering a culture of accountability, collaboration, and continuous improvement.

* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.

* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.

81441dbf3e355e53288a.description:
**Job Profile**

**Overview**
============

  
At PNC, our people are our greatest differentiator and competitive advantage in the markets we serve. We are all united in delivering the best experience for our customers. We work together each day to foster an inclusive workplace culture where all of our employees feel respected, valued and have an opportunity to contribute to the company’s success.PNC is an in-office company that fosters a supportive culture where employees can thrive and achieve balance. We encourage candidates to connect with their recruiter and hiring manager to understand workplace expectations and ensure the role aligns with their goals.  
PNC will not provide sponsorship for employment visas or participate in STEM OPT for this position.

**Job Description**
===================

As a(n) Relationship Banker Business Specialist within PNC's retail organization, you will be based in Wilmington, DE at the Delaware Avenue Branch.

  

* Acquires and expands share of wallet for Consumer and Business Banking opportunities under 2MM in sales revenue. Achieves business results through leadership of and productive collaboration with a wide range of ecosystem partners. Responsible for proactive lead generation and appointments conducted inside and outside of branch. Delivers a differentiated client experience from acquisition through onboarding and servicing.
Proactive lead management and referral generation* -Leverages experience and acquired knowledge of bank products and services and positions appropriately to grow share of wallet and attract new consumer and business households. Responsible for managing and growing Business Banking relationships under 2MM in sales revenue. Takes action, using client information from various sources and translates to actionable sales strategy and tactics. Generates quality referrals to ecosystem partners. Leverages tools and protocols to maximize business results.
* Develop ecosystem leadership inside and outside of the branch as a COI. Works across a broad range of ecosystem partners, including PNCWM, PNC Private Bank, Business Banking and Mortgage. Identifies the resource or team of resources best equipped to meet client needs and introduces the client accordingly. Holds partners accountable for routine updates and referral follow up.
Client experience and Hospitality management* -differentiates the client experience through advanced conversation skills. Delivers client well-being through tailored solutions aligned with clients’ wholistic needs, including deposits, lending, cash management, payments, and investing. Solves clients’ problems courteously and with urgency, escalating where necessary. Acts as an advocate for clients and prospects across product, support, operations or other departments within PNC, identifying trends and unique needs of the client.
* Works with branch team to help them identify consumer and business banking opportunities to create referrals. Works closely with the Branch Manager and Business Banker to follow up on independent opportunities to expand share of wallet with consumer and business clients.
* Creates client loyalty and grow client share of wallet through a differentiated client experience. Performs lobby engagement activities to connect with clients and position PNC products to meet their needs. Educates clients on options for managing financial transactions by leveraging technology, tools and resources. Applies product and procedural knowledge to identify, mitigate and solve customer problems effectively to drive customer loyalty.
* Manages risk through adherence to all policies and procedures, demonstrating sound judgment within established limits. Demonstrates a heightened scrutiny to identify and avoid loss. Participates in branch daily operations, ensuring they are completed in an efficient and accurate manner.

  
PNC Employees take pride in our reputation and to continue building upon that we expect our employees to be: • Customer Focused: Knowledgeable of the values and practices that align customer needs and satisfaction as primary considerations in all business decisions and able to leverage that information in creating customized customer solutions. • Managing Risk: Assessing and effectively managing all of the risks associated with their business objectives and activities to ensure they adhere to and support PNC's Enterprise Risk Management Framework.

Accountability, Banking, Client Loyalty, Customer Experience (CX), Customer Service, Identifying Opportunities, Leveraging Technology, Proactive Sales

e6673e5c1bd23448f045.title: Associate Director - Managed Care - Healthcare Strategy & Transformation Consulting
e6673e5c1bd23448f045.description:
**Job Family****:**

Strategy & Transformation Consulting

**Travel Required****:**

Up to 50%

**Clearance Required****:**

None

Guidehouse is engineering revenue cycle on a platform that can power the future of health services reimbursements. Complexity, friction and duplicity impede healthcare transactions. Our Managed Care consultancy is focused on ensuring healthcare providers are able to align contracts with the right reimbursement strategies/operations and engineer revenue cycle operations, simplify consumer experience and minimize administrative cost. Our approach is to strategically and operationally elevate the entire healthcare experience for patients by leveraging our full scope of reimbursement capabilities along with cutting-edge technology in machine learning, automation and financial technology to reimagine revenue cycle.

You will be responsible for managing client relationships and leading account projects. This position requires outstanding client management, problem-solving, and communication skills; experience leading complex contract strategy, pricing, financial reengineering, and operational improvement initiatives spanning multiple teams and stakeholders; and the ability to manage C-suite relationships and communications. In this role, you will direct internal strategic and operational initiatives and be accountable for delivering analytically sound, implementable client outcomes.

**What You Will Do:**

* Support the growth of the team: help hire, develop, and mentor team members; plan for the future by identifying and addressing bottlenecks, gaps, and risks
* Develop and maintain strong client relationships that provide leverage for decision-making and effective change management
* Help advance the Guidehouse Managed Care practice with an emphasis on managed care strategy, price transparency, physician enterprise strategy, digital health transformation, revenue rebalancing, strategic pricing, enterprise strategy, M&A, payer-provider partnerships, and reimbursement frameworks
* You will help shape our consulting team and deliverables to identify and analyze the root cause of user and system issues, and strategize and help operationalize efficient workflows, and implement technology solutions within the financial operating systems.
* Contribute to the design, documentation, and execution of repeatable and scalable client financial frameworks and client deliverables.
* You will provide account management strategies that deliver an industry-leading client experience
* Work cross-functionally within Guidehouse Strategy & Revenue Cycle teams as well as our broader portfolio of healthcare services to bring integrated sustainable solutions to healthcare clients
* Proactively contribute to the strategic direction and priorities for the finance contract strategy and Finance Operations team
* Lead end-to-end hospital and professional Charge Description Master (CDM) strategic pricing engagements, including workplan development, data acquisition, validation, scenario design, client decision sessions, and implementation-ready deliverables.
* Translate client pricing objectives into customized, defensible methodologies that balance reimbursement improvement, standardized pricing relationships, market position, cost considerations, price transparency, and organizational risk tolerance.
* Direct quantitative analyses using CDM, account-level, transaction-level, payer master, contract, fee schedule, cost, and market benchmark data; identify charge-level and payer-specific opportunities, including lesser-of exposure under commercial contract terms.
* Oversee development and quality assurance of executive strategy memos, scenario presentations, detailed charge-code models, and finalized upload files; clearly explain assumptions, financial impacts, trade-offs, and implementation requirements to finance, revenue cycle, clinical, compliance, and executive stakeholders.

**What You Will Need:**

* 7+ yrs. working in health system complex contract and pricing strategy and finance operations with a heavy focus leading managed care strategy, price transparency, physician enterprise strategy, digital health transformation, revenue portfolio rebalancing, access, enterprise strategy, M&A, payer-provider partnership and their design and implementation.
* Demonstrated success in complex problem solving and root cause analysis and structured solutioning to better engineer financial objectives and the operations /reimbursement for the consumer, business and clinician to measurably improve satisfaction and impact.
* 3+ yrs. experience independently owning senior level stakeholder relationships/communication and accountability for delivering successful cross-functional project outcomes
* Management consulting experience or consulting-like experience managing client and internal teams responsible for managed care strategy, price transparency, physician enterprise strategy, revenue portfolio rebalancing, access and/or enterprise strategy
* 3+ yrs. applying financial rigor that resulted in demonstrable financial turnaround in struggling Health entities
* Proficient understanding of EMR applications (Epic and Cerner)
* 3+ yrs. strategizing, interpreting and designing process, data, and metadata to synthesize and execute strategies and process change and improvement that deliver defined financial results
* You have the ability to quickly synthesize information and data and present to senior level stakeholders
* Ability to create standardized processes with strong organization, time management and project management skills
* Bachelor's degree
* Travel as needed up to 50% of the time to client site(s)
* Demonstrated ability to independently lead complex healthcare pricing or revenue integrity engagements from ambiguous data requests through executive recommendation and operational implementation, while managing scope, timeline, quality, and client expectations.
* Advanced experience structuring, validating, and interpreting large healthcare datasets and financial models at the patient, claim, service-line, CPT/HCPCS, revenue-code, and charge-code levels; proficiency in Excel-based scenario modeling and quality-control reconciliation is required.
* Working knowledge of hospital billing and professional billing reimbursement mechanics, commercial contract payment terms, Medicare fee schedules, lesser-of logic, cost-to-charge relationships, market benchmarking, price transparency, and defensible pricing practices.
* Ability to facilitate pricing strategy workshops, convert leadership priorities into measurable modeling assumptions, compare conservative through aggressive scenarios, and guide cross-functional stakeholders to documented decisions and implementation-ready pricing rules.

**What Would Be Nice To Have:**

* MBA
* 3+ yrs. selling $2M+ credited annually of consulting or professional services (heavily preferred)
* 3+ yrs. of management consulting experience in healthcare strategy (managed care contracts preferred)
* You have demonstrated ability to carry a collaborative culture and management style to interactions with other Stakeholders, including those at Guidehouse and the client
* Strong written and oral communication skills
* Experience in value-based payment arrangements such as Medicare Advantage/Managed Care, risk contracting, shared savings arrangements, and/or post-acute care consulting.
* Experience with CDM governance, revenue integrity, hospital pricing analytics, or charge master tools and data sourced from Epic, Oracle Health/Cerner, or comparable patient accounting and contract management platforms.
* While this role is available remotely, preference will be candidates within 50 miles of a Guidehouse office.

The annual salary range for this position is $135,000.00-$225,000.00. Compensation decisions depend on a wide range of factors, including but not limited to skill sets, experience and training, security clearances, licensure and certifications, and other business and organizational needs.

**What We Offer****:**

Guidehouse offers a comprehensive, total rewards package that includes competitive compensation and a flexible benefits package that reflects our commitment to creating a diverse and supportive workplace.

Benefits include:

d94e09b417bbc2b0812a.title: Business System Support Specialist
d94e09b417bbc2b0812a.description:
Overview:

**The Michaels Organization is a national leader in residential real estate offering full-service capabilities in development, property management, construction, and investment. At Michaels, our teammates strive to fulfill our promise of creating communities that lift lives – ones that jumpstart housing, education, civic engagement, and neighborhood prosperity. With this passion at the forefront of our business, Michaels teammates can be proud to be a part of the extraordinary, every day.**

The Business Systems Support Specialist is the first person a site, regional, or corporate team reaches when something goes wrong in the Property Management Systems (i.e, Yardi, Entrata, Real Page) or  
another platform Business Transformation & Solutions (BTS) owns. Reporting to the Director, Business Systems & Solutions and taking day-to-day technical direction from the Business Systems Administrator, the Business Systems Support Specialist receives, records, triages, and resolves standard support requests across market-rate, affordable, student, and military housing, and owns the integrity of the support queue: every request captured with complete information, categorized correctly, prioritized against published criteria, answered within service level, and either resolved at first line or escalated with everything the second line needs.

  
Responsibilities:

Intake and Triage

* Receive and record every support request across the published intake channels, user, property or business line, platform, issue, steps already taken, business impact, time constraint and triage each against published categorization and priority criteria, correcting miscategorized requests rather than passing them on as received.
* Monitor the queue throughout the business day, acknowledge new requests within service level, and keep the status of every open item accurate, so the queue is a reliable view of outstanding work.
* Recognize requests that are in fact business demand, a new requirement, a change request, an improvement idea, and route them to the Business Solutions Manager through intake rather than holding them in the support queue.

Standard Support and Basic Troubleshooting

  

* Resolve standard requests using documented procedures: user account setup and deactivation, standard role and permission assignment within approved access matrices, password and access resets, routine report requests, and user onboarding and offboarding with Human Resources and Information Technology.
* Perform basic troubleshooting, verify the reported behavior, check permissions and setup, establish whether the issue is isolated or widespread, eliminate known causes from the knowledge base, and guide users through documented steps where the request reflects a knowledge gap rather than a fault, recording the pattern so recurring training needs are visible.
* Confirm resolution with the user before closing any request; never close on the basis of an action having been taken.

Escalation

  

* Escalate to the Business Systems Administrator any issue outside documented procedure and any issue affecting multiple users, a compliance or financial deadline, or a resident-facing service promptly, not after the service level is consumed, with complete reproduction detail, affected users and properties, impact, and the outcome of every step attempted; then follow up on the user's behalf until the item is closed.

Documentation and Reporting

  

* Maintain a record for every request sufficient for another person to understand what happened without asking; draft and maintain first-line knowledge base articles for recurring issues under the Administrator's review; and produce the recurring support report, volume by platform and category, service-level performance, escalation rate, aging items, recurring issues for the Business Solutions Manager.

Readiness Support

  

* Provide extended first-line coverage and rapid issue capture during go-live and hypercare, reporting daily into the Project & Implementation Manager, and coordinate scheduling, logistics, and material distribution for training and communication activity as required.

Qualifications:

Required Experience:

* Minimum of 2 years in a support, administrative coordination, or on-site property management role with regular use of a property management or comparable operating platform.
* Experience working a ticket queue or structured request process against service levels preferred; multi-site operations and affordable, student, or military housing exposure a plus.

Required Education/Training: List education &/or training required to perform the job.

* High school diploma or equivalent required; Associate's or Bachelor's degree in Business, Information Systems, or a related field preferred.
* Platform end-user training or certification preferred; may be completed after hire.

Required Skills and Abilities:

* Organizational discipline to hold an accurate queue under volume without losing items.
* Clear, patient written and verbal communication with site teams operating under time pressure.
* Sound judgment on when a request exceeds documented procedure, and the discipline to escalate rather than improvise.
* Working proficiency with standard office and reporting tools, accuracy in record keeping and  
  access administration, and the ability to learn platform functionality quickly.

Working Conditions:

  

* Ability to sit for extended periods and work on a computer for long durations.
* Occasional standing, walking, and lifting up to 30 pounds may be required.
* Must be able to travel up to 10% for training, go-live support, and occasional site visits;  
  occasional work outside standard hours during go-live and stabilization.

**Salary Range Information:**

The range displayed on each job posting reflects the targeted base salary for the position. Within the range, individual pay is determined by work location and additional factors, including job-related skills, experience, and relevant education or training.

**Rewards & Benefits:**

We know Michaels’ promise of lifting lives starts with our teammates, so making sure every single teammate is happy, healthy, and set up for a successful future is important to us. As part of our team, you will enjoy a competitive wage, a comprehensive benefit package which includes Medical, Dental, Vision, prescription, etc., generous paid time off, a 401 (k) plan with a company match, and so much more. We believe in education – and in taking care of our own – so as an added incentive your children will be able to apply for the Michaels Employee Scholarship Program.

* Help make the world a better place in a team-oriented environment.
* Grow with our organization through various professional development opportunities.
* Collaborate and thrive in a company culture where all are welcome

Michaels teammates make a difference in the lives of residents, colleagues, and the communities where we live and work every day. To learn more about the total rewards we offer please visit our website.

Come join our team. You’re going to love it here!

Salary Range: $21.01- $27.99 Per Hour

838da2d393d366988552.title: Customer Service Representative
838da2d393d366988552.description:
**The Opportunity:**

Tetra Tech's Disaster Recovery Unit is hiring to add Customer Service Representatives to their Call Center team. This is a remote position.

**Why Tetra Tech:**

At Tetra Tech, you will work with high-performing teams who are passionate about using their expertise to find solutions to complex problems in water, environment, infrastructure, resource management, energy, and international development.

**Your Impact:**

As a Customer Service Representative, you will make a direct impact by helping residents and customers navigate program services with clarity, professionalism, and compassion. You will serve as a trusted point of contact, ensuring questions are answered accurately, concerns are documented and resolved efficiently, and complex issues are escalated appropriately. Your attention to detail, commitment to confidentiality, and ability to build positive customer relationships will help strengthen trust in Tetra Tech and the client program.

**Position Summary:**

Tetra Tech Inc. is currently seeking a Customer Service Representative to serve as the primary liaison between Tetra Tech, the client program, and residents or customers. The role provides accurate, respectful, and timely service through phone, email, text, chat, and outbound outreach while supporting effective issue resolution and strong customer relationships.

**Essential Job Functions:**

The following duties are considered essential to the role. Reasonable accommodations may be made to enable individuals with disabilities to perform these essential functions:

* Customer Interaction: Handle inbound and outbound contacts professionally and courteously across phone, email, text, chat, and outreach channels.
* Accurate Information: Provide accurate information using approved scripts, FAQs, knowledge articles, SOPs, program guidance, and company policies.
* Issue Resolution and Escalation: Resolve routine inquiries in a timely and effective manner and escalate complex, sensitive, or unresolved matters to the appropriate supervisor, department, or client program contact.
* Documentation: Document every customer interaction, transaction, inquiry, complaint, action taken, and follow-up completely and accurately in the approved system.
* Confidentiality and Verification: Protect confidential and sensitive information and follow required identity-verification, privacy, and data-security procedures.
* Performance Expectations: Meet established schedule, attendance, quality, productivity, adherence, and customer-service expectations and performance targets.
* Team Collaboration and Development: Participate in team huddles, meetings, training, coaching, calibrations, and process-improvement activities; work collaboratively with team members and other departments to support a seamless customer experience.
* Operational Awareness: Promptly report system issues, emerging trends, misinformation, recurring customer concerns, safety concerns, and policy or process gaps to management.

f3d33b19c31d1078ebd7.title: Client Intake & Sales Specialist
f3d33b19c31d1078ebd7.description:
**Client Intake & Sales Specialist – Private-Pay Home Care (Remote)**
=====================================================================

**Company:** SYNERGY HomeCare of Rockville, Bethesda & Potomac  
**Location:** Remote – U.S.-based, working Eastern Time business hours  
**Employment Type:** Full-Time  
**Base Salary:** $45,000–$55,000 annually  
**Target Total Compensation:** $65,000–$80,000 annually, including commissions  
**Commission:** Uncapped, performance-based  
**Equipment Provided:** Company computer, phone system, and necessary technology

**Help Families Find the Care They Need — And Turn Conversations Into Clients**
-------------------------------------------------------------------------------

At SYNERGY HomeCare, we help seniors and individuals with disabilities remain safe, comfortable, and independent in their own homes.

We're looking for an **experienced, results-driven Client Intake & Sales Specialist** who knows how to connect with families, build trust, overcome objections, and convert inquiries into new clients.

**This is a sales position, not simply an intake or customer service role.**

You'll work primarily with inbound leads from families who are already interested in home care services. Your responsibility is to understand their needs, explain our services, address concerns, and guide them through the process of becoming a client.

We're looking for someone who combines strong telephone sales skills with empathy, persistence, and the confidence to ask for the business.

If you have experience successfully closing sales in private-pay home care, senior living, senior care advisory services, or another consultative sales environment, we'd love to hear from you.

**What You'll Do**
------------------

### **Convert Inquiries Into New Clients**

* Respond promptly to incoming calls, website inquiries, and other assigned leads.
* Build rapport quickly with prospective clients and their families.
* Ask thoughtful questions to understand care needs, concerns, and decision-making timelines.
* Explain our home care services, pricing, and the value we provide.
* Confidently address objections related to pricing, scheduling, and starting care.
* Guide families toward a decision and secure signed service agreements.
* Take ownership of the sales process from initial inquiry through successful client conversion.

### **Manage Follow-Up and Close Opportunities**

* Proactively follow up with prospective clients by telephone, email, and text.
* Maintain consistent communication with families who are considering care but have not made a decision.
* Provide telephone and written responses to inquiries in accordance with company follow-up standards.
* Identify decision-makers, recognize buying signals, and address concerns preventing families from moving forward.
* Maintain an organized sales pipeline and ensure opportunities do not fall through the cracks.

### **Coordinate a Smooth Start to Care**

* Schedule initial consultations and assessments when appropriate.
* Work closely with our scheduling, nursing, and operations teams to coordinate new clients.
* Communicate important client information, requested schedules, and expectations to the appropriate departments.
* Help ensure a positive experience from the first conversation through the start of services.

### **Track Performance and Improve Results**

* Document all client interactions and follow-up activities in our CRM.
* Manage assigned leads and keep sales opportunities updated.
* Meet or exceed established lead conversion and new-client sales goals.
* Track personal conversion rates, follow-up activity, and sales performance.
* Identify common objections and opportunities to improve the intake and sales process.

**What We're Looking For**
--------------------------

**Required Qualifications**

* 3+ years of successful inside sales, consultative sales, or client acquisition experience.
* Demonstrated ability to convert telephone inquiries into paying clients or customers.
* Experience meeting sales goals or working in a performance-based sales environment.
* Excellent verbal and written communication skills.
* Strong closing skills, including objection handling, relationship building, and asking for the sale.
* Ability to develop trust quickly over the telephone, particularly with families making important or emotional decisions.
* Strong organization, follow-up discipline, and attention to detail.
* Experience working with CRM systems and managing a sales pipeline.
* Comfortable using Google Workspace, email, online scheduling tools, and telephone systems.
* Ability to work independently and remain accountable in a remote environment.
* Reliable high-speed internet and a private, professional home workspace.

**Highly Preferred**

* Experience converting private-pay home care inquiries into new clients.
* Previous sales experience with a home care agency, senior living organization, or senior care referral service.
* Experience with organizations such as A Place for Mom, Caring.com, Home Instead, Right at Home, BrightStar Care, Visiting Angels, or similar senior care providers.
* Demonstrated history of achieving or exceeding sales conversion goals.
* Familiarity with home care management systems such as AxisCare.

**What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?**
-----------------------------------------------

We're looking for someone who:

* **Knows how to close:** You don't simply provide information and wait for families to call back. You confidently guide conversations toward a decision.
* **Builds genuine trust:** You understand that families are often making emotional and important care decisions.
* **Follows through:** You're persistent without being pushy and recognize that some families need multiple conversations before moving forward.
* **Takes ownership:** You're accountable for your leads and take pride in achieving measurable results.
* **Balances empathy with performance:** You genuinely want to help families while remaining focused on converting appropriate opportunities into clients.
* **Understands quality:** You recognize that the right client relationship matters more than a sale that cannot be successfully supported.

**What We Offer**
-----------------

* **Competitive Compensation:** $45,000–$55,000 base salary plus uncapped commissions, with target total annual compensation of $65,000–$80,000.
* **100% Remote Work:** Work from an approved U.S. location during established Eastern Time business hours.
* **Company-Provided Equipment:** Computer, business phone system, and the technology needed to perform your role.
* **Health Coverage:** Access to available employee health coverage options, subject to plan eligibility and terms.
* **Retirement Savings:** Participation in the company's 401(k) program, subject to eligibility and plan terms.
* **Paid Leave:** Time off in accordance with company policy and applicable law.
* **Training & Support:** Onboarding and ongoing collaboration with our experienced home care team.
* **Meaningful Work:** Help families make important decisions while building a rewarding sales career.

**Ready to Make a Difference?**
-------------------------------

We're seeking a motivated sales professional who enjoys connecting with people, thrives on converting opportunities into results, and wants to make a meaningful difference in the lives of seniors and their families.

**If you have a proven history of turning inquiries into paying clients, we want to hear from you.**

Please submit your resume and briefly tell us:

* Your relevant home care, senior care, or consultative sales experience.
* Your experience converting inbound leads into paying clients.
* Your previous sales results or conversion rates, if available.
* Why you're interested in joining SYNERGY HomeCare.

**Apply today to join SYNERGY HomeCare of Rockville, Bethesda & Potomac.**

SYNERGY HomeCare is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration in accordance with applicable law.

919a1cc922e6f3b7ea06.title: Contact Center Technology Analyst
919a1cc922e6f3b7ea06.description:
**Job Overview**

***Job Title*****:** Contact Center Technology Analyst

***Employment Type*****:** Full-Time

***Location:*** Madison, WI - Remote - Chicago, IL

***Reports To*****:** Mgr, Customer & User Experience

**The Impact You’ll Make:**

As the **Contact Center Technology Analyst,** you'll own the reliable operation and continuous improvement of contact center technology that supports guest and agent experiences. You'll combine hands-on platform support, AI agent enablement, disciplined project execution, structured testing, and controlled production releases. You will drive assigned work to verified completion, maintain organized records, anticipate risks, and communicate proactively with stakeholders—even when implementation depends on other teams or vendors.

**Key Responsibilities:**

*Contact Center Platforms*

* Administer and optimize cloud contact center (CCaaS), telephony, IVR, skills-based routing, queues, greetings, business hours, and agent configurations.
* Monitor platform health, service quality, integrations, and agent-impacting incidents; troubleshoot, investigate root causes, coordinate escalations, and validate permanent fixes.
* Maintain accurate configuration inventories, change records, runbooks, access documentation, and business-continuity procedures.
* Support workforce management, quality management, speech analytics, CRM, and knowledge-management tools and their operational workflows.

*AI Agents & Conversational Automation*

* Support the deployment, configuration, testing, and ongoing optimization of voice and chat AI agents, including intent recognition, conversation journeys, knowledge sources, authentication, handoffs, and routing.
* Analyze AI performance and guest friction using containment, transfer reasons, fallback/no-intent rates, escalation outcomes, and guest feedback; recommend and validate improvements.
* Partner with Digital, platform vendors, and business owners to define requirements for AI integrations and API-based workflows; test eligibility, edge cases, error handling, and human-agent transitions.
* Monitor production AI changes for accuracy, reliability, guest experience, and unintended impacts; document issues and collaborate on remediation.
* Support responsible AI practices, including appropriate handling of sensitive information, access controls, and escalation to humans when needed.

*Project Ownership, Execution & Delivery*

* Translate operational needs into clear requirements, user stories, acceptance criteria, and implementation plans.
* Own assigned initiatives end to end—from intake, requirements and planning through testing, approved deployment, post-launch verification, and closure; actively drive next steps and dependencies without repeated prompting.
* Build and execute traceable test plans with scenarios, expected and actual outcomes, defects, retests, and evidence; cover normal, exception, negative, integration, and regression scenarios.
* Maintain disciplined project tracking (currently Monday.com): owners, milestones, due dates, decisions, risks, blockers, action items, and accurate status; promptly escalate at-risk deliverables with options and recommendations.
* Provide concise, timely updates on status, decisions, dependencies, and next steps; communicate emerging risks or delays before deadlines are missed.
* For incidents and escalations, identify business impact, coordinate accountable parties, recommend actions, and confirm resolution with affected stakeholders.
* Maintain clear handoffs and ownership across IT, Digital, Operations, vendors, and other partners; ensure no issue or deliverable is left without a documented next step.

*Proactive Communication & Accountability*

* Provide concise, timely updates on status, decisions, dependencies, and next steps; communicate emerging risks or delays before deadlines are missed.
* For incidents and escalations, identify business impact, coordinate accountable parties, recommend actions, and confirm resolution with affected stakeholders.
* Maintain clear handoffs and ownership across IT, Digital, Operations, vendors, and other partners; ensure no issue or deliverable is left without a documented next step.

*Testing Discipline & Production Governance*

* Define acceptance criteria and obtain business-owner sign-off on UAT results before requesting a production release; record open defects and disposition of exceptions.
* Follow authorized change-control processes: assess guest and agent impact, dependencies, security and privacy risks, release windows, communication plans, approvals, and rollback readiness.
* Coordinate releases with authorized deployment owners; do not bypass required approvals or assume unrestricted production access.
* Complete documented post-release smoke tests and monitoring, verify routing and AI handoffs, track incidents during hypercare, and formally close changes only after outcomes are validated.

*Agent Enablement & Cross-Functional Partnership*

* Partner with Operations, Workforce Management, Learning & Development, IT, InfoSec, and vendors to resolve issues and improve the agent experience.
* Support access provisioning, role-based configurations, new-hire technology readiness, and changes to agent skills.
* Maintain practical job aids, release notes, and training references; communicate outages and technology changes promptly and clearly.

*Reporting, Security & Continuous Improvement*

* Validate that systems capture reliable operational and AI metrics; partner with analysts to investigate discrepancies and improve reporting.
* Follow organizational security, privacy, PCI, and PII requirements, including appropriate controls for call recordings, transcripts, payments, and guest data.
* Stay informed about CCaaS, WFM, quality analytics, conversational AI, and automation trends; propose improvements based on measurable operational value.

**Required Qualifications & Skills:**

* Experience supporting or administering contact center technology, enterprise SaaS applications, telephony, or related customer experience platforms.
* Working knowledge of IVR, call routing, queues, agent workflows, system integrations, and incident troubleshooting.
* Ability to analyze technical and operational data, document findings, test changes, and communicate clearly with technical and nontechnical stakeholders.
* Demonstrated organization, independent follow-through, project-management discipline, and proactive stakeholder communication; ability to maintain multiple workstreams, surface risks early, and close the loop on commitments.
* Familiarity with conversational AI, chatbots, or automated customer service workflows, or demonstrated ability to learn and support these technologies.

**Preferred Experience**

* Hands-on experience with Five9 CCaaS, including administration, IVR/routing, and reporting.
* Experience with Verint Workforce Management, Quality Management, Speech Analytics, or related modules.
* Experience with conversational AI agent platforms such as Sierra, including journey design, testing, analytics, and human handoffs.
* Experience with Salesforce Service Cloud, API integrations, webhooks, CRM workflows, or contact center data pipelines.
* Experience supporting multi-site or outsourced contact center operations.

**Physical Requirements:**

Lift up to 20 lbs., sit and/or stand for long periods.

**Grow Your Career**

This role offers the opportunity to expand your leadership impact, develop high-performing teams, and contribute to enterprise-wide initiatives. You’ll have access to development programs, cross-functional experiences, and clear pathways to advance your career within Great Wolf Lodge.

**Benefits:**

* Medical, Dental, and Vision insurance
* Health savings account
* Telehealth resources
* Life insurance
* Annual Bonus
* 401K with employer match
* Paid vacation time off
* Paid parental leave
* Discounts to visit Great Wolf’s 23+ locations for team members, friends, & family

Learn more about what it’s like to work at Great Wolf and be part of our Pack.

  

**Estimated Salary Range**

**($75,000 - $80,000) annual base salary**

**An employee’s pay position within the salary range will be based on several factors, including but not limited to, relevant education, qualifications, certifications, experience, skills, seniority, geographic location, performance, travel requirements, revenue-based metrics, any contractual agreements, and business or organizational needs. The range listed is just one component of Great Wolf’s total compensation package. Other rewards may include annual bonuses, a Paid Time Off policy, and other perks.**

**How to Apply**

We are actively hiring, with relocation packages available.

**Click “Apply Now**” or chat with a recruiter at the bottom of your screen on Great Wolf Lodge’s website. Once your application is submitted, a recruiter will review your experience and reach out with next steps.

**EEO**

These regulations prohibit discrimination against qualified individuals based on their status as protected veterans or individuals with disabilities, and prohibit discrimination against all individuals based on their race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, and for inquiring about, discussing or disclosing compensation. Moreover, these regulations require that covered prime contractors and subcontractors take affirmative action to employ and advance in employment individuals without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability or veteran status*

1e676bf7db385efaebb2.title: Practice Coordinator, Specialty Care
1e676bf7db385efaebb2.description:
**Join the team leading the next evolution of virtual care.**

At Teladoc Health, you are empowered to bring your true self to work while helping millions of people live their healthiest lives.

Here you will be part of a high-performance culture where colleagues embrace challenges, drive transformative solutions, and create opportunities for growth. Together, we’re transforming how better health happens.

**Summary of Position**

  

The Practice Coordinator will report directly to the Practice Manager, providing direct administrative and project support for our growing 24/7 telemedicine practices. Primary responsibilities will be coordinating physician schedules, patient rescheduling, referral, and prior authorization support, assisting in implementation and roll out of new product offerings and ensuring that staff physicians feel supported in their day-to-day role in virtual healthcare. The candidate will work closely with stakeholders across Teladoc Health, including Provider Relations, Physician Credentialing, Planning and Delivery as well as the Clinical Operations Care Team.

**Essential Duties and Responsibilities**

* Monitors providers’ schedules to ensure that physicians maximize opportunities for efficient patient scheduling and timely patient flow in a virtual care setting. Schedules/Reschedule Physician clinics as needed.

* Aids in referral management and billing processes. Act as a resource for clinicians and Care Team staff. Obtains referrals as instructed by providers; completes prior authorizations as needed.

* Provides administrative and technical support to physicians for CME (Continuing Medical Education), financial reimbursement, licensing as well as other admin tasks as assigned.

* Answers provider requests and/or escalate provider requests appropriately to ensure physician receive timely information to concerns.

* Supports new physician onboarding by closely monitoring the credentialing and training progress to assure candidate is successfully processed internally by start date.

* Partners with credentialing team to stay ahead of physician license approvals, renewals, and expirations to ensure there is not a lapse in physicians' ability to provide care.

* Provides ongoing feedback to manager regarding training needs, physician performance and process improvement.

* Assists operations leadership and medical director with department staff meeting agendas, and maintains attendance, minutes and follow up items.

* Participates in performance improvement projects and may perform other similar and related duties as required.

* Comply with company policies and procedures.

* Other duties, as needed.

The time spent on each responsibility reflects an estimate and is subject to change dependent on business needs.

**Qualifications Expected for Position**

* High School Diploma required, Bachelor's degree preferred
* 2-4 years' experience in related industry
* 2-4 years of healthcare experience required, or direct experience working in an healthcare environment
* Position relies heavily upon communication; must have excellent oral and written communication skills to succeed
* Customer service oriented
* Previous experience directly supporting physicians
* Ability to function in a fast-paced environment and to be able to meet deadlines
* Must be well-organized and a self-motivator
* Works well with others and is a team player
* Interacts effectively with staff, employees, managers, and physicians
* Must be able to generate reports and documents

The above qualifications, knowledge, experience, and/or background are expected but not required for this role.

The rate for this position is $25/hourly. In addition to your hourly rate, this position is eligible for a performance bonus and benefits (subject to eligibility requirements) listed here: Teladoc Health Benefits 2026 . Total compensation is based on several factors including, but not limited to, type of position, location, education level, work experience, and certifications. This information is applicable for all full-time positions.

  

During your first year of service, you will accrue 5.84 hours of PTO for each bi-weekly pay period. In addition, you will receive 80 hours of Paid Sick, Safe, and Caregiver Leave annually. This applies to full-time positions only. If you are applying for a part-time role, your recruiter can provide additional details.

  

As part of our hiring process, we verify identity and credentials, conduct interviews (live or video), and screen for fraud or misrepresentation. Applicants who falsify information will be disqualified.

  

**We’ve been alerted that scammers will sometimes impersonate our employees and make fictitious job offers.** The only official email address domain used by Teladoc Health is “@teladochealth.com,” and we are only recruiting for the positions listed below. Additionally, we will never ask you to send any payment to our company or employees, and all Teladoc Health equipment is provided at no charge to our employees. If you have been contacted by any other email domain, offered a position that’s not on our website, or received any other suspicious communication, please do not engage, mark the email as phishing and file a report at https://reportfraud.ftc.gov/ .

  

Teladoc Health will not sponsor or transfer employment work visas for this position. Applicants must be currently authorized to work in the United States without the need for visa sponsorship now or in the future.

  

**Why join Teladoc Health?**

* Teladoc Health is transforming how better health happens. Learn how when you join us in pursuit of our impactful mission .
* Chart your career path with **meaningful opportunities** that empower you to grow, lead, and make a difference.
* Join a **multi-faceted community** that celebrates each colleague’s unique perspective and is focused on continually improving, each and every day.

Explore candidate resources with tips and tricks from Teladoc Health recruiters and learn more about our company culture by exploring #TeamTeladocHealth on LinkedIn .

In our innovative and inclusive workplace, we prohibit discrimination and harassment of any kind.*

In furtherance of your employment relationship with Teladoc Health, we collect personal information responsibly and in accordance with applicable data privacy laws, including but not limited to, the California Consumer Privacy Act (CCPA). Personal information is defined as: Any information or set of information relating to you, including (a) all information that identifies you or could reasonably be used to identify you, and (b) all information that any applicable law treats as personal information. ***SOLV Energy is a leading provider of infrastructure services to the power industry, designing, building and maintaining utility scale solar, battery storage and high voltage substation projects nationwide.***

**Job Description Summary:**

The Contract Specialist will efficiently manage and coordinate all aspects of the contract lifecycle, including review and administration of contracts for either (i) the engineering, procurement, and construction (EPC) contracting group (including PV, BESS and HV), or (ii) the operation and maintenance (Services) contracting group, as applicable, in relation to utility-scale projects. This role serves as a key liaison between Contracts, Legal, Pre-Construction, Business Development and other internal teams, ensuring timely and accurate contract processing, while mitigating risk and supporting business objectives.  
  
This role is fully remote. Specific location details and expectations will be discussed during the interview process.

**Job Description:**

* *This job description reflects management's assignment of essential functions; it does not prescribe or restrict the tasks that may be assigned*

* Upload client agreements into contracting software and conduct initial review of client agreements, assisting in identifying problematic provisions. Coordinate contract review processes with Contracts, Legal, Pre-Construction, Operations, Risk, and other stakeholders.

* Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively across departments and with external stakeholders.
* Commitment to ethical conduct, integrity, and professionalism.
