HIRING: REAL ESTATE OPERATIONS MANAGER

Remote | $100,000–$120,000 Base Salary | High-Growth Leadership Opportunity

This is not a traditional 9-to-5 job.

We're looking for an exceptionally intelligent, resourceful, ambitious, and hardworking individual who wants to dedicate an intense season of their life to building something extraordinary.

Someone who doesn't simply want a comfortable job, complete their assigned tasks, and collect a paycheck.

We want someone who wants to become an exceptional operator, solve difficult problems, take on enormous responsibility, and build a career with extraordinary earning potential.

If you're someone who wants to go all-in on your career for the next several years, rapidly accelerate your professional development, and help build one of the largest home-buying companies in the United States, this opportunity may be exactly what you're looking for.

We're willing to pay exceptionally well for exceptional people.

ABOUT OUR COMPANY

Top Choice Cash Offers is a rapidly growing nationwide real estate investment company.

Over approximately the past year, we've grown from $30,000/month to approximately $200,000/month in revenue.

Our next goal: $500,000–$1,000,000/month in revenue within the next year.

Our long-term vision is to become the largest home-buying company in the United States.

We're building an organization that moves fast, solves complicated problems, and consistently out-executes the competition.

Our growth has created an opportunity for an exceptional individual to join our operations team, take ownership of increasingly important responsibilities, and eventually grow into a major leadership role.

We're looking for someone who wants to help build this company, not simply work for it.

OUR CULTURE: HIGH URGENCY. LOW DRAMA. EXTREME OWNERSHIP.

We have a young, highly ambitious, entrepreneurial leadership team.

We work hard, move quickly, hold ourselves accountable, and take our goals extremely seriously.

We believe there are seasons in life when someone can choose to go all-in on building their future.

Seasons where they're willing to prioritize their career, dedicate extraordinary effort to developing their abilities, and pursue opportunities most people aren't willing to pursue.

That's the culture we've built.

We aren't looking for everyone. We're looking for individuals who genuinely enjoy this kind of environment.

We don't glorify being busy for the sake of being busy. We care about meaningful output, intelligent execution, and measurable results.

Our expectations are high, but our environment isn't stiff or unnecessarily corporate.

We joke around, have fun, challenge each other's ideas, brainstorm solutions, and genuinely enjoy building the business together.

When problems arise, we don't panic, complain, or make excuses.

We stay calm, figure things out, and execute.

High urgency. Low drama. Extreme ownership.

THE PERSON WE'RE LOOKING FOR

We're looking for someone who:

* Is exceptionally intelligent, resourceful, and capable of figuring out unfamiliar problems without needing step-by-step instructions.

* Takes complete ownership of their responsibilities and follows through until problems are resolved.

* Has outstanding organization, attention to detail, and time-management skills.

* Thinks critically, makes sound decisions, and exercises excellent judgment.

* Communicates proactively, clearly, and confidently.

* Has strong written and spoken English.

* Is comfortable managing multiple complicated projects simultaneously.

* Has strong technological abilities and learns new software quickly.

* Remains composed and effective under pressure.

* Is extremely financially and professionally motivated.

* Actively identifies operational inefficiencies and opportunities for improvement.

* Is comfortable taking initiative and making decisions within their authority.

* Enjoys solving problems that don't have obvious answers.

* Has an unusually strong work ethic and genuinely enjoys working toward ambitious goals.

* Wants to become increasingly valuable, assume greater responsibility, and grow into leadership.

Most importantly, we want someone who thinks like an owner rather than someone waiting to be told what to do next.

When a problem comes up, you don't simply report it and wait.

You investigate, research, contact the right people, develop possible solutions, and take action.

You don't need to know everything.

You need to be exceptionally good at figuring things out.

YOUR RESPONSIBILITIES

This is a highly involved operations position within our nationwide real estate company.

Unlike a typical real estate transaction coordinator working within one local market, our team handles transactions across multiple states, counties, and jurisdictions.

Every transaction can bring new requirements, unfamiliar obstacles, and complicated situations.

We need someone capable of navigating these challenges independently and efficiently.

1. Nationwide Real Estate Transaction Operations

* Coordinate real estate transactions from executed contract through closing.

* Locate, evaluate, and establish relationships with title companies, escrow providers, and closing attorneys throughout the United States.

* Communicate with title companies, sellers, attorneys, and vendors to keep transactions moving forward.

* Track outstanding title requirements, documentation, deadlines, and closing obstacles.

* Research unfamiliar county-specific recording requirements and coordinate the recording of authorized documents, including memorandums of contract when applicable.

* Identify transaction problems early and proactively coordinate solutions.

* Organize and maintain accurate transaction records and closing documentation.

* Ensure outstanding issues receive consistent follow-up until resolved.

2. Property Marketing & Vendor Coordination

* Coordinate professional property photography, staging vendors when needed, and other marketing preparation.

* Locate and schedule mobile notaries and other service providers nationwide.

* Help determine what documentation, access arrangements, and preparation are necessary before marketing a property.

* Coordinate with sellers, vendors, and brokerage partners.

* Manage the submission of properties to our listing and marketing partners.

* Ensure properties move through the marketing preparation process efficiently.

3. Internal Operations & Organization

* Maintain accurate CRM records and transaction pipelines.

* Track company KPIs, operational data, deadlines, and performance metrics.

* Manage spreadsheets, dashboards, documentation, and internal follow-up systems.

* Identify overdue tasks, stalled transactions, and preventable operational delays.

* Assist with GoHighLevel, automation tools, and operational software.

* Maintain organized processes and clear communication across departments.

4. Problem-Solving & Special Projects

This is one of the most important parts of the job.

You will regularly encounter situations that don't have an existing step-by-step procedure.

For example:

Scenario 1: A title company cannot handle a complicated transaction in an unfamiliar state.

You independently research alternatives, contact qualified providers, compare their capabilities, and coordinate a solution.

Scenario 2: A property requires a document to be recorded in a county we've never worked in before.

You research the county's requirements, communicate with the appropriate professionals, and coordinate the necessary steps to get it handled correctly.

Scenario 3: A property needs professional photography within 48 hours, but we don't have an existing photographer in the area.

You find qualified photographers, arrange the appointment, coordinate property access, and ensure everything gets completed.

Scenario 4: A transaction has been stalled for two weeks due to an unresolved title problem.

You investigate what's causing the delay, identify the appropriate parties, coordinate next steps, and ensure the issue receives consistent attention.

We don't want someone who simply identifies problems. We want someone who drives solutions.

LONG-TERM GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES

As you demonstrate your abilities and develop a deeper understanding of our business, your responsibilities can expand significantly.

Potential future responsibilities include:

* Taking ownership of major operational processes.

* Improving systems and eliminating inefficiencies.

* Building and implementing new SOPs.

* Developing operational automation.

* Recruiting, interviewing, and onboarding new employees.

* Managing projects and eventually leading team members.

* Helping build new departments.

* Supporting leadership with company-wide growth initiatives.

* Helping create the infrastructure necessary to scale our company nationally.

We want someone who eventually looks at the business and asks:

"What's preventing us from growing faster, and how can I help solve it?"

Not simply:

"What's my next assignment?"

COMPENSATION & CAREER OPPORTUNITY

Starting Base Salary: $100,000–$120,000 USD annually.

Starting compensation depends on demonstrated experience, capabilities, and the scope of responsibilities.

Additional performance-based bonuses or incentive compensation may be available based on agreed-upon performance goals.

As your responsibilities expand and your contributions become increasingly valuable, there will be opportunities to discuss significant compensation increases.

We're not looking for the cheapest employee.

We're looking for someone whose performance creates exceptional value for the company.

We believe the people who help build and scale our organization should have opportunities to benefit meaningfully from its success.

Our goal is to develop long-term relationships with exceptional individuals who grow alongside the company.

WORK SCHEDULE & EXPECTATIONS

Please read this section carefully before applying.

This position is for someone seeking an unusually ambitious, high-effort career opportunity.

The initial schedule is expected to be approximately 40–50 hours per week, with availability aligned to U.S. Eastern Time business operations.

As the company grows, responsibilities and demands may increase substantially.

Our leadership team's culture is built around the willingness to work exceptionally hard during periods of rapid growth, including the possibility of 60–80-hour workweeks during intense building phases.

We're particularly interested in individuals who are genuinely excited about the possibility of taking on that level of commitment during a season of their career.

Such extended schedules are not the standard starting requirement. Any changes in working hours, responsibilities, and compensation would be discussed in advance, mutually agreed upon, and structured in compliance with applicable wage-and-hour laws, including overtime requirements where applicable.

We understand this career path isn't for everyone.

Some people prioritize predictable hours and a traditional work-life balance. We respect that.

But we're specifically looking for people who are currently in a season of life where they want to invest extraordinary effort into developing their abilities, building something meaningful, and accelerating their professional and financial growth.

We care about exceptional results, not simply the number of hours someone works.

We believe hard work, intelligent execution, and increasing responsibility should create increasing opportunities.

If that excites you, you'll likely fit our culture extremely well.

QUALIFICATIONS

Strongly Preferred

* Experience in real estate operations, transaction coordination, title, escrow, investment operations, or complex project management.

* Demonstrated experience coordinating multiple projects, vendors, and deadlines.

* Strong problem-solving abilities and independent judgment.

* Excellent organization and written communication.

* Proficiency with spreadsheets, CRM platforms, and business software.

* Experience improving processes and increasing operational efficiency.

Highly Valued

* Experience with nationwide real estate transactions.

* Familiarity with real estate wholesaling, novations, or investment transactions.

* Experience with GoHighLevel.

* Experience coordinating title, escrow, notaries, attorneys, and property vendors.

* Leadership potential and previous experience managing teams or complex operational workflows.

Exceptional demonstrated ability matters more to us than a particular degree or job title.

We're open to outstanding candidates from other industries who can demonstrate the necessary capabilities.

OUR EXPECTATIONS

Our standards are extremely high.

We expect:

* Urgency without unnecessary panic.

* Ownership without constant supervision.

* Accuracy without repeated reminders.

* Communication before problems escalate.

* Creative thinking rather than excuses.

* Solutions rather than unnecessary complexity.

* Continuous improvement rather than complacency.

This is not the right opportunity for someone who needs every task clearly explained before taking action.

We're looking for someone who enjoys responsibility, thrives on challenges, and wants to continuously raise the standard of their work.

OUR HIRING PROCESS

We're extremely selective about the people who join our team.

Our hiring process includes:

Step 1 — Written Application

Complete our application form so we can better understand your experience, capabilities, and goals.

Step 2 — Practical Screening Exercise

Qualified applicants will complete a short exercise designed to evaluate judgment, resourcefulness, and independent problem-solving.

Step 3 — Paid Skills Assessment

Selected candidates will complete a paid, realistic operations assessment.

Step 4 — Final Interview

Meet with our leadership team to discuss your experience, expectations, and long-term career goals.

Step 5 — Paid Working Trial

Finalists may be invited to participate in a paid working trial to evaluate real-world fit and performance.

We care far more about what you can actually accomplish than how impressive your resume sounds.

HOW TO APPLY

If you're exceptionally driven, resourceful, ambitious, and excited about the opportunity to help build a nationwide real estate company, we want to hear from you.

Apply using the link below:

https://form.jotform.com/263214751308049

Only applicants who complete the application will be considered for the next stage.

We're not looking for someone who wants just another job.

We're looking for someone who wants to help build something extraordinary.

Pay: $100,000.00 - $120,000.00 per year

Work Location: Remote

Penn Medicine is dedicated to our tripartite mission of providing the highest level of care to patients, conducting innovative research, and educating future leaders in the field of medicine. Working for this leading academic medical center means collaboration with top clinical, technical and business professionals across all disciplines.  
  
Today at Penn Medicine, someone will make a breakthrough. Someone will heal a heart, deliver hopeful news, and give comfort and reassurance. Our employees shape our future each day. Are you living your life's work?

**Pennsylvania Hospital | 800 Spruce Street, Philadelphia, PA**

Penn Medicine is seeking a Surgical Services Associate to support the Neurosurgery practice at Pennsylvania Hospital. This position serves as a key point of contact for patients, providers, and clinical staff, coordinating both outpatient and surgical care activities within a busy academic practice. The Surgical Services Associate plays an important role in ensuring patients receive timely, organized, and efficient care throughout their treatment journey.

Responsibilities

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned patients, providing exceptional customer service and support.
* Coordinate outpatient appointments, diagnostic testing, surgical procedures, and hospital admissions.
* Schedule surgeries and ensure all required pre-operative testing, imaging, laboratory work, and documentation are completed.
* Obtain authorizations for procedures and medications as required.
* Process medication refill requests and route them to appropriate clinical staff.
* Retrieve, manage, and process medical records and imaging studies.
* Submit and maintain accurate operative case information for operating room scheduling.
* Coordinate surgical cases with medical equipment representatives as needed.
* Answer and screen phone calls, respond to patient inquiries, and route messages appropriately.
* Maintain physician schedules, clinic calendars, meetings, and surgery schedules.
* Assist with medical record requests and physician correspondence.
* Support billing processes by ensuring operative reports and encounter forms are submitted within established timeframes.
* Provide coverage for team members during absences and staffing shortages.
* Perform additional duties as assigned to support practice operations.

Minimum Qualifications

* High School Diploma or GED required.
* Two (2) or more years of medical office experience or two (2) years of customer service experience.
* Related clinical office experience required.
* An Associate's, Bachelor's, or Master's degree may be considered in lieu of experience.

Preferred Qualifications

* Customer service experience in a healthcare setting.
* Insurance verification experience in a healthcare setting.

Skills & Qualifications

* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Strong technical and computer skills.
* Strong attention to detail and organizational skills.
* Critical thinking and problem-solving abilities.
* Ability to work independently and collaboratively in a team environment.
* Commitment to maintaining patient confidentiality.
* Strong patient-focused customer service skills.

  
We believe that the best care for our patients starts with the best care for our employees. Our employee benefits programs help our employees get healthy and stay healthy. * Perform other duties as assigned to support operational and organizational needs.

About the Opportunity

Do you enjoy figuring out how things work and helping others solve problems? We're looking for a dependable, customer-oriented individual to join our software support team.

In this position, you'll work directly with customers who rely on technology to manage their daily title and closing operations. You'll help answer questions, investigate reported issues, and guide users toward solutions.

We're especially interested in individuals who have worked with **TitleFusion, Closers' Choice, Landtech**, or similar title production software. Whether your experience comes from working in a title office or providing software support, your industry knowledge could make you a great addition to our team.

We recognize that candidates bring different levels of experience and technical knowledge. Depending on qualifications, individuals with advanced title industry or software support experience may be considered for opportunities with additional responsibilities and compensation appropriate to their experience.

What You'll Be Doing

As a member of our customer support team, you'll assist title professionals with software functionality, account access, documentation, and general application questions. Your work will involve both direct customer interaction and collaboration with internal teams to address technical concerns and maintain accurate system information.

Your responsibilities will include:

* Responding to customer inquiries by phone and email regarding software functionality and application issues.
* Researching reported problems, identifying possible causes, and guiding customers through appropriate solutions.
* Creating and removing user accounts, maintaining access permissions, and assisting with password resets.
* Participating in software testing to identify issues and evaluate new features or enhancements.
* Helping customers understand changes to software functionality and available features.
* Reviewing, formatting, proofreading, and organizing documents used within the applications.
* Updating state-specific forms, underwriter information, and other documentation as needed.
* Tracking regulatory, rate, and procedural changes that may require updates to the software.
* Communicating programming requests and identified issues to the development team through established DevOps procedures.
* Maintaining accurate records of customer communications, documentation updates, and outstanding requests.

What We're Looking For

We're looking for someone who is patient, resourceful, and comfortable working through unfamiliar situations. You'll need to balance multiple requests, communicate clearly, and know when to investigate an issue further or involve another team member.

**Qualifications:**

* High school diploma or GED required.
* Two or more years of experience in customer service, technical assistance, or a related position preferred.
* Previous experience in title insurance, settlement services, real estate closings, or a related industry strongly preferred.
* Familiarity with title production systems such as TitleFusion, Closers' Choice, Landtech, SoftPro, ResWare, or similar applications is highly desirable.
* Understanding of title commitments, closing documents, policies, and related workflows is a plus.
* Strong communication skills, both written and verbal.
* Ability to explain software functions and technical information in a way customers can easily understand.
* Confidence navigating web-based applications, websites, email, and multiple software platforms.
* Proficiency with Microsoft Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
* Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage competing priorities.
* Experience maintaining customer relationships and providing thoughtful, professional service.
* Ability to research problems, document findings, and recognize when an issue requires additional technical assistance.

What Makes Someone Successful in This Role?

The right person doesn't need to know the answer to every question immediately. What matters is having the curiosity to investigate, the patience to work through a problem, and the communication skills to help customers feel supported along the way.

If you enjoy combining customer service with technology and have experience in the title industry, we'd like to hear from you.

Job Type: Full-time

Pay: $40,000.00 - $50,000.00 per year

Benefits:

* 401(k) matching
* Dental insurance
* Health insurance
* Paid time off
* Parental leave
* Referral program

* real estate title software : 3 years (Required)

eb487155b95985af4d64.title: Remote WFH Response Associate, Roadside Assistance (CSR)
eb487155b95985af4d64.description:
#### **About Agero:**

#### Wherever drivers go, we're leading the way. Agero's mission is to rethink the vehicle ownership experience through a powerful combination of passionate people and data-driven technology, strengthening our clients' relationships with their customers. As the #1 B2B, white-label provider of digital driver assistance services, we're pushing the industry in a new direction, taking manual processes, and redefining them as digital, transparent, and connected. This includes: an industry-leading dispatch management platform powered by Swoop; comprehensive accident management services; knowledgeable consumer affairs and connected vehicle capabilities; and a growing marketplace of services, discounts and support enabled by a robust partner ecosystem. The company has over 150 million vehicle coverage points in partnership with leading automobile manufacturers, insurance carriers and many others. Managing one of the largest national networks of service providers, Agero responds to approximately 12 million service events annually. Agero, a member company of The Cross Country Group, is headquartered in Medford, Mass., with operations throughout North America. To learn more, visit https://www.agero.com/.

**Note:** **For our technical positions, we love to get you started in person! You may be required to travel to Medford for your initial onboarding. Don't worry about the logistics - once you're hired, we handle all travel arrangements and expenses for you.**

  

**Role Description and Mission: The Job & Why It Matters**

**Are you a quick-thinking problem solver who thrives on helping others in their time of need? Do you want to make a real difference and have a lasting impact on customers?**

Agero is actively seeking **Remote Response Associates** to join our **Roadside Assistance** department, where you will help rescue stranded customers off the side of the road. When a vehicle breaks down, you are the driver's first point of contact. Taking real-time inbound calls from motorists across the U.S., you will be the calming voice that turns an unpredictable, highly stressful situation into a solved problem. You will provide a clear roadmap of what they can expect next, guiding them through an urgent and unplanned event. Just like an everyday superhero, you are stepping in to save their day and get their plans back on track!

As a **Remote Response Associate**, you serve as a lifeline for customers facing roadside emergencies such as flat tires, lockouts, dead batteries, fuel deliveries, and towing due to mechanical failures. Because customers often reach out feeling overwhelmed or unsafe on the side of the road, in dark parking lots, or while traveling in unfamiliar areas, you will manage these high-stress situations with calm, empathetic guidance and consistent reassurance.

Leading with a customer-first mindset, you will coordinate directly with external service providers to ensure the accurate and rapid dispatch of tow trucks and service vehicles. Your ability to stay calm and make quick decisions under pressure directly impacts customer safety, satisfaction, and our reputation for service excellence as a trusted, industry-leading roadside provider.

  

**Key Outcomes:** **What you'll do**

* **Handle High-Volume Calls:** Gather essential details regarding location and vehicle issues to dispatch assistance quickly for stranded motorists in real-time.
* **Dispatch with Accuracy:** Coordinate efficiently with external service providers to ensure the right help arrives at the right time.
* **De-escalate & Support:** Use active listening and empathy to calm frustrated or anxious customers, navigating heightened emotions during uncertain situations.
* **Navigate Digital Tools:** Utilize multiple web-based systems and dispatch tools simultaneously to track service progress accurately.
* **Excel in a Virtual Team:** Thrive in a performance-driven remote environment, collaborating with peers and managers via Zoom and Google Chat.

  

**Skills, Education, & Experience:** **What We're Looking For**

This isn't your typical, script-reading customer service role. We have a high bar for talent because our drivers need real help in real-time. Every single call involves a stressful situation - some customers will be panicking, others might be crying, and many won't even know exactly where they are stranded. To succeed here, you need to bring your A-game every shift, every call.

**Here are the skills you'll bring to the team:**

* **Empathy in Action:** You have a natural ability to genuinely understand what a stranded driver is going through. You can authentically connect with people, stay patient, validate their fears, and give them the real reassurance they need when they are stuck in a dark parking lot or on a busy highway.
* **Effective Communication & Listening:** True communication starts with listening. You need to actively listen to absorb the critical details from a worried caller, ask the right questions, and probe for missing information. From there, you'll use a steady, confident voice to give clear directions to our roadside partners and explain the next steps to the customer so they feel completely guided.
* **Sound Judgment Under Pressure:** You don't fold when things get chaotic. You can keep a cool head, think clearly, and make smart, fast decisions during unpredictable events. You are comfortable thinking outside the box to solve problems safely, but you also have the awareness to know exactly when a situation needs to be escalated for extra help.
* **Problem-Solving & De-escalation:** You bring a calm, professional attitude to every interaction. You have a knack for turning a stressful, negative situation into a smooth, positive experience by focused problem-solving.
* **Multitasking Mastery:** You thrive in a fast-paced environment where no two calls are identical. You can comfortably talk to a stranded driver or a tow provider while simultaneously typing detailed notes, navigating multiple screens, and pulling resources from our system without breaking your focus.
* **Service Excellence:** We leave no one stranded. You take total ownership of every single call and call-back. You don't just check a box or process a dispatch; you focus on the person behind the problem, ensuring both our customers and our roadside partners get high-quality, accurate, and timely support.
* **Tech Proficiency:** You are comfortable working with digital tools and fast-paced systems. You can confidently navigate online databases, CRMs, and complex dispatch software all at once. You are familiar with and comfortable using AI tools, a pro at using Google Maps to pinpoint exact locations, fluent in Google Workspace (Gmail, Docs, Sheets, Chat), and can type at least 30 WPM accurately without breaking the flow of a live conversation.
* **Accountability & Reliability:** Even in a remote environment, we hold our team to a high standard and operate a structured contact center with top-tier client expectations. select a dedicated production schedule with set days off. We require your consistent commitment to this schedule because a stranded driver is counting on you when you are on the clock. At the same time, due to the nature of our business, things move fast. Call volumes spike, schedules adjust, teams shift, and supervisors change - meaning you must be highly adaptable and ready to pivot.

  

**Position Requirements:**

* **Location:** You must currently physically reside in Alabama, Arizona, Florida, Georgia, Mississippi, Missouri, Tennessee, or Virginia.

We also love and look for transferable skills from retail, fast-food, hospitality, administrative, or warehouse/production environments!
* **Background Check:** You must successfully pass a comprehensive criminal background screening (covering 10 years for misdemeanors and a lifetime check for felonies) to protect customer security and client integrity.
* **Workspace Needs:** You must have a dedicated, quiet home office setup completely free from family, pet, or background noise. Associates are responsible for providing their own work equipment.

  

**Remote Technology Requirements (BYOD):**

To ensure you can support stranded drivers without technical lag, your home office setup must meet these exact specifications. We will verify your system using the Harver System Checker during the application process.

**Your PC & Equipment Setup:**

* **Computer:** A personal desktop or laptop manufactured in 2021 or later. Chromebooks, Macs, and tablets are not allowed.
* **Operating System:** A current, supported version of Windows 11 (specifically version 24H2, 25H2, or newer). *Important Note: Microsoft has discontinued support for older Windows 11 versions, so you must be updated to be eligible.*
* **Processor:** Intel or AMD with 2+ cores, minimum 3.5 GHz (boosted/turbo speed).
* **Memory & Storage:** Minimum 8 GB RAM and at least 20 GB of free hard drive space.
* **Peripherals:** A working webcam (used for training & company meetings) and a high-quality USB-wired headset. Dual monitors are not required, but may be used if preferred.
* **Browser:** Google Chrome (version 23+) or Mozilla Firefox (version 3+).
* **Hardwired Internet:** A secure, hard-wired high-speed connection hooked directly into your router (modem) via an Ethernet cable. Wi-Fi is absolutely not allowed while working.
* **Required Internet Speeds:** Minimum **25 Mbps download** / 1**0 Mbps upload**. Maximum **latency up to 80ms–100ms**.
* **Mobile Device:** An active cell phone capable of receiving SMS text messages and downloading security apps for our mandatory two-step authentication process.

**What Will NOT Work (Incompatible Setups):**

* **Work-Issued PCs:** You must have full Administrator privileges to install our tools. Devices owned by previous employers and schools have strict security locks and cannot be used.
* **Incompatible Devices:** MacBooks, iPads, iMacs, Chromebooks, Surface Pro/Go, Samsung Notebooks, or any machines built before 2020.
* **Incompatible Connections:** Mobile hotspots, Wi-Fi, satellite internet, or USB phone tethering.
* **Banned Software:** Active VPNs, privacy/proxy services, or hosted/virtual PC platforms.
* **Unsupported OS:** All versions of Windows 10 and older, expired versions of Windows 11.

  

**Pay, Benefits, & Career Growth:**

* **Premium Shift Differentials & Incentives:** Boost your earnings with an **extra $1.75 to $2.50 per hour** **in shift differentials for working evenings, nights, and weekends.** You also have direct access to monthly performance and attendance bonuses, plus regular overtime opportunities based on business needs, and scheduled raises through merit increases.
* **Comprehensive Benefits Package:** We have you covered. Enjoy a full suite of medical, dental, and vision insurance options, a 401(k) program with a company match, Paid Time Off (PTO), tuition reimbursement, Employee Assistance Program (EAP), referral bonus program, complimentary roadside assistance, and more.
* **A Clear Path Upward:** We invest heavily in your future. You will have direct access to online skill-building courses, professional mentorship, and cross-training programs designed to give you the exact expertise you need to climb the ladder and fast-track your career at Agero.

This job is responsible for identifying training and development needs for our Customer Service call center reps, servicing multiple clients. The Associate Quality Assurance Coordinator focuses on improving individual performance and the overall customer experience through call monitoring, side-by-side coaching, client call calibrations, and monitoring quality results.

**What will be my duties and responsibilities in this job?**

* Identify QA deficiencies through root cause analysis
* Partner with Training and Management to identify programs that reduce errors and improve both individual and department results
* Develop tools, resources, and job aids to improve individual and overall results
* Balance priorities to achieve deadlines and key target expectations
* Provide statistical data and patterns of top errors by client and department

* Ability to work with various skill sets, personalities, and working styles
* Work in conjunction with the Call Center Management team to improve the overall associate and department QA scores
* Attend and provide feedback for internal/external client calibration sessions for Customer Care
* Complete monthly side by side & silent monitoring based on established KPI’s
* Maintain positive, productive, and effective relationships with management and call center employees
* Liaison both internally and externally with clients, management, associates, and quality assurance
* Review and evaluate claim decisions

* 3 years related experience for quality assurance in any industry
* Intermediate skill level in Microsoft Office (Excel, Word, and PowerPoint
* Ability to quickly develop rapport with clients and/or customers over the phone in a professional and friendly manner
* Ability to work in a fast-paced metric driven environment with proficient multitasking and navigation in a Windows environment
* Strong analytical skills
* General knowledge of QA systems and tools preferred

1b46d5147f71f8215fb7.description:
Huron helps its clients drive growth, enhance performance and sustain leadership in the markets they serve. We collaborate with education organizations to develop strategies and implement solutions that enable the transformative change our clients need to own their future. Together, we empower clients to drive innovation, create sustainable funding streams and deliver better student outcomes.  
  
Today, leaders of higher education institutions and academic medical centers are spending too much time reacting to market forces, rather than focusing on the essential priorities that help students, faculty and staff thrive. The most productive path forward requires an intentional approach and innovative thinking, whereby stakeholders across the entire institution rally around a shared vision and embrace the hard work of effecting change.  
  
You’ll help our clients to achieve organizational effectiveness, improve student outcomes, implement new technologies and align resources and investments to ensure long-term sustainability.  
  
Join our team as the expert you are now and create your future.

The purpose of this role is to support Education and Research business leaders in their sales efforts by leading the preparation of proposals, presentation materials, and other sales content. Acting as a strategic partner, this individual will help improve overall quality, drive alignment and accountability across pursuit teams, and ensure all deliverables are completed on time and to the highest standard.  
With a primary focus on managing the proposal and orals (PowerPoint) development process in response to RFI/RFP opportunities, this individual will work efficiently, apply strong project management discipline, and leverage additional resources when appropriate (e.g., shared services, offshore, bench resources, etc.). This role will also apply AI-driven tools and data insights to optimize pursuit processes, enhance content quality, streamline production, and improve win rates.  
In addition, the individual will contribute to content management for the Education and Research industry—harvesting new materials, tagging and uploading assets into the content management system, and ensuring sales materials remain current, easily searchable, and ready for use by pursuit teams.

***Key Responsibilities:***

* Manage Education & Research RFP and orals pursuits: Lead the end-to-end pursuit process—from kick-off through submission and client presentation. Coordinate pursuit teams, manage timelines, and ensure strategic alignment and delivery of professional, brand-compliant materials.
* Leverage AI and technology: Use AI-driven tools and data insights to streamline pursuit management, enhance proposal/orals quality, and improve win rates. Identify opportunities to automate, analyze, and optimize content and processes.
* Facilitate strategic deal discussions: Partner with leaders to define win themes, capture differentiators, and incorporate competitive intelligence into pursuit strategies and deliverables.
* Ensure Salesforce data accuracy: Manage workload effectively while maintaining data integrity, compliance, and timely updates in Salesforce to support accurate pipeline tracking and reporting.
* Govern sales content and best practices: Curate, tag, and maintain proposal content in Seismic; help establish review cycles and drive adoption of best practices and tools across the team.
* Drive continuous improvement: Gather feedback, develop tools and training, and champion process improvements to enhance pursuit effectiveness and team performance.
* Assist in triaging requests, aligning support, replying and interfacing with our internal clients on a timely basis.

***Related Experience & Core Competencies***

* **3–5 years of experience in a B2B or professional services environment.**
* Demonstrated success managing complex proposal, RFP, and orals processes from planning through delivery.
* Strong writing, editing, and PowerPoint skills with exceptional attention to detail and brand consistency.
* Proven ability to partner effectively with senior leaders and cross-functional teams across varying leadership styles and availability.
* Experience with Salesforce, Seismic, Microsoft Teams/SharePoint, or similar tools.
* Knowledge of AI tools and emerging technologies that support business development is a plus.
* Strong executive presence and professional communication skills, with the ability to influence and build trust at all levels.
* Rigorous focus on quality, accuracy, and deadline management.
* Excellent customer service orientation, with strong communication and collaboration skills.
* Strong critical thinking, analytical, and problem-solving abilities.
* CST Time Zone preferred

92b7a9f973b943b5a96f.description:
**Health Coach Institute is looking for** **Inside Sales Reps for the Health Coach (HCI) Course****!**

**KEY INFO!**

* **PLEASE NOTE: We are currently hiring for our (January) class.**
* **Compensation:** **Base salary of $50,000**, with an uncapped commission structure bringing your On-Target Earnings **(OTE) to $100,000.**
* Free Enrollment in the Health Coach Course on Day 1!
* Must reside in an ISSA-eligible state (AZ, UT, NV, ID, TX, IL, IN, WI, TN, GA, FL, SC, NC, VA)
* Core business hours are 6 am to 6 pm M-F AZ Time. If you live in another time zone, the flexibility to work a schedule within our core business hours is critical. (For example, some shifts may end at 9 pm Eastern.) Additionally, this is a work-to-goal environment, so you can work beyond this core shift to achieve your goals and earn more money!

**ISSA + Health Coach Institute: Expanding the Definition of Wellness Education**

For over 35 years, the International Sports Sciences Association (ISSA) has empowered hundreds of thousands of professionals to transform lives through science-based fitness, nutrition, and wellness education.

Now, through the integration of Health Coach Institute (HCI), a pioneer in habit change and life transformation, ISSA broadens its mission to include the art and science of coaching. Together, ISSA and HCI merge evidence-based training with mastery of behavior change, creating a complete ecosystem for holistic health professionals.

This partnership equips students not only to train the body but also to guide the mind—developing experts who help clients build sustainable habits, lasting motivation, and lifelong wellness.

Together, ISSA and HCI empower people to transform lives through science, education, and habit change.

We are adding an **Inside Sales Representative** to our team of relationship-builders who are laser-focused on providing exceptional service to our students. We are tenacious and resilient in our pursuit of personal and professional success, while we incorporate fun into every day!

**So What's the Job?**

We are looking for sales professionals who want to transform lives through health and fitness! Use our extensive knowledge of certifications and specializations to overcome objections, address prospect concerns, and convert warm leads into sales!

* **This role will be focused on selling our Health Coach (HCI) course.**
* Make up to 150 calls per day to prospective students (no cold calling!)
* Use discovery questions and rapport-building techniques to engage with students.
* Meet and exceed sales targets, including Monthly Revenue, Average Order Value, and Conversion Rate goals.

**WHAT is ISSA looking for?**

* A desire to promote and sell our Health Coach (HCI) course.
* At least 1 year of phone-based inside sales experience.
* Proven track record in high-ticket sales or managing premium product portfolios is preferred.
* Prior CRM experience.
* Enthusiastic and results-oriented with a proven track record in phone-based sales.
* Excellent phone-based communication skills.
* Personal passion for health, life, and nutrition coaching and desire to help others.
* Money motivated with a competitive nature that enjoys the grind of sales.
* Comfortable interacting with a diverse potential customer base.
* Ability to communicate and coach someone through their challenges and inspire them to take action despite their fears or roadblocks.
* Ability to build rapport, empathize, and make a personal connection with our prospective students.
* Ability to frame the enrollment/sales conversation as a powerful conversation to help someone bridge the gap from where they are to where they want to be.
* Describe the experience and attributes of the ideal candidate
* Comfortable learning and applying AI tools as part of daily work

**WHO is ISSA looking for?**

Skills can be developed. Experience can be built. What's harder to teach, and what we pay close attention to, is mindset. The qualifications below are specific to this role. But across every role at ISSA, we're looking for the same kind of person.

* Someone who leads with curiosity. Who asks "why do we do it this way?" as a genuine question, not a complaint.
* Someone humble enough to know what they don't know, and bold enough to challenge the way things have always been done.
* Someone who can advocate hard for an idea and then fully commit when the team goes a different direction.
* Someone who takes ownership of their mistakes, shares credit for their wins, and believes the best idea should win regardless of who had it.

We're looking for people who are personally invested in healthy living, not because it's their job, but because they believe in its power to change lives. You don't have to have it all figured out. You just have to care.

We're not looking for perfect. We're looking for growth-oriented, mission-driven, and genuinely invested in doing something that matters. If that sounds like you, you'll fit in great here!

**Anything else? Absolutely! Benefits and Perks:**

ISSA is a place where every day we are inspired by our teammates, encouraging each other to be our best. The environment is relaxed, friendly, and upbeat! And we feel it’s important to reward our team with competitive pay and benefits. Here are some of the highlights:

**Free Certifications:** Who wants to be their best self? WE DO! As an ISSA team member, you have access to our courses and certifications…at no expense! Additionally, you'll receive exclusive discounts on leading products in the fitness industry. Cool, right? After 90 days, employees can also enroll up to 5 friends/family members each year in our courses...FOR FREE!

**Health & Wellness Reimbursement:** If our company’s mission is to encourage healthy living, we need to walk the talk and ensure each employee is supported in their wellness journey! Employees can submit fitness purchases (gym membership, fitness equipment, classes) and professional and mental health purchases (personal learning courses, wellness apps, art classes, and more) for reimbursement up to $50/month…$600/year.

**Work-Life Synergy:** Our Team members have 3 weeks of PTO each year...this is accrued on a bi-weekly basis! And everyone at ISSA gets 9 paid national holidays every year...PLUS 1 floating holiday! Work hard, play hard!

**Parental Time Off:** We support our team members as they grow their families. Eligible employees giving birth can receive up to 12 weeks of paid leave, while other parents welcoming a new child (including partners and adoptive/foster parents) receive up to 6 weeks of paid bonding leave.

**Medical, Dental, and Vision Insurance:** A key component to living a healthy lifestyle is having access to the care we (and our families) need. We offer 2 medical insurance plans accompanied by Health savings account (HSA) and Flexible Savings Account (FSA) options, as well Dental and Vision coverage. And you don’t have to wait forever! Eligibility begins the 1st of the month after you start.

**Team Building:** We may be remote, but we don’t have to be alone! We host a monthly schedule of virtual team activities, town halls, brown bag lunches, and other special events…so many fun ways for us to connect and support one another.

**Tools To Do The Job:** We ensure you are hooked up with the tools, equipment, and systems you need. We begin the process before your start date, so you are ready to rock ‘n roll on your first day. We also provide a monthly work-from-home allowance!

**What Else?** We have a 401(k) company match and 100% company-paid life/AD&D insurance/short-term disability. We also offer an employee assistance program to assist with work-life concerns (legal, financial, and mental health). Our ultimate goal is to support you and your overall wellness.

**Transform your career at ISSA!**

f8ffce7ccc53c68abbc5.title: Customer Support Specialist
f8ffce7ccc53c68abbc5.description:
We are currently looking for a **Customer Service Specialist** to join us at our facility in **Glen Mills, PA**.

This role serves as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts, managing order fulfillment, demand visibility, customer communications, and supply continuity. The position partners closely with Sales, Supply Chain, Logistics, and Operations to analyze customer demand, resolve service issues, and support business decisions through data-driven insights.

### **Key Responsibilities**

* Serve as the primary point of contact for assigned customer accounts and manage day-to-day customer inquiries and order management.
* Process and coordinate customer orders from receipt through invoicing, ensuring accuracy and timely execution.
* Monitor customer demand, inventory, and service performance to identify trends, risks, and opportunities for improvement.
* Review, analyze, and interpret customer, operational, and business data to support informed decision-making.
* Prepare reports, identify key findings, and present data-driven insights and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.
* Partner with Supply Chain, Logistics, Operations, and Sales to resolve customer service, inventory, supply, and order-related issues.
* Communicate order status, inventory availability, supply updates, and other critical information to customers and internal stakeholders.
* Investigate and resolve customer complaints, order discrepancies, and invoicing issues.
* Maintain customer records, documentation, and compliance with company policies and procedures.
* Support process improvement initiatives that enhance customer satisfaction and operational efficiency.

### **Minimum Requirements**

* Bachelor's degree in Business, Supply Chain, Operations, Analytics, or a related field.
* Minimum 2 years of customer service, order management, supply chain, business operations, or administrative experience.
* Experience supporting customers within a manufacturing, chemical, industrial, or supply chain environment.
* Experience with SAP, Salesforce.com, or similar ERP and CRM systems.
* Intermediate to advanced proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including Pivot Tables, VLOOKUP/XLOOKUP functions, data analysis, and reporting.
* Experience analyzing data and translating findings into actionable recommendations.
* Ability to present data, business insights, and recommendations to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders.

### **Preferred Skills**

* Experience creating and analyzing KPIs, dashboards, reports, and business performance metrics to identify trends and develop recommendations.
* Interest in business analytics, demand planning, supply planning, or continuous improvement initiatives.
* Ability to communicate data-driven insights and influence decisions through effective collaboration with cross-functional teams and leadership.
* Ability to adapt and perform effectively in a dynamic business environment.

### **What We're Looking For**

* Customer-focused approach with a commitment to service excellence.
* Strong business acumen and analytical mindset.
* Confidence presenting information and recommendations to stakeholders at all levels.
* Ability to build relationships and collaborate across functions.
* Ownership, accountability, and follow-through.
* Ability to balance urgency, accuracy, and sound judgment.
* Continuous improvement mindset with a focus on results.

**Our Company:**

Axalta has remained at the forefront of the coatings industry by continually investing in innovative solutions. We engineer technologies that protect customers’ products – whether they are battling heat, light, corrosion, abrasion, moisture, or chemicals – and add dimension and beauty with colorful finishes. We have a vast and ever-evolving portfolio of brands primed to play an important part in everything from modernizing infrastructure around the world to enabling the next generation of electric and autonomous vehicles.

Axalta operates its business in two segments: Performance Coatings and Mobility Coatings, which serve four end markets, including Refinish, Industrial, Light Vehicle and Commercial Vehicle, across North America, EMEA, Latin America and Asia-Pacific. Our diverse global footprint allows us to deliver solutions in over 140+ countries and coat 30 million vehicles per year. We’ve recently set an exciting 2040 carbon neutrality goal, in addition to 10 other sustainability initiatives, and we take pride in working with our customers to optimize their businesses and achieve their goals.

Axalta may use technology-assisted tools, including artificial intelligence (AI), to support certain aspects of the recruitment and selection process. These tools may be used to help manage applications, identify job-related qualifications, and assist recruiter review. All hiring decisions involve human oversight and review.

**Recruitment Fraud Alert**: We take candidate safety seriously. If you believe you’ve encountered a fraudulent job posting claiming to represent our company, please include a link or screenshot and report it to TA-Support-Center@axalta.com.

We consider an individual’s qualifications, skillset, and experience to determine final salary. This role is eligible for benefits such as health insurance and paid time off. The actual offer will be at the company’s sole discretion and determined by relevant business considerations, including the final candidate’s qualifications, years of experience, skillset, and geographic location.

This is an active opening for which we are recruiting to fill immediately.

aea17587d67d60c609b8.title: Vice President, Customer Service Strategy & Assurance
aea17587d67d60c609b8.description:
Comcast brings together the best in media and technology. We drive innovation to create the world's best entertainment and online experiences. As a Fortune 50 leader, we set the pace in a variety of innovative and fascinating businesses and create career opportunities across a wide range of locations and disciplines. We are at the forefront of change and move at an amazing pace, thanks to our remarkable people, who bring cutting-edge products and services to life for millions of customers every day. If you share in our passion for teamwork, our vision to revolutionize industries and our goal to lead the future in media and technology, we want you to fast-forward your career at Comcast.  
**Job Summary**

The Vice President of Customer Service Strategy and Operations Implementation leads the strategy, performance management, and operational capabilities that enable a consistent, high-quality customer and employee experience across Customer Service Operations. This leader will translate enterprise priorities into actionable channel strategies, measurable performance outcomes, and coordinated execution across internal operations and business partners. The role oversees business planning and analytics, channel strategy and operational integration, performance and incentive programs, and the new hire Academy. Partnering closely with Operations, Finance, Technology, Workforce Management, Human Resources, and Compensation, this leader strengthens operational readiness, accelerates improvement, and ensures investments and programs deliver sustainable business results.

**Job Description**

**Responsibilities:**

**Enterprise Strategy and Operational Integration**

* Define and execute an integrated Operations Customer Service strategy that connects enterprise objectives with channel priorities, operating plans, and frontline execution.
* Lead strategic planning across Sales, Base Management, engagement models, and customer service channels, aligning initiatives to customer needs and business goals.
* Oversee the strategic initiative portfolio, establishing priorities, governance, decision rights, delivery commitments, and accountability for results.
* Assess operational impacts, risks, dependencies, and readiness requirements for enterprise initiatives, product changes, and technology enhancements.
* Sponsor test-and-learn initiatives and scalable solutions that simplify work, improve adoption, reduce repeat contacts, and strengthen customer experience.
* Lead executive operating forums and business reviews that accelerate decisions, resolve barriers, and maintain cross-functional alignment.

**Business Planning, Analytics, and Performance Governance**

* Partner with Finance, Operations and Shared Services on budgets, forecasts, and long-range plans, aligning resources and investments to performance, growth, and financial commitments.
* Establish balanced scorecards, performance targets, metric definitions, and measurement standards across internal operations and business partners.
* Set analytical priorities and reporting requirements, ensuring data integrity, consistent interpretation, and alignment with enterprise KPIs.
* Translate operational and financial results into clear insights, executive narratives, and actions that address performance gaps and emerging opportunities.
* Oversee business requirements, solution validation, and user acceptance testing for reporting, analytics, and operational tools.
* Evaluate initiative effectiveness, return on investment, and performance against budget and forecast to guide resource allocation and continuous improvement.

**Service Assurance, Routing, and Resource Optimization**

* Establish an integrated approach to monitoring service performance, identifying operational friction, and driving corrective actions across channels.
* Partner with Workforce Management on routing and queue strategies, including segmentation, overflow, backflow, and AI-enabled routing, to improve customer outcomes and resource utilization.
* Align routing plans, staffing requirements, and business partner site strategies with operational priorities and workforce planning cycles.
* Monitor service levels, abandonment, repeat contacts, conversion, and resource utilization, partnering with Operations to address gaps.
* Partner with Shared Service for business partner operational support, including onboarding, access, escalations, and invoice reconciliation for non-production hours.

**Performance, Incentives, and Recognition**

* Lead the design and governance of performance management frameworks, scorecards, and recognition programs that reinforce desired behaviors and business outcomes.
* Partner with Finance, Compensation, and Operations on targets, rate cards, performance thresholds, funding, and compensation alignment.
* Establish consistent eligibility, progression, measurement, and governance standards that support program integrity and effective execution.
* Oversee program deployment, change control, communications, and frontline adoption, translating complex requirements into clear expectations.
* Evaluate program participation, effectiveness, and return on investment, refining programs to strengthen accountability, engagement, and retention.

**Academy and New Hire Readiness**

* Lead the end-to-end Academy experience, including onboarding, on-the-job training, readiness assessment, and transition into production.
* Establish coaching routines, performance expectations, graduation criteria, and handoff standards that accelerate proficiency and support consistent readiness.
* Partner with Talent Acquisition, Workforce Management, Compensation, and Operations to align hiring profiles, staffing needs, and new hire requirements.
* Use performance, engagement, and employee feedback to identify readiness gaps, guide early interventions, and improve the new hire experience.
* Reduce early-tenure attrition and strengthen retention through targeted coaching, leader accountability, and proactive support.

**Executive Leadership and Partnership**

* Build and develop a high-performing leadership team with clear ownership, strong collaboration, and accountability for measurable results.
* Serve as a strategic advisor to senior leadership on operational health, customer experience, workforce readiness, and performance improvement.
* Lead organizational change with clear communication, stakeholder alignment, and disciplined execution.
* Foster a culture of customer focus, analytical rigor, innovation, and continuous improvement.

**Qualifications**

* Proven ability to lead complex transformation, influence executive stakeholders, and drive execution across organizational boundaries.
* Strong executive communication skills, with the ability to translate complex data and operational issues into clear decisions and actions.
* Significant progressive leadership experience in customer service strategy, contact center operations, operational excellence, or a related discipline, including leadership of multiple functions and senior leaders.
* Demonstrated success translating enterprise strategy into operational plans and measurable results within a large, complex organization.
* Strong financial and analytical acumen, including budgeting, forecasting, long-range planning, performance measurement, and investment evaluation.
* Experience with customer service channel strategy, routing, workforce optimization, and outsourced business partner operations.
* Experience leading performance and incentive programs, operational readiness, or new hire development at scale.
* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent relevant experience; advanced degree preferred.

**Employees at all levels are expected to:**

* Understand our Operating Principles; make them the guidelines for how you do your job.
* Own the customer experience think and act in ways that put our customers first, give them seamless digital options at every touchpoint, and make them promoters of our products and services.
* Know your stuff be enthusiastic learners, users and advocates of our game-changing technology, products and services, especially our digital tools and experiences.
* Win as a team make big things happen by working together and being open to new ideas.
* Be an active part of the Net Promoter System a way of working that brings more employee and customer feedback into the company by joining huddles, making call backs and helping us elevate opportunities to do better for our customers.
* Drive results and growth.
* Support a culture of inclusion in how you work and lead.
* Do what's right for each other, our customers, investors and our communities.

**Disclaimer:** This information has been designed to indicate the general nature and level of work performed by employees in this role. It is not designed to contain or be interpreted as a comprehensive inventory of all duties, responsibilities and qualifications.

Comcast is an equal opportunity workplace. We will consider all qualified applicants for employment without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status, genetic information, or any other basis protected by applicable law.

**Seeking Breakthrough Makers**  
  
Children’s Hospital of Philadelphia (CHOP) offers countless ways to change lives. Our diverse community of more than 20,000 Breakthrough Makers will inspire you to pursue passions, develop expertise, and drive innovation.
  
  
At CHOP, your experience is valued; your voice is heard; and your contributions make a difference for patients and families. Join us as we build on our promise to advance pediatric care—and your career.  
  
  
  
  
CHOP does not discriminate on the basis of race, color, sex, national origin, religion, or any other legally protected categories in any employment, training, or vendor decisions or programs. CHOP recognizes the critical importance of a workforce rich in varied backgrounds and experiences and engages in ongoing efforts to achieve that through equally varied and non-discriminatory means.  
  
**A Brief Overview**  
PSRs serve as the operational gateway to care delivery, helping ensure patients and families experience a seamless, informed, and compassionate entry into the healthcare system while supporting access and overall financial integrity.  
  
PSRs are responsible for supporting patient access, registration accuracy, financial clearance, and service excellence. This role plays a critical part in patient experience, operational flow, and revenue integrity across the organization. Team members serve as trusted guides for patients and families while partnering closely with clinical and operational teams to ensure efficient, accurate, and compassionate service delivery. Other duties, administrative support, and projects as required.

  

**Location:** CHOP Pediatric Primary Care, Cobbs Creek

**Address:** 225 S 63rd St, Philadelphia, PA 19139

**Work Schedule:** *(Full-Time)*

* **Weekdays:** 8:30am - 5pm
* **One evening shift per week:** 11:30am - 8pm

The Saturday schedule is rotational.  
  
**What you will do**

* Provide welcoming, prompt, and respectful customer service, which includes scheduling and registering appointments, informing of delays, addressing family complaints, and escalating complaints as necessary.
* Perform PARC (PATIENT ACCESS & REVENUE CYCLE) EPIC functions while ensuring accuracy, and run daily eligibility verifications, following organization access and intake standards.
* Reconciliation of daily services to include collection and processing of payments received, reimbursements, creating and/or obtaining insurance referrals and authorizations needed. Communicate financial responsibility to patients/families.
* For sites responsible for incoming/outbound calls: Answer phones promptly with minimal downtime between calls, monitor call service levels, accurately verify and document contact information and messages, and provide appropriate information to callers as warranted. Communicate in a courteous, caring manner to all customers as needed. Check voicemails if applicable for your site.
* Communicate with patients and families in accordance with CHOP's iCARE values.
* Escalate workflow issues and family issues as appropriate. Provide Family Relations contact information to families if needed.
* Offer and support families with MyCHOP activation for enrollment and troubleshooting of the portal. Encourage utilization of pre-check to support efficient and prompt check-in.
* Perform administrative tasks as assigned such as sorting and delivering mail, faxes (RightFax), medical records, and other correspondence; and photocopying and faxing documents. Scan, upload, and route documents accurately while safeguarding PHI.
* Daily maintenance of patient records and daily schedules while adhering to CHOP policy and procedure, and upholding all HIPAA and documentation standards.
* Actively participate in team huddles and meetings.
* Clean and maintain an organized workspace and ensure that waiting areas are kept tidy as needed.
* Completion of necessary work queues as assigned and various other daily reports.
* Maintain and monitor key performance metrics to ensure goals are met, resources are used effectively, and operational performance is consistently achieved.
* PSRs may need to cover and rotate to other sites and locations. Location and hours may vary. If shifts or staffing needs are available at other locations, PSRs will be asked to support and cover open shifts as needed.

**Education Qualifications**

* High School Diploma/GED Required

**Experience Qualifications**

* At least one (1) year Patient Services Representative experience in a role that consisted of health care, registration, physician billing, medical records, medical office work and relatable customer service. Preferred

**Skills and Abilities**

* Good verbal and written communications skills. (Required proficiency)
* Good interpersonal skills. (Required proficiency)
* Ability to maintain confidentiality and professionalism (Required proficiency)

**To carry out its mission, CHOP is committed to supporting the health of our patients, families, workforce, and global community. As a condition of employment, CHOP employees who work in patient care buildings or who have patient facing responsibilities must receive an annual influenza vaccine.** **Learn more.**

Our diverse team of medical specialists offers a wide range of treatment services, covering medical, orthopedics, neurology, rehabilitation, diagnostic, and surgical. We are committed to supporting patients through personalized support, detailed documentation, and outcome-oriented care coordination to make the recovery process easier. With Excelsia, patients are never far from the care they need—with the compassion they deserve.

* Patient management skills.

* Basic understanding of medical office procedures.

Sitting, standing, walking, reaching above shoulder length, working with body bent over at waist, working in kneeling position, climbing stairs, climbing ladders, working with arms extended at shoulder length, lifting maximum of 20 lbs.

* 401(k) retirement plan with employer match.
* Paid training opportunities and Education Assistance Program.
* Employee Referral Bonus Program

Job Description
  
  
**Job Description:**  
Respiratory Sales Sr. Specialist
  
  
The Respiratory Sales Senior Specialist (RSSS) plays a vital role in bridging the gap between medical products and the healthcare professionals who use them to treat patients. In this role you will develop and manage relationships with a range of specialty health care customers including pulmonologists and other approved specialty physicians, physician assistants, nurse practitioners, nurses, pharmacists, and office managers.
  
  
Joining this team means being a part of driving meaningful patient impact by utilizing our scientific expertise and serving as the primary contact for customers within your assigned territory which includes Knoxville, TN
  
  
**Primary Responsibilities:**  

* Develop and execute a territory-level business plan in alignment with company policies, standards, and ethics. Promote respiratory product and educate HCPs on the appropriate use of our product within an assigned territory while compliantly utilizing approved promotional resources.
* Monitor business performance against objectives using company tools to support effective planning and sales impact.
* Conduct balanced and compliant product sales discussions with health care providers and business professionals to align customer needs with company products according to product labelling.
* Demonstrate expertise in Patient Access Programs and Specialty Distribution Models (e.g., Specialty Pharmacy/HUBs).
* Maintain accurate records of Health Care Providers (HCP) interactions in Customer Relationship Management (CRM) software and utilize data for territory planning.
* Develop and maintain expertise to provide customers with key insights and tailored customer interactions using Company approved learning and development materials.
* Be knowledgeable on headquarter approved information regarding approved company products, disease, and marketplace.

**Minimum Requirements:**  

* Bachelor’s degree or equivalent; 3+ years of pharmaceutical/biotech or equivalent sales experience.
* Experience in specialty pharmacy, distribution channels, and/orHUBs.
* Ability to work both independently and within a team environment.
* Ability to travel up to 75%; must reside in the assigned territory.
* Candidate must possess a valid driver's license.

**Preferred Requirements:**  

* Pulmonology experience is a plus; experience with specialty HCPs in any therapeutic area is desired.
* Success with multiple product launches.
* Demonstrated ability to navigate a flexible and agile way of working.

**Required Skills:**  
Market Analysis, Pharmaceutical Sales Training, Sales Calls, Sales Metrics, Sales Pipeline Management, Sales Presentations, Sales Process Management, Sales Territory Management, Sales Training
